name: Character EXP
description: Character EXP, used to level up characters.

name: Adventure EXP
description: Adventure EXP. Used to improve Adventure Rank.

name: Stardust
description: Small talent points (Including the main character)

name: Starglitter
description: Large talent points (Including the main character)

name: Companionship EXP
description: Companionship EXP. Used to increase Friendship levels.

name: Original Resin
description: Used to vitalize Petrified Trees and Ley Line Blossoms, allowing access to the treasures they hold. Energy regenerates over time.\nIt is said that the roots of all the Irminsul trees and blossoms in the world are intertwined at the deepest, most hidden place in the earth, and that the pattern the root system makes defines the Ley Lines of the world.

name: Story Key
description: A key used to unlock Story Quests.\nObtained by completing the required number of Daily Commissions.

name: Fading Star's Might
description: A collection of celestial energy.\nCan be exchanged for treasure during the "Unreconciled Stars" event.

name: Fading Star's Essence
description: Distilled celestial energy.\nCan be exchanged for valuable treasure during the "Unreconciled Stars" event.\nThe essence of a faraway star. The power emanating from within is warm to the touch.

name: Glimmering Essence
description: A collection of vital energy that exudes a faint glimmer of light.\nCan be exchanged for treasure during the event "The Chalk Prince and the Dragon."

name: Warm Essence
description: A collection of vital energy that exudes a gentle warmth.\nCan be exchanged for precious treasure during the event "The Chalk Prince and the Dragon."

name: Miraculous Essence
description: A wondrous energy capable of reviving and mutating a withered Cryo Regisvine.\nCan be exchanged for invaluable treasure during the event "The Chalk Prince and the Dragon."

name: Iron Coin
description: An ancient type of coinage that Ulman is collecting. Perhaps he may offer you something in exchange for Iron Coins.\nLong ago, there was once an organization that attempted to found their own nation. These coins were the nation's minted currency at the time.

name: Peace Talisman
description: Jade talismans that can be obtained during Lantern Rite. The people of Liyue believe that these talismans can bring and defend peace. You might be able to exchange these for some things during Lantern Rite...

name: Festive Fever
description: The festive mood during Lantern Rite. Perhaps the atmosphere on the day of the Rite will be better the higher the Festive Fever is...

name: Veneficus Sigil
description: A resource used to build all manner of mechanisms in the Theater Mechanicus. Still, the word "veneficus" itself seems to come from some old book...

name: Festive Tour Ticket
description: Take part in the celebratory activities of the Windblume Festival to obtain these tickets and exchange them in the event shop for rewards.\nThe people of Mondstadt are fun-loving by nature, and they have a celebration for the seasons, the harvests of different crops, and the anniversaries of events of historic significance. Perhaps there might be a festival to commemorate the outlander who repelled Stormterror someday...?

name: Peculiar Collab Coupon
description: Take part in the Windblume Festival event Domain to obtain these coupons and exchange them in the event shop for rewards.\nThis Domain of exceeding peculiarity is also part of the Windblume Festival celebrations, and it displays the fun-loving nature of Mondstadt's people.

name: Heart of the Spring
description: The true heart of an Oceanid. This item is truly hard to find, for one must become one with the waters to truly perceive the heart of the springs.

name: Trust
description: Accumulate this to increase your Trust Rank.

name: Fractured Fruit Data
description: Irminsul Fruit fragment data that you have obtained via calculations and analysis performed by the Energy Amplifier. It contains a vast bounty of knowledge that may yet lead to surprising gains if you use it well.

name: Windtrace Coins
description: The currency that is awarded for participating in Windtrace.\nThe "background settings" of this same game will change in different areas. Though it is still a game of chase-and-catch, the fleeing party are named the "Rebels" in Mondstadt, while their pursuer is the "Hunter," symbols both of the ancient resistance and oppression.\nOf course, the children of Mondstadt know well that this is just a game, and no true sense of enmity emerges as they play.

name: Shiny Flotsam
description: Shells brought in by the tide that shine gorgeously, filled with the breath of the sea.\nCan be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Midsummer Island Adventure" event.

name: Mini "Harpastum"
description: These crystal-clear marbles have a bright feather sealed within them, making them miniature harpasta that are easy to collect.\nCan be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Midsummer Island Adventure" event.

name: Enigma Gear
description: Intricately crafted parts from Dodofortresses that look rather valuable. Can be exchanged for rewards.

name: Thunder Pellet
description: A shard of concentrated violet lightning, fizzing with strange Electro energy. Can be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Thunder Sojourn" event.

name: Thunder Crystal
description: A crystal formed from concentrated violet lightning, fizzing with strange Electro energy. Can be exchanged for valuable treasure during the event "Thunder Sojourn" event.

name: Mechanicus Mastery EXP
description: Accumulate this to raise your Mastery Level. Raise your Mastery Level to obtain new Mechanici and Wondrous Sticks.

name: Wondrous Talisman
description: A mysterious talisman obtained by playing Theater Mechanicus: Stage of Wonders. Exchange them with Komakata for some precious items.

name: Moonchase Festival Festive Fever
description: Moonchase Festival Festive Fever

name: Battered Shikifuda
description: Shikifuda that have become terribly tattered. The intricate, esoteric charms have long ago become blurred and cannot be used in combat. However, the energy within these shikifuda is still sufficient to activate Charm Emplacements.\nUse these items in the Labyrinth Warriors event to re-draw Charms.

name: Damaged Replica
description: Shikigami replicas whose charm magic has long since faded. They cannot reawaken Shiki Taishou's memories, but if gathered together, they can still help him reclaim his past power.\nUse these items in the Labyrinth Warriors event to enhance Shiki Taishou's abilities.

name: Aged Token
description: Leftover wooden military ID tokens that record the names of the warriors who once fought within the Mystic Onmyou Chamber.\nExchange these items in the Labyrinth Warriors event for valuable treasure.

name: Snowstrider Seal
description: An insignia given to those who complete the special training conducted by the Adventurers' Guild. It can be considered a symbol of one's strength.

name: Vanquisher's Emblem
description: A precious insignia obtained from conquering a great trial. These emblems won't morph into anything else... Right?

name: Affluence Talisman
description: A wondrous talisman said to be able to connect people to "fortune." In Liyue Harbor, many children are asked by their parents to carry this sort of talisman with them all the time.

name: Immaculate Talisman
description: An exquisite talisman that seems quite valuable. You should be able to exchange this for certain items...

name: Conquest Talisman
description: A strange talisman that appeared out of nowhere on your person. You can still feel powerful emotions emanating vaguely from this talisman when you hold it tight...

name: Moonlit Cragstone
description: A stone that gives off a strange radiance. It can only be found in a separate part of The Chasm, and its origins and composition are both unknown. However, it has strange and unique properties: When it falls, it maintains a regular shape and its cross-section still keeps its mirrored sheen. Those of these rocks that are older may have witnessed that ancient battle.\nThese stones can be exchanged for treasures during "Perilous Trail."

name: Iridescent Flotsam
description: The shell of some sea creature, hard in texture and scattered in the Golden Apple Archipelago. As if affected by a certain power, its surface loses all its natural patterns and becomes iridescent instead.\nCan be exchanged for treasure during "Summertime Odyssey."

name: Stratagem Shard
description: A crystal that contains a deep and subtle power. Much like Cor Lapis, it has a pure Geo-gold hue. Its power can be activated to some extent within this space under The Chasm, thus helping to defeat monsters.\nThis can be used in the "Realms of Guile and War" of "Perilous Trails" to draw Stratagems or allow characters who have fallen to take to the field once again.

name: Creative Note
description: After much discussion with your companions during the adventure, you summed up some thoughtful suggestions on how Aranara Carvings can become more popular. Can be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Graven Innocence" event.

name: Whimsical Draft
description: A quick sketch of inspirations for "Aranara Carvings" made during the adventure. Can be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Graven Innocence" event.

name: Ancient Iron Coin
description: Ancient iron currency which, according to Ulman, is worth an awful lot of money. However, it doesn't feel like anything special to the touch...

name: Player EXP
description: Obtained by winning Genius Invokation TCG matches. Every duel you won builds upon the paths to victory, such is the act of earning experience itself. To know how to overcome and subdue the adversary in any situation is the greatest strength that a player can possess.

name: Festive Fever
description: Weinlesefest Festive Fever

name: Business Earnings
description: A sizable amount of Fairbrew Jelly, representing the sum total of your earnings in this charity event. As the Weinlesefest draws to a close, Bernhard will exchange these for Mora to give to old folks and children who need it.

name: Usable Funds
description: A sizable amount of Fairbrew Jelly, representing the base capital used in setting up your shop.\nAttracting customers and increasing earnings — these two are the key goals of all shopkeepers. As such, you must plan out your spending and increase the attractiveness of your shop.

name: Strategic Inspiration
description: Materials that contain various theories and case studies related to mercantile practice. To those with the appropriate experience, every page and every word is filled with possible inspiration for ways to improve.

name: Mushroom Currency
description: A finely-crafted memorial coin, and the reward given to outstanding participants in the Fungus Capture and Coruscating Potential stages of the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament.\nNo matter the results of the competition, these coins are proof of the friendly associations between the participants and the tame Fungi.\nThese coins can be used to exchange for precious items during the "Fabulous Fungus Frenzy" event.

name: Fungus Medal
description: A medal made from unique materials, and the reward given to outstanding participants in the Special Training stage of the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament.\nWorking together to defeat powerful enemies in the Special Training grounds is one of the key aspects to nurturing the bond between you and your Fungi friends and growing stronger together.\nThese coins can be used to exchange for precious items during the "Fabulous Fungus Frenzy" event.

name: Shattered Phenocryst
description: A mysterious crystalline substance that you obtained after defeating the mighty Hypostases within a heretofore undiscovered Domain. Its lovely colors are like the remnant light of the elements as they are scattered.\nCan be used to exchange for valuable resources in the event "Hypostatic Symphony: Dissonant Verse"

name: Courage Test Ticket
description: Ticket earned from a participant's display of courage and insight by completing special challenges in the "Test of Courage" event hosted by the Yashiro Commission.\nYou can exchange these tickets for rewards during the "Akitsu Kimodameshi" event.

name: Festive Fever
description: Lantern Rite Festive Fever

name: Floral Coupon
description: You can obtain these reward coupons by playing games of Floral Chess during the Windblume Festival. During the event, you can exchange them for rewards.

name: Gala Excitement
description: Wisdom Gala Excitement

name: Festive Ticket
description: You can obtain these reward tickets by taking part in the various festivities during the Windblume Festival. During the event, you can exchange them for rewards.

name: Invokation Coupons
description: You can obtain these coupons after participating in various events at the King of Invokations Grand Prix. During the event, you can exchange them for rewards.

name: Joyeux Voucher
description: Vouchers found inside Voucher Boxes throughout the Veluriyam Mirage. They are exquisitely made and come in vivid colors. Just gripping them in your hand seems to impart the joy of winning a reward.\nCan be used to unlock valuable rewards during the "Secret Summer Paradise" event.

name: Fascinating Phenocryst
description: A crystal that radiates a magnificent luster. Looking upon it for a time will bring back fun memories of taking part in various games. With so many interesting sights to be seen within the Veluriyam Mirage, is it strange that such vast quantities of joy would crystallize into a pure gemstone?\nCan be used to unlock valuable rewards during the "Secret Summer Paradise" event.

name: Enigmatic Copper Mainspring
description: A mainspring with an enigmatic metal luster. Its surface is said to have been processed with a secret technique that grants desirable properties to the inexpensive base metal. The method ensures the mainspring's good performance at a low price when utilized in core meka.\nIt can be used to exchange for supplies and unlock rewards in "Mega Meka Melee."

name: Poetry Gala Fervor
description: "Waterborne Poetry" Poetry Gala Fervor

name: Thelxie's Badge
description: A golden penguin badge that shines with a metallic glow. It seems to give the bearer a staunch resolve to move forward...\nA precious reward that can be unlocked in the "Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures" event.

name: Theater Tickets
description: Exquisitely-made souvenir tickets meant to memorialize participation in the various events related to the Fontinalia Film Festival. These tickets are said to be made to have a similar texture to film slides. Crystal-clear when reflecting light, they resemble nothing so much as thin gem fragments...\nUse these to unlock various rewards during the "Roses and Muskets" event.

name: Ancient Iron Coin
description: Ancient iron currency which, according to Ulman, is worth an awful lot of Mora. However, it doesn't feel like anything special to the touch...

name: Festive Fever
description: Lantern Rite Festive Fever

name: Film for Fun
description: Souvenir coins shaped like film slides. These are mementos that can be accumulated and won through participation in the Fontinalia Film Festival. These cannot be placed within specialized devices to play exciting films, sure, but their unique designs are sure to lift peoples' spirits with reminders of what they saw during that festival...\nThese can be exchanged for valuable rewards during the "Roses and Muskets" event.

name: Funds
description: Funds obtained from running the alchemy shop, which can be reinvested into various matters surrounding said shop. Cultivating more ingredients, producing potions, and the scale of your operations...\nA good shopkeeper always keeps an eye on their shop funds and has a considerable sum at hand. That way, you will be able to maintain a profitable, expanding business...

name: Iridescence Tour Tickets
description: A mysterious ticket that symbolizes the spirit of rock 'n' roll. It appears able to grant its holder hot-blooded passion...\nYou can exchange this for valuable rewards during the "Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness," and send an invitation to an important companion...

name: Analysis Progress
description: By initiating wargames and collecting the combat data therein, we can provide useful points of reference for the various commanders and analyze the abilities of various monsters, as well as how to effectively defeat them...

name: Excerpts of Bliss
description: Pages found while exploring Simulanka. They contain text fragments that describe the daily lives of the realm's inhabitants. Filled as they are with leisure and joy, they set outsiders at ease, that they too may enjoy unforgettable and happy times with their companions in this marvelous wonderland.

name: Starsail Coin
description: A custom coin with a starry emblem carved into it. Exquisitely crafted, it seems to carry the blessings of the one who made it. And who knows? Perhaps good things will come when you use it!\nYou can use it to obtain fairytale figurines from Fantastical Fabricators in the "Summertide Scales and Tales" event.

name: Colorful Contemplation
description: Inspiration for graffiti that, following Dopey Dazzler's suggestion, you've gathered from various sightseeing spots across Natlan. When you calm your mind and focus on the act of observing things, you find that you are able to glean a more thorough understanding of their shapes and colors, which proves greatly beneficial when creating graffiti...\nCan be used to unlock all sorts of material rewards during the "Traces of Artistry" event.

name: Festive Fervor
description: The festive fervor of the Sabzeruz Festival can be continually accumulated by participating in festival events and be used to unlock various rewards.

name: Incense Ashcrystals
description: When a person burns incense to enter a state of clairvoyance, the ash leftover from the consumed incense condenses into these crystals. The sides reflect the time that was spent Spiritseeking.

name: Festive Fever
description: Lantern Rite Festive Fever

name: Festival Stamp
description: A stamp gained from playing games at the Mikawa Flower Festival. It represents both the festival-goer's appreciation and the creator's passion...

name: Smiley Snacks
description: A tasty treat combining a variety of aromatic ingredients with a soft and crumbly base. Ingredients are carefully selected, and the finished result is safe for 99% of Teyvat's animals to eat. This sumptuous snack is a delicious invitation for animal friends from far and wide to visit the Mellow Manor...

name: Funds
description: The total funding pool reserved for operating the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland. It is the source of investment for all of the park's amusements, and the destination for all of their income. Only by ensuring that every last Mora is invested correctly can profits be maximized...

name: Action Points
description: Equivalent to the "time slots" that Navia told you about. These are the units of time in which all work at the park is allocated, based on the principles of time management. Using words that even Paimon can understand, they are "points required to perform actions."\nAs management skills and working efficiency improve, more work can be completed in the same amount of time, allowing for the day to be subdivided into a larger number of time slots, thereby increasing the amount of work completed...

name: Speculative Records
description: Records collected through careful observations of the Companion Caper Chronicles' tabletop adventure game and fruit-feeding trials. Fadaweh uses these records to calculate and extrapolate various scenarios and data for the Companion Caper Chronicles. Though initially a game made for children, she will not tolerate even the slightest inaccuracy in the data.

name: Sunspray Spirit
description: A small pattern in the shape of an Asha that exudes the mesmerizing colors of summer. Increase your summer heat and enjoy everything this precious holiday has to offer!

name: Legion Morale
description: The Clink Clank Legion's morale affects Aino's efficiency and is crucial to the investigation!

name: Prep Progress
description: Preparation work progress made on behalf of the Fieldwise Center. Once adequate preparation work has been completed, the Fieldwise Center should be able to operate on its own...

name: Blazing Spirit
description: Proof of participation in the "Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey." A warrior fueled by faith, courage, and passion will ultimately reap brilliant victories.

name: Fortune Coin
description: A special coin prepared by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. It can be exchanged for various rewards during the Lantern Rite.

name: Windscape Splendor
description: Inspiration gained by exploring Mondstadt from a different perspective during the welcome ceremony. It can be used to unlock valuable rewards.

name: Treasured Insights
description: Insights gained from appreciating all manner of splendid attire. Once enough have been accumulated, they may one day be exchanged for precious rewards...

name: Joint Exhibition Popularity
description: A commemorative medal awarded for helping organize the "Nod-Krai Trade Expo." It can be exchanged for valuable rewards.

name: Pals Synergy
description: The bond established while playing with your imaginary friends. Can be exchanged for rewards in the "Phantasmal Pals" event.

name: Venue Popularity
description: During the "Sunny Summer Fontinalia" event, complete various aquarium tasks to raise your Venue Popularity. This score can be used to unlock valuable supply rewards.

name: Primogem
description: A primordial crystalline gem that's beyond the mundane world. Shines with the condensed hopes and dreams of universes that once were.

name: Mora
description: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

name: Genesis Crystal
description: An energy crystal from the very origin of the universe. Formed from within nothingness out of pure potential and hope, it contains enough energy to create a newborn star.

name: Realm Currency
description: Currency of the realm. Used within the Serenitea Pot to exchange for various items.

name: Toy Medal
description: A shiny medal. It is a toy, yes, but it nonetheless represents the acknowledgment of the audience.\nUse it in the "Imaginarium Theater" to obtain "Thespian Tricks" from Wolfy.

name: Repertoire Coins
description: Currency gained from completing "Repertoire of Myriad Melodies" performances. Proof that you've been acknowledged as one who loves music and rhythm. Can be exchanged at the "Treasure of Myriad Melodies" for unique rewards.

name: Original Essence (Invalidated)
description: A crystal that temporarily revitalizes Irminsul to grant you ancient treasures. The energy within regenerates over time.

name: Original Resin (Invalidated)
description: A crystal that temporarily revitalizes Irminsul to grant you great treasures. The energy within regenerates over time.

name: Masterless Starglitter
description: Currency used to purchase rare resources from the Shop.\nSurplus Starglitter of destiny. Perhaps it can light up other corners of the universe.

name: Masterless Stardust
description: Currency used to purchase rare resources from the Shop.\nSurplus Stardust of destiny. Perhaps it can create new destinies when in large enough quantities.

name: Intertwined Fate
description: A fateful stone that connects dreams.\nIts glimmers can entwine fates and connect dreams, just as how its glimmers link stars into the shapes of a heart's desires.

name: Acquaint Fate
description: A seed that lights up the night.\nNo matter the distance apart, guided by the stone's glimmer, the fated will meet under the stars.

name: Chronal Nexus
description: A crystal containing phenomenological concepts formed from the coalescence of precious memories and obsessions within ever-shifting realms.

name: Arcane Keystone
description: A curious keystone that serves as a repository of brilliant hues.\nIn a wondrous domain filled with beauty and mystery, myriad stories from a witch's long sojourns in foreign lands are sealed. By harnessing the power of this wondrous item, you can reveal these brilliant treasures to the world once more...

name: Geode of Replication
description: A crystal geode that serves as a template to reproduce splendor.\nIn a mystical realm where anything can take shape, it is imbued with a witch's insights into the true essence of clothing. By harnessing the power of this wondrous item, you can re-create many a marvelous cosmetic...

name: Engraved Shard
description: Currency used to purchase precious items from the Shop.\nThe materialized form of surplus phenomena. Perhaps it can recreate splendorous treasures when in large enough quantities.

name: Festive Key
description: A wondrous key that allows you to open a lobby. Absolutely essential for anyone seeking to host a lively gathering.\nA new Festive Key takes shape every 12 hours.

name: Luminous Keystone
description: A bright, translucent keystone that can be used to perform Event Odes.\nIn a wondrous domain replete with luminous splendor, every corner is filled with exquisite forms arranged by a witch. By harnessing the power of this wondrous item, you can re-create many a marvelous cosmetic...

name: Wonderland EXP
description: When exploring the "Miliastra Wonderland," the enthusiasm, encounters, and knowledge gained serve as a particularly precious form of "experience."

name: Chronicle EXP
description: A witch's boundless collection, sealed within a Wonderland. Each treasure is a spark of inspiration leading toward a brand-new creation.

name: Chronicles of the Realms
description: Use this item to unlock Chronicles of the Realms for a single period.

name: Prismatic Crystal
description: A precious item in "Miliastra Wonderland." This crystal shimmers with a mysterious light and can be exchanged for various gift boxes in the Wonderlands.

name: Prismatic Crystal
description: A precious item in "Miliastra Wonderland." This crystal shimmers with a mysterious light and can be exchanged for various gift boxes in the Wonderlands. It has a <color=#FF5E41>time limit</color>. Once this period ends, it will vanish and lose all its effects...

name: Prismatic Crystal
description: A precious item in "Miliastra Wonderland." This crystal shimmers with a mysterious light and can be exchanged for various gift boxes in the Wonderlands.

name: Pyro Sigil
description: A sigil representing the acknowledgment of Natlan's flames.\nCan be offered to the Tablet of Tona at the Temple of Pax to obtain the blessings of the Sacred Flame.

name: Hydro Sigil
description: A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the waters in Fontaine.\nOffer it to the Fountain of Lucine to receive the rewards from the springs.

name: Dendro Sigil
description: A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the trees, grass, and flowers in Sumeru.\nOffer it to the Tree of Dreams deep in the woods to receive the rewards from the forest.

name: Electro Sigil
description: A sigil that serves as a sign of the acknowledgment given by the thundering islands of Inazuma.\nOffer them to the Sacred Sakura of the Grand Narukami Shrine to raise your Sacred Sakura's Favor level.

name: Anemo Sigil
description: An insignia that shows the recognition of the winds of Mondstadt.\nCan be exchanged for special items in Mondstadt.

name: Cryo Sigil
description: A token of recognition and appreciation that can be found around Mondstadt. Can be exchanged for rare items in the shop.

name: Geo Sigil
description: An insignia that shows the recognition of the cliffs of Liyue.\nCan be exchanged for special items in Liyue.

name: Luna Sigil
description: A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the flowing moonlight of the borderlands.\nOffer it to the Meeting Point to receive the rewards from moonlight.

name: Inazuma Reputation EXP
description: Increases your Reputation Lv. (Inazuma)

name: Mondstadt Reputation EXP
description: Increases your Reputation Lv. (Mondstadt)

name: Sumeru Reputation EXP
description: Increases your Reputation Lv. (Sumeru)

name: Liyue Reputation EXP
description: Increases your Reputation Lv. (Liyue)

name: Fontaine Reputation EXP
description: Increases your Reputation Lv. (Fontaine)

name: "Scions of the Canopy" Reputation EXP
description: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (Scions of the Canopy)

name: "People of the Springs" Reputation EXP
description: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (People of the Springs)

name: "Children of Echoes" Reputation EXP
description: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (Children of Echoes)

name: "Flower-Feather Clan" Reputation EXP
description: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (Flower-Feather Clan)

name: "Masters of the Night-Wind" Reputation EXP
description: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (Masters of the Night-Wind)

name: "Collective of Plenty" Reputation EXP
description: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (Collective of Plenty)

name: Memory of Eternal Flames
description: The missing star from the Talents of a Pyro-aligned Traveler.

name: Memory of Running Stream
description: The missing star from the Talents of a Hydro-aligned Traveler.

name: Memory of Flourishing Green
description: The missing star from the Talents of a Dendro-aligned Traveler.

name: Memory of Violet Flash
description: The missing star from the Talents of an Electro-aligned Traveler.

name: Memory of Roving Gales
description: The missing star from the Talents of an Anemo-aligned Traveler.

name: Memory of Piercing Frost
description: The missing star from the Talents of a Cryo-aligned Traveler.

name: Memory of Immovable Crystals
description: The missing star from the Talents of a Geo-aligned Traveler.

name: Blazing Flint Ore
description: Flint Ore gets its name from the radiant glow it harbors.\nWhen grasped in one's hand, one can feel the fiery pulse thrumming within the stone. Perhaps one day, held high against the starry sky, it might emit a gentle gleam that illuminates the night.

name: Kamisato Ayaka
description: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

name: Jean
description: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

name: Male Character
description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

name: Lisa
description: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

name: Female Lead
description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

name: Barbara
description: Every citizen of Mondstadt adores Barbara. She learned the word "idol" from a magazine.

name: Kaeya
description: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

name: Diluc
description: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.

name: Razor
description: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.

name: Amber
description: Always energetic and full of life, Amber's the best — albeit only — Outrider of the Knights of Favonius.

name: Venti
description: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.

name: Xiangling
description: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.

name: Beidou
description: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

name: Xingqiu
description: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

name: Xiao
description: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

name: Ningguang
description: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

name: Klee
description: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius' confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

name: Zhongli
description: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.

name: Fischl
description: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

name: Bennett
description: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.

name: Tartaglia
description: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

name: Noelle
description: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.

name: Qiqi
description: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

name: Chongyun
description: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

name: Ganyu
description: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

name: Albedo
description: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

name: Diona
description: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.

name: Mona
description: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

name: Keqing
description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis' unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

name: Sucrose
description: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

name: Xinyan
description: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

name: Rosaria
description: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

name: Hu Tao
description: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

name: Kaedehara Kazuha
description: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.

name: Yanfei
description: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.

name: Yoimiya
description: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.

name: Thoma
description: The Kamisato Clan's housekeeper. A well-known "fixer" in Inazuma.

name: Eula
description: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

name: Raiden Shogun
description: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.

name: Sayu
description: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems sleep-deprived.

name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
description: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.

name: Gorou
description: The great general of Watatsumi Island's forces. He is deeply trusted by his subordinates.

name: Kujou Sara
description: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.

name: Arataki Itto
description: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?

name: Yae Miko
description: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.

name: Shikanoin Heizou
description: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.

name: Yelan
description: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.

name: Kirara
description: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.

name: Aloy
description: Formerly an outcast, now a hunter of unparalleled skill. Ready to do the right thing at any time.

name: Shenhe
description: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

name: Yun Jin
description: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.

name: Kuki Shinobu
description: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader - Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.

name: Kamisato Ayato
description: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

name: Collei
description: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.

name: Dori
description: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.

name: Tighnari
description: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.

name: Nilou
description: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.

name: Cyno
description: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.

name: Candace
description: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.

name: Nahida
description: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.

name: Layla
description: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.

name: Wanderer
description: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

name: Faruzan
description: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.

name: Yaoyao
description: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring "little adult."

name: Alhaitham
description: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.

name: Dehya
description: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.

name: Mika
description: A young knight born to an ordinary family. He serves as a Front-Line Surveyor in his Company. He is a low-key and cautious character.

name: Kaveh
description: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.

name: Baizhu
description: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.

name: Lynette
description: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.

name: Lyney
description: A famed Fontainian magician who possesses great stage presence as well as gift of the gab. Audiences are enthralled by his exquisite skills, and they hang on to his every clever word.

name: Freminet
description: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.

name: Wriothesley
description: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.

name: Neuvillette
description: The Chief Justice of Fontaine, known as the Iudex, is renowned for his unassailable impartiality.

name: Charlotte
description: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."

name: Furina
description: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.

name: Chevreuse
description: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.

name: Navia
description: The current President of Spina di Rosula, who is lovely, dutiful, and a great boss.

name: Gaming
description: Guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency, and the head of the "Mighty Mythical Beasts" Wushou troupe.

name: Xianyun
description: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."

name: Chiori
description: The owner of Chioriya Boutique. A tailor renowned throughout Fontaine.

name: Sigewinne
description: A Melusine and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She cares equally for every convict locked in the undersea prison.

name: Arlecchino
description: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."

name: Sethos
description: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.

name: Clorinde
description: An undefeated Champion Duelist. Sword in hand, she defends justice in the Court of Fontaine.

name: Emilie
description: A Fontainian perfumer, one who bottles secrets.

name: Gnostic Hymn - Old Notes
description: An early draft of a traveler's tale, recording the many things they saw on their journey across the lands. But why does it exist? It is almost as if you have been here before...\n\nUse this item to unlock Gnostic Hymn for a single period.

name: Blessing of the Welkin Moon - New Moon
description: A ritual prayer, recited on the rising of the first new moon, to ask for the moon's blessing in the form of wealth and good fortune. For your purposes, the new moon you shall pray to is the first-ever new moon in Teyvat, since it's the first one you've seen here.\n\nUse this item to receive 30 days of Blessing of the Welkin Moon rewards.

name: An Appellative Stroke
description: The brush with which you may bestow a new name upon a certain person.\nOnce the new name has been given, it cannot be changed.

name: Reaffirmed Accord of Appellation
description: Just like when you first met and tied a scarf around his tail, now give him a new "name."\nAfter giving him a new name, it cannot be changed again.

name: Overwrite Key: Left
description: A secret key given to you and Paimon, along with the Miliastra Wonderland. Use it to rename the Manekin.\nOnce the new name has been given, it cannot be changed.

name: Overwrite Key: Right
description: A secret key given to you and Paimon, along with the Miliastra Wonderland. Use it to rename the Manekina.\nOnce the new name has been given, it cannot be changed.

name: Kaeya
description: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

name: Lisa
description: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

name: Kachina
description: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.

name: Kinich
description: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.

name: Mualani
description: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.

name: Xilonen
description: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.

name: Chasca
description: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.

name: Ororon
description: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.

name: Mavuika
description: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.

name: Citlali
description: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.

name: Lan Yan
description: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.

name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
description: A shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse, a baku, and a clinical psychologist. Dedicated to the dispersal of nightmares, and to bringing people peace of mind.

name: Iansan
description: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.

name: Varesa
description: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!

name: Escoffier
description: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.

name: Ifa
description: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.

name: Skirk
description: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.

name: Dahlia
description: Deacon of the Church of Favonius and the Anemo Archon's representative in the church.

name: Ineffa
description: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.

name: Lauma
description: A Maiden blessed by moonlight and the grove alike, hope born to the Frostmoon Scions.

name: Flins
description: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.

name: Aino
description: A genius mechanic and inventor from Nod-Krai who loves interesting machines and sweet treats.

name: Nefer
description: The remarkably resourceful owner of the Curatorium of Secrets.

name: Durin
description: A dragon born from M's pen, who came to alight in the human world. His "story" continues to unfold.

name: Jahoda
description: The Curatorium of Secrets' extremely reliable, do-it-all super employee (or so she claims).

name: Columbina
description: The Moon Maiden born in Nod-Krai, and also the welkin moon returning home.

name: Zibai
description: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.

name: Illuga
description: Member of the investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. The youngest squad leader among the Lightkeepers.

name: Varka
description: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

name: Lohen
description: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.

name: Linnea
description: Naturalist and Advisor to the Nod-Krai Branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

name: Nicole
description: The Silent "Mage," the Voiceless "Angel."

name: Prune
description: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!

name: Sandrone
description: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers, "Marionette." Interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.

name: Apple
description: Crisp and fragrant. Delicious raw or made into wine.
effect: Restores 300 HP for the selected character.

name: Sunsettia
description: A plump fruit, beautiful like the sunset, that is abundant across all of Teyvat. It has a curious, sweet aroma and is able to energize an individual.
effect: Restores 300 HP for the selected character.

name: A Piece of Paper
description: You have no idea who slipped it to you.

name: Stolen Items
description: Items belonging to the people of Mondstadt that were previously stolen by hilichurls in Drunkard Gorge.

name: Hilichurl Antidote
description: Made by hilichurl witch doctors. Cures hilichurl poison.

name: Climbing Finish Line Garland
description: Marker indicating the finish line of the Climbing Competition.

name: Gliding Finish Line Garland
description: Marker indicating the finish line of the Gliding Competition.

name: Gliding Finish Line Garland
description: Marker indicating the finish line of the Gliding Competition finals.

name: Gliding Champion Cup
description: Awarded to the Mondstadt Gliding Competition Champion.

name: Mushroom
description: Hardy common fungi. Can grow anywhere with the right amount of shade and moisture.

name: Sweet Flower
description: Particularly fragrant flowers. They can be found easily, even in the dark. Just follow the scent.

name: Carrot
description: A healthy and nutritious vegetable that is crunchy and sweet to the taste. Easy to grow and harvest.

name: Radish
description: Rich in fiber and nutrients. Easy to grow and harvest.

name: Snapdragon
description: Can be eaten once cooked. As a spice, it can bring wonderful flavor to dishes.

name: Mint
description: A refreshingly cool ingredient. The cool, fresh flavor can cut through the heat of many dishes.

name: Wheat
description: Golden, sun-kissed tassels. Needs to be ground down to flour for further use.

name: Cabbage
description: A layered, leafy vegetable. Said to have originally been an ornamental plant, it certainly looks great in the pot.

name: Silver Lotus
description: A rare plant that grows on steep cliffs with nobility. Shines magnificently in the night.

name: Pinecone
description: Filled with oil-rich seeds. Certainly won't be growing into a tree from inside a squirrel's stomach.

name: Wolfhook
description: A berry with thorns that often gets attached to a wolf's pelt. When you look at it, you can almost hear the echoing cries of the wolves in the woods.

name: Valberry
description: A plump and translucent berry that has a fragrant smell and a sweet, refreshing taste. In the past, the storm watchers' only solace was the sweetness of this fruit and hope for the city's peace.

name: Cecilia
description: A beautiful flower with a name that suits its appearance. It only grows where harsh winds blow, and is just as intangible as the true heart of an unbound soul.

name: Windwheel Aster
description: A plant that adores the wind. To the proud children of the wind, or the citizens of Mondstadt, the Windwheel Asters are "the visible winds."

name: Philanemo Mushroom
description: A fungus that grows in the warm caress of the wind. It is as everlasting as the wind, nourishing life.

name: Lotus Head
description: An aquatic plant native to Liyue that grows and blooms in pairs. One is fragrant, and the other bitter. It's said to make a good herbal medicine.

name: Jueyun Chili
description: A spicy plant native to Liyue. Merely smelling it makes one hot and thirsty.

name: Noctilucous Jade
description: A rare mineral that glimmers in the dark. It's said to be a mutated gemstone condensed from the flourishing elements of the world.

name: Silk Flower
description: A crimson flower that blooms like the rainbow clouds in Liyue. It can be made into silky-smooth fabric.

name: Glaze Lily
description: An extremely ancient flower that was said to be commonly seen in Liyue. It transforms the memories of the land into its fragrance during florescence.

name: Qingxin
description: A translucent white flower that only grows on the highest stone peaks. It eschews the warmth and moisture of the plains to gaze out afar from the solitary mountaintops.

name: Horsetail
description: A purple plant that sometimes grows amidst Silvergrass but grows taller, straighter, and plumper — like an aristocrat among the paupers.

name: Starconch
description: Empty seashells brought ashore by the tides. Hold one close to your ear, and hear the longing calls of the sea.

name: Violetgrass
description: A small flower with strong vitality. It is said that its downward-blooming flower keeps its fragrance from dissipating.

name: Berry
description: Small, brightly-colored fruit. They can be found everywhere, and the taste of them wipes the fatigue of a long journey away.

name: Mist Flower Corolla
description: A flower bud encased in solid ice. Even after being picked, the flower continues to emit cold.

name: Flaming Flower Stamen
description: The stamen of a fiercely burning flower. Even after being extinguished, it still emits heat.

name: Electro Crystal
description: A power-rich crystal that draws electricity from the air around it. Holding it makes your hand a little numb.

name: Small Lamp Grass
description: A wild grass that emits light at night. Used in cooking to enhance other flavors.

name: Calla Lily
description: A flower that grows near water sources. When cooked, the petals have a chunky texture, yet are sweet and a little bitter.

name: Dandelion Seed
description: A tiny seed that rides on the wind. Even without its feathered wings, it still holds the hope from afar within.

name: Cor Lapis
description: A precious crystal of condensed pure Geo element that usually grows along with other minerals. It's also commonly called "Cor Petrae."

name: Raw Meat
description: A fresh chunk of meat. Handled properly, it can be used to make delicious food.

name: Bird Egg
description: An incredibly versatile ingredient that can supply all of your daily protein needs.

name: Matsutake
description: A rare fungus that generally grows on or near pine trees. Its delicate aroma gives away its location.

name: Fowl
description: A fresh chunk of fowl. Handled properly, it can make a hearty meal.

name: Butterfly Wings
description: Brightly colored wings. The powder that falls from them shimmers a little. Perhaps this is what allows them to fly?

name: Crab
description: A shelled creature that lives near the ocean. Its flaky, delicious meat can easily be made into tasty dishes.

name: Crab Roe
description: A delicacy specific to female crabs. A rare and prized ingredient that isn't quite to everyone's taste.

name: Salt
description: A savory seasoning. A precise but adequate amount will elevate the quality of the cuisine.

name: Onion
description: A spherical vegetable. As vengeance for cutting it, it will make you cry, no matter how brave you are.

name: Pepper
description: Peppery. Cuts through oily flavors and excites the taste buds. Goes best on meat.

name: Milk
description: Sweet and fragrant cow's milk. Don't waste a single drop, not even that one rolling down your chin.

name: Tomato
description: A bright red ingredient that gives a tangy kick. Yes, the "fruit or vegetable" debate is still going...

name: Potato
description: A chunky vegetable. A gift from the earth that you never tire of with its multitude of cooking methods.

name: Frog
description: Common frog found in moist environments. Full of energy, they secrete a substance that will keep you full of vitality.

name: Luminescent Spine
description: The light-emitting part of a firefly. Used for courtship, and in medicine to help recover strength.

name: Lizard Tail
description: A lizard tail that curled up after losing its owner. Very bitter, but has skin hardening properties.

name: Fish
description: A fresh fillet of fish. Handled properly, it can make a rich dish.

name: Crystal Core
description: The core of a crystal butterfly. It absorbs elemental energy that has escaped into the atmosphere.

name: Raw Meat (S)
description: A fresh chunk of meat. Handled properly, it can be used to make delicious food.

name: Fowl (S)
description: A fresh chunk of fowl. Handled properly, it can make a hearty meal.

name: Tofu
description: Freshly made bean product that has a silky-smooth tender texture.

name: Almond
description: A seed with a peculiar fragrance that gives food a refreshing taste.

name: Loach Pearl
description: A shiny pearl spat out by a loach that has mystical medicinal properties.\nMinerals and elemental particles ingested by the loach condense into these mildly magical beads. When threatened, the loach spits them out to confuse predators and escape with its life.

name: Bamboo Shoot
description: A fresh young bamboo shoot, straight out of the ground. It is a delicious cooking ingredient with an exotic aroma, found exclusively in bamboo-growing regions.

name: Rice
description: A grain crop commonly found in Teyvat. People of all walks of life enjoy its distinct grainy texture. As the saying goes, "The same kind of rice can feed one hundred kinds of people."

name: Shrimp Meat
description: A whole piece of deep sea shrimp meat, full of nutrients and bursting with delicious flavor.

name: Chilled Meat
description: Rare, fresh meat.\nThis species of boar is recorded to have gone extinct several hundred years ago and has been preserved by the extreme temperatures on Dragonspine. For the gourmets of Teyvat, this is an ingredient of unspeakable sacrosanctness.

name: Eel Meat
description: The fresh meat of an Unagi/Eel. If handled properly, it can be used to make fresh, lovely food.

name: Glabrous Beans
description: A common legume in Teyvat with a light aroma. It can be prepared in a variety of ways, and is thus widely accepted by people all over the world.

name: Mysterious Meat
description: A fresh chunk of meat that seems to be radiating an enigmatic aura. Wonder what it'll taste like?

name: Coffee Beans
description: A common fruit in Teyvat with a special aroma. It can be used to make beverages after being ground.

name: Fermented Juice
description: A fermented juice with a unique fruity scent. It is often used as a marinade.

name: Rye
description: The gray-brown ears are a gift from the earth. Their richness can only be brought out by grounding and roasting.

name: Jean's Document Package
description: A few normal documents and a copy of Vera's Troubles.

name: Extreme Escape
description: Musk's Travel Journal. In the notes regarding Musk Reef is a line that reads: "Only on a morning sea breeze can one glide here from Lover's Cape..."

name: Incomplete Score (Part 1)
description: The first half of the sheet music for "Yellow." "S to J" is written in the bottom right corner.

name: Incomplete Score (Part 2)
description: The second half of the sheet music for "Yellow."

name: Private Letter from Lisa to Jean
description: Lisa has asked you to give this to Jean to deliver the news that Vera's Secret is receiving a sequel soon.

name: Autumn Night
description: Tells a story in which a court mage and her King get married in the end.

name: Tasty-Looking Potion
description: Looks tasty, but is actually a weakening potion.

name: Potion
description: Lisa has asked you to give this to Barbara.

name: Barbara's Treatment
description: Lisa has asked you to give this to Barbara.

name: Incomplete Poem (Part 1)
description: The poem Venti asked you to look for, though only the first part of it.

name: Incomplete Poem (Part 2)
description: The poem Venti asked you to look for, though it would seem there is more.

name: Incomplete Poem (Part 3)
description: The poem Venti asked you to look for, piece the three pages together to reveal a love verselet.

name: Inscription Rubbing
description: Ancient text engraved on the building.

name: Form Restoration Potion
description: Can restore those that have been transformed into hilichurls by Abyss Mages back to their human form.

name: Holy Lyre der Himmel
description: Can be used for taking down Stormterror.

name: Cricket Hair
description: You didn't catch a cricket, just a hair off its leg.

name: Cricket (White)
description: Common cricket. Can be seen everywhere, nothing rare about it at all.

name: Cricket (Blue)
description: A big blue cricket. Seems to have a powerful bite force. Should be good at battle.

name: Cricket (Purple)
description: A rare cricket with seven different red and purple layers to its wings.

name: Cricket (Gold)
description: Oh, wow! The Legendary Golden Cricket!

name: Hydro Amber
description: Hydro Amber given to you by Venti. Can be smashed to create rainfall. (Test)

name: Anemo Amber
description: Anemo Amber given to you by Venti. Can be smashed to create air currents. (Test)

description: Items worth little value stolen from some random passer-by. Better return them quickly.

description: A teardrop crystal in which gloomy red gleams flow. Seems to have been left by the dragon. Perhaps the person that was talking with the dragon knows more about it, but where did he go?

name: Teardrop Crystal
description: A curious teardrop left in the ancient arena that attracted hordes of monsters to fight for it.

name: Teardrop Crystal
description: A teardrop looted and treasured by some members of the Eclipse hilichurl tribe. Had some trouble "convincing" them to part with it.

name: Teardrop Crystal
description: A tear hidden in the forest ruins. Thankfully it hadn't been eaten by the insects.

name: Holy Lyre der Himmel
description: A treasure that once belonged to Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, but its Anemo power has all dried up.

name: Partially Repaired Holy Lyre der Himmel
description: A treasure that once belonged to Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, with some power restored by a Teardrop Crystal.

name: Completely Repaired Holy Lyre der Himmel
description: A treasure that once belonged to Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, that has been restored to full power. Even Dvalin may heed its call.

name: Clear Dvalin Tear
description: A teardrop left behind by Dvalin. The pure power of Anemo resonates within it.

name: Damaged Holy Lyre der Himmel
description: A prized treasure of Barbatos, the Anemo Archon. Its clear sound that once echoed through the heavens and was beloved by the unruly Dvalin has now been reduced to naught but dull, ear-piercing noise.

name: Treasure Clue (I)
description: A piece of paper with clues to a treasure. On it, is an unclear map with an unclear message.

name: Treasure Clue (II)
description: A piece of paper with clues to a treasure. On it, is an unclear map with an unclear message.

name: Treasure Map
description: A scribbled map with a simple marking in a particular area.

name: Hidden Key
description: A key that once belonged to the Fatui. Just like all other keys, each respond to a door.

name: Black Key
description: Opens the black door.

name: Vera's Melancholy (I)
description: I don't ever think the world is monotonous. It's just that interesting things happen in far away galaxies.\nThe great adventure of Vera, an ordinary girl always fascinated by distant lands, secretly begins.

name: Vera's Melancholy (II)
description: Everything's just boring. Everything, all the time. It's not depression. It's just reaching the age of 14.\nSo begins Vera's adventure.

name: Vera's Melancholy (III)
description: The Andromeda Empire stretches across half the galaxy group. Every planet within the Empire has its own demons and deities, dragons and monsters.\n"I've come up with a story for every star from your home." "That's not possible. Looking from here, the Andromeda Galaxy is only one fifth the size of your moon."\nSo continues Vera's adventure.

name: Along with Divinity: Prologue
description: "Have you ever thought about what our lives would've been like without the archons?"\nCome and join the author in an exploration of "divinity" with humor and logic.

name: The Legend of Vennessa (I)
description: A popular song since the reconstruction of Mondstadt. It tells the story of Vennessa, the founder of the Knights of Favonius, in her early years as a slave in Mondstadt.

name: The Legend of Vennessa (II)
description: A popular song since the reconstruction of Mondstadt. It tells the story of Vennessa, the founder of the Knights of Favonius, in her early years when she met Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, as well as how she defeated the drake and overthrew the Aristocrats.

name: Mondstadt General Goods Order Board
description: Mondstadt General Goods Order Board

name: Cat's Tail Tavern Message Board
description: Cat's Tail Tavern Message Board

name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (I)
description: "Dandelion, Dandelion, ride the wind to a faraway land," the Fox chants.\nAn unforgettable Mondstadt fairytale about a hunter and a fox. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, an 11-part story, begins here.

name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (II)
description: "Be good and stay put." Trapped by a Mist Flower, what does fate have in store by the fox who met a hunter?\nThe story of the Hunter and the Fox continues in Part 2.

name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (III)
description: The Hunter of fruitless hunts was awoken by a commotion outside. Who is at his door?\nThe story of the Hunter and the Fox continues. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 3.

name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (V)
description: Upon accepting the Fox's conditions, he came to the place where all the prey who disappeared had eventually gone to — an endless field of dandelions.\nThe story of the Hunter and the Fox in the sea of dandelions. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 5.

name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (VI)
description: "Why do you want to learn the language of human?" "So I can befriend humans when I become one."\nThe child-like voice says, in the sea of dandelions. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 6.

name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (VII)
description: "Dandelion, Dandelion, ride the wind to a faraway land," the Fox chants.\nCan the Hunter also learn magic to make his wish come true? The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 7.

name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (X)
description: The somber parting has finally arrived... The Fox bids farewell to its mother, teacher, and the dandelion sea.\nIt's time to live up to the promise. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 10.

name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (XI)
description: "Dandelion, Dandelion, ride the wind to a faraway land," the Fox chants.\nAn unforgettable Mondstadt fairytale about a hunter and a fox. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, the final installment.

name: Hilichurl Ballad Selection (I)
description: The masterpiece of the Poet Laureate of Hilichurlian! Scholar Jacob Musk will show you the mysterious spiritual world of the hilichurls through this poetry collection!

name: Hilichurl Ballad Selection (II)
description: Are wine and poetry a part of the hilichurl lifestyle? Do they have pure and devout desires? Expert on the hilichurls, Jacob Musk, is here to answer!

name: Vera's Melancholy (V)
description: You can't have picnics on the sides of a galactic highway! Even the deities will be held fully responsible for road accidents that might occur!\nThe doorway to a study in a simple village connects to anywhere in space and time! Having tea with the deities, playing hide-and-seek across time... Vera's great adventure continues!

name: Vera's Melancholy (IX)
description: "Vera's so beautiful, like a shining star in the universe, but I..." "Boys at this age are always more petite than girls of a similar age."\nChildhood must be let go of to welcome the coming of the adolescent years. It's not too late to think about it now... Real melancholy finally hits Vera.

name: Vera's Melancholy (X)
description: "It's enough. Let's go home... The furthest place I've dreamt of, is the Delphi where you are."\nThough the explanation is delayed, you should know that Delphi is the center of Greek mythology. Vera's Melancholy - the perfect ending... or is it?

name: Breeze Amidst the Forest - Ballad Selection Excerpt
description: A collection of Mondstadt ballads, recorded, compiled and arranged by scholars centuries ago.

name: The Boar Princess (I)
description: A long, long time ago, in the forest kingdom... What legends occurred there?\nThe Boar Princess, Part 1. A story about friendship, love, and death.

name: The Boar Princess (II)
description: A lifeless ice field, a land even the gentle Anemo Archon has never visited. How is it that it still has its lonely inhabitants?\nThe Boar Princess, Part 2. The story continues on the glacier.

name: The Boar Princess (III)
description: "Now and evermore shall you be bereft of hope." What fate awaits the wolf pup who bears such a cruel curse?\nThe Boar Princess, Part 3.

name: The Boar Princess (IV)
description: The wolf pup grew up in the cold loneliness. The secret past of the lone wolf is now revealed.\nThe Boar Princess, Part 4.

name: The Boar Princess (V)
description: "No one deserves this fate." The good princess sheds a tear of compassion. For those who persevere as true companions, even the ice shall melt before their determination.\nThe Boar Princess, Part 5.

name: The Boar Princess (VII)
description: All the sacrifices made out in the frozen plains were not in vain. The perfect ending of friendship, love, life and death!\nThis is the end to the famous and touching story, The Boar Princess.

name: The Mondstadt Tower (I)
description: In the age of depression and tyranny, the outlander girl met the ominous orphan. Does this fateful encounter foretell a tragic ending?\nThe historic romance novel, The Mondstadt Tower, begins!

name: Elemental Mark
description: Overly Clean Cut

name: Broken-off Branch
description: Seems it's been rotten for a long time.

name: Fabric Piece
description: Wonder who left it behind?

name: Breeze Amidst the Forest Supplement: The Dragon Tome
description: A supplement to the "Breeze Amidst the Forest" ballad selection with excerpts from various sources.\nIt tells the story of the Dragon of Mondstadt.

name: Letter from the Abyss Order
description: Seems to be a declaration of war from the Abyss Order to the "Darknight Hero." Many key phrases have been redacted.

name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (I)
description: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This is part one, which tells the story of the Land of Night and the Moonlight Forest.

name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (II)
description: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This installment tells of the meeting of the Pale Princess and the Light Prince.

name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (III)
description: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This installment tells of the Pale Princess and the Light Prince's decision to save the Moonlight Forest.

name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (IV)
description: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. Installment four describes the meeting between the Pale Princess, the Light Prince, and the Six Pygmies.

name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (V)
description: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. In this installment, the Six Pygmies' sinister scheme starts to unfold.

name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (VI)
description: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This installment tells of how the Six Pygmies managed to implement their nefarious plot.

name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (VII)
description: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. The final installment brings everything to a conclusion, and includes the Night Mother's prophecy.

name: 1000 Years of Loneliness
description: The beginning of the Springvale Hunter's tragic fantasy journey. Where did misfortune first befall him? What marks the start and finish of the 1000-year journey of loneliness? Let this first volume of 1000 Years of Loneliness be your guide through the fantastical fog that is the life of Gothson.

name: Teyvat Travel Guide - Mondstadt
description: A magazine by the Adventurers' Guild. Each issue introduces great sceneries across Teyvat. This issue includes a short traveling diary of Alice the Traveler on her experiences in Mondstadt.

name: Wind, Courage, and Wings
description: A book mistakenly taken by Amber... about fables?

name: Hunting Trap
description: Used to trap beasts of a certain size. If you pay attention in the wilds to collect them, you can make one like this. Set one down, and then conceal it carefully.

name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Qingce Village
description: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald, at a makeshift camp. It stills looks new, and smells like the fragrant herbs of Mt. Qingce.

name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Luhua Pool
description: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald, at a makeshift camp. It seems to have been dipped in water, with the watermark of a fox's footprint.

name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Yaoguang Shoal
description: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald. The pages smell like the sea breeze.

name: Letter for Dongdong
description: A letter treasured by Dongdong from Qingce Village. It seems to be a letter from his father.

name: Someone's Diary I: Yaoguang Shoal
description: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's unfortunate encounters at Yaoguang Shoal.

name: Scattered Page
description: (TEST) Adventure Journal Page

name: Intact Tome
description: (TEST) Adventure Journal

name: Hearty Mushrooms
description: Hardy common fungi. Can grow anywhere with the right amount of shade and moisture.

name: Crunchy Carrots
description: A healthy and nutritious vegetable that is crunchy and sweet to the taste. Easy to grow and harvest.

name: A Plump Cabbage
description: A layered, leafy vegetable. Said to have originally been an ornamental plant, it certainly looks great in the pot.

name: Gliding Instruction Manual
description: A guidebook for the ones new to using wind gliders. It also serves as a mandatory reading material to get a gliding license in Mondstadt. It contains all the necessary info any user must know.

name: Azurite
description: A piece of plaustrite dug up from the roots of a Bloatty Floatty. It has a rather unique color and is, perhaps, the Azurite that Wang'ya spoke of...

name: Vermillionite
description: A piece of plaustrite plucked from a Ruin Hunter. It has a rather unique color and is, perchance, the Vermillionite that Wang'ya mentioned...

name: Someone's Diary II: Guili Plains
description: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's unfortunate encounters at Guili Plains.

name: Someone's Diary III: Jueyun Karst
description: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's adventures at Jueyun Karst.

name: Someone's Diary IV: Liyue Harbor
description: A diary left behind by someone in Liyue that tells of the owner's adventures there.

name: Letter to the Treasure Hoarders
description: A letter written by someone to the Treasure Hoarders about some plans for the Lantern Rite...

name: Nephrite Ring
description: A Nephrite Ring obtained from a slime. Gorgeous color and clearly a top-quality item. This must be Mr. Zhu's lost property.

name: Delicious Golden Crab
description: Crab meat that's been rolled in flour, deep fried, and then pan fried together with ginger and garlic. When you finally plate up, the crab appears to be lying on gold.

name: "Of Mountains and Seas"
description: Notes penned by Leonard, an adventurer from the distant past. Clearly an ancient text, it has suffered much wear and tear. Most of the content has been lost to the ravages of time, with just a few fragments remaining.

name: Draft Manuscript of "Hyakunin Ikki: The Greatest Battle"
Fischl Dictionary: Die Neuauflage der Prinzessin
Wyatt's Red Key
description: A key to the warehouse's gates kept by Wyatt. The likeliness of him losing it is next to him losing his slim wallet.

name: Wyatt's Black Key
description: A key to the warehouse's gates kept by Wyatt. The likeliness of him losing it is next to him losing his slim wallet.

name: Coin Pouch
description: A small coin pouch of Mora that doesn't weigh much; you'd sometimes forget it's even there.

name: Meal Fee Pouch
description: A small coin pouch of Mora that contains payment for a meal ordered at the Good Hunter. Do not take your cut out of this bag.

name: Delicious Sticky Honey Roast
description: A meat dish in a sweet honey sauce. The warm honey draws out the flavor of the meat, creating a flavor explosion akin to bathing in the warm summer sun.
effect: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

name: Sturdy Plank
description: A sturdy plank. It feels heavy and reliable, and easy to apply to all sorts of scenarios.

name: Fragile Wooden Plank
description: A fragile wooden plank that is easily breakable. It doesn't serve much of a purpose aside from pretending that you're strong.

name: A Bundle of Ropes
description: A bundle of sturdy ropes long enough to temporarily hold certain things together for a time, however short it may be.
