name: Rather Fine Dandelion Seeds
description: Seeds of a Dandelion plucked from Starsnatch Cliff. Said to be of rather fine quality.

name: Rather Fine Windwheel Aster
description: A Windwheel Aster that grows near Windrise. Said to be of fine quality.

name: Special Beverage
description: A special beverage that has just been brewed. Who knows how it will taste...

name: Special Beverage
description: A special beverage that has just been brewed. Who knows how it will taste...

name: Hex & Hound (IX)
description: "What does the death of a warm spring day feel like?" So the young maiden said one morning, in defiance of all common logic. "I suppose it must feel... furry?"

name: Hex & Hound (X)
description: After all, none can live and still obtain release.

name: Hex & Hound (XI)
description: "I should just stuff that noisy puppy yapper of yours..." "Woof, woof!" That day, the young maiden gave her loyal dog something precious...

name: String of Pearls (IV)
description: To rescue the one he loves, the young man charges heedlessly into danger, entering the lair of the enemy with his sword drawn: and on the other side, his beloved hangs on desperately...

name: String of Pearls (V)
description: The bandit lair in the dead of night is pitch-dark. The tyrant, the youth, and the lady grope in the dark in search of one another, and there, a perilous misunderstanding is about to play out...

name: Handy Handbook of Hilichurlian
description: A handbook of Hilichurlian written by the folklorist Ella Musk, though its practical use has yet to be tested in the field.

description: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

description:
A special slip of paper that can illuminate one's fortune. Also known to a certain someone as "strips of paper."
You can only get one of these per day, which will cause the previous day's fortune slip to lose meaning and disappear.
They say that slips that portend ill luck such as "Misfortune" and "Great Misfortune" can be tied to the Fortune Slip Hanger as a prayer for a turnaround.
Regardless, "fate" and "destiny" are things best grasped and forged in one's own hands.

name: Strange Fortune Slip
description: A special slip that can only be obtained if you use a certain secret code while exchanging for a Fortune Slip. Indicates a target and the location where they will emerge.

name: Strange Fortune Slip
description: A special slip that can only be obtained if you use a certain secret code while exchanging for a Fortune Slip. Indicates a target and the location where they will emerge.

description: A special slip that can only be obtained if you use a certain secret code while exchanging for a Fortune Slip. Indicates a target and the location where they will emerge.

description: A special slip that can only be obtained if you use a certain secret code while exchanging for a Fortune Slip. Indicates a target and the location where they will emerge.

name: Picture of Cape Oath
description: A picture taken for Bea. It shows a scenic view of the beach at Cape Oath.

name: Picture of Starsnatch Cliff
description: A picture taken for Bea. It shows the night sky above Starsnatch Cliff.

name: Picture of Windrise
description: A picture taken for Bea. It shows the picturesque landscape of trees and water at Windrise.

name: Cyrus' Letter to Iris
description: This long letter makes one curious as to what Cyrus has written in it... But it's not very appropriate to peek at the private letters between a brother and sister, now is it?

name: Picture of Dragonspine
description: A picture taken for Iris. It depicts the snowy scenery of Dragonspine.

name: The Crux Clash Champion Medal
description: A medal awarded by the organizers of The Crux Clash. It is proof that you are the undisputed champion of this tournament. But it is not so much the duels you experienced that you will look back on — rather, it is the story of a Vision and the pursuit of ideals.

name: Well-Packaged Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut
description: A serving of Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut that has already been packed. A curious smell wafts from within.\nYou've heard that this is a hidden menu item that only long-time patrons know of and that the hoi polloi cannot appreciate its flavor — fair enough, you think...

name: Tea Break Pancake Cooked by Lily
description: The inner layers have not quite been pressed together to perfection, and it does taste a little burnt, but these are the best pancakes that Lily can make.

name: Mysterious Mechanical Part
description: A rarely seen device that seems to have some special purpose. Try fitting it into a suitable environment.

name: Pale Yellow Crystal
description: A crystal chunk that is pale yellow all over, beauteous as the swaying leaves of fall.

name: Pale Red Crystal
description: A crystal chunk that is pale red all over, lovely as spring blossoms.

name: Pale Blue Crystal
description: A crystal chunk that is pale blue all over, fair as the purest winter snow.

name: Pale Yellow Scale
description: A pale yellow scale obtained from a fish in the sea. Gazing upon it for a long time, you are reminded of autumn.

name: Pale Blue Scale
description: A pale blue scale obtained from a fish in the sea. Gazing upon it for a long time, you are reminded of winter.

name: Pale Red Scale
description: A pale red scale obtained from a fish in the sea. Gazing upon it for a long time, you are reminded of springtime.

name: Cat Food
description: Cat food obtained from Sara. You wonder what it might taste like...

name: Cat Toy
description: A cat toy obtained from Marjorie. Hopefully, the kittens will enjoy it.

name: Fresh Fish Scales
description: The fresh scales of a fish. One wonders what Diona might do with it...

name: Some Strange... Drink?
description: A newly mixed drink. It seems a little... odd?

name: Purse by the Dried-Up Well
description: A purse that you found beside the dry well in Konda Village.\nIt seems to have been left behind in a hurry, and has a special symbol printed on it.

name: Archaic Stone
description:
A rare ore mined from a deserted spot deep in the mountains.
This sort of ore can only be found in veins in the oldest mountains. Perhaps it is due to its extreme rarity, but many merchants haven't even so much as heard of this rock.
The ore itself has incredible clarity and its colors are dazzling, almost seeming to glow with an inner light that brings out its blue-violet beauty, which is like the distant and lovely sunset sky.
The few scholars who understand its value gave it a most straightforward name — "Archaic Stone."
If you intend to give it as a gift, it would be best to give it to one who recognizes what they're receiving.

name: Slightly Damaged Wooden Plank
description: A wooden plank that has taken some damage. Some words seem to be carved on it...

name: Somewhat Rotten Wooden Plank
description: A wooden plank that has partially rotted away. There seem to be some words carved on it...

name: Smaragdus Jadeite
description: A stone known as Smaragdus Jadeite. What will Madame Ping use it for?

name: Smaragdus Nephrite Fragment
description: A stone that Yanfei and Zhiqiao have adjudged to be Smaragdus Nephrite.

name: The Jade Mystery's Affidavit
description: A written affidavit from The Jade Mystery.

name: Ministry of Civil Affairs' Affidavit
description: The Ministry of Civil Affairs' filing documents, obtained from Mingxing Jewelry.

name: Bubu Pharmacy's Affidavit
description: A pharmacological certification from Bubu Pharmacy.

name: Fresh Slime Condensate
description: Slime condensate that you just obtained. Who knows what Diona might do with it...

name: Minacious Isle Mural
description: A mural that you found on a stone wall on Minacious Isle. It seems to depict a shipwreck...

name: Broken Isle Mural
description: A mural that you found on a stone wall on Broken Isle. It depicts five strange objects...

name: Nameless Island Mural
description: A mural that you found on a stone wall on the Nameless Island. It seems to depict a rescue...

name: Twinning Isle Mural
description: A mural that you found on a stone wall on Twinning Isle. The mountain in the mural bears a special mark...

name: Illegible Notes
description: These notes are illegible.

name: Fresh Fish
description: Fresh fish. What will Diona use it for, you wonder...

name: Ragged List of Goods
description: A list of goods found on a destroyed transport cart.\nBoth sun and rain have beaten down upon it such that most of its contents are impossible to discern. One thing alone remains clear — that this was once a Shogunate receipt for goods and the payments thereof.

name: Cargo Bag Fished Out From Water
description: A bag of cargo you discovered in the water while following the gully.\nIt seems to have been washed away.

name: Nameless Islet Mural
description: A mural that you found on a stone wall on the Nameless Islet. It seems to depict a group of people preparing to board a ship...

name: Clear Image
description: An image showing the state of the storage devices within the Mikage Furnace. Who knows what Xavier can glean from it...

name: Somewhat Clear Image
description: An image showing the lowest level of the Mikage Furnace. Who knows what Xavier can glean from it...

name: Rather Foggy Image
description: An image showing the area around the Mikage Furnace. Who knows what Xavier can glean from it...

name: A Discarded Blade
description: An old blade that has lost its luster due to a long-term lack of maintenance.

name: A Jug of Wine
description: An old jug containing wine. A rich scent emanates from it.

name: A Masterless Blade
description: A familiar old blade, stabbed into the battlefield in a skewed fashion.

name: Bag of Flower Seeds
description: A bag full of flower seeds. Question is, where to plant them?

name: Mysterious Conch
description: A conch, but there's something strange about it. What could it be for?
Konda Village Missing Person Notice

name: The Sage Aetolia Will Die Tomorrow
description: A fantasy novel. From the packaging, it seems that this book has used various setting intricacies to attract many readers...

name: The Honest Cat's Little Lie
description: A suspense novel. The packaging suggests that many readers were attracted by the unexpected twists and turns of the plot.

name: Literature Club
description: A traditional novel. The packaging states that this novel has a "rigorous plot and setting"...

name: Rust-Worn Key
description: An old key found at the bottom of the Konda Village well.\nIt is said that "where there's a key, there's a lock." Who knows where the lock for this key is...

name: Mask of Memories
description: Hanachirusato the shrine maiden used to wear this mask. It is deeply stained on the inside.\nSome memories are contained inside, through which one may learn the art of creating the Catalyst known as "Hakushin Ring."\nNow that Hanachirusato has been separated from this mask, Paimon doesn't get to call her the "Masked Maiden" anymore, right?

name: The Violet Oni's Blade
description: The favored sword of Yanagiha Arashi, an expelled member of the Iwakura School.\nIt is a leftover copy of a certain famous sword, and has been reforged after being broken. It and the weapon of Okazaki Toraemon are a pair.

name: The Crimson Oni's Blade
description: The favored sword of Okazaki Toraemon, an expelled member of the Iwakura School.\nIt is a leftover copy of a certain famous sword, and has been reforged after being broken. It and the weapon of Yanagiha Arashi are a pair.

name: Chang the Ninth's Gift
description: A gift from the Yae Publishing House to Chang the Ninth. There's even a letter on the inside.

name: Zhenyu's Gift
description: A gift from the Yae Publishing House to "Zhenyu." There's even a letter on the inside.

name: Cage Key
description: Seems to be the key to some prison cage. Some reckless person seems to have thrown it out here.

name: Metal Key
description: A metal key that one can find just about anywhere, and that can unlock a majority of ordinary doors... Well, probably, anyway.

name: Atsuko's Letter
description: A letter that Atsuko penned herself. It is filled with her yearning to see her parents again — with any luck, this long letter will bring her parents some peace of mind.

name: Illegible Fortune Slip
description: A fortune slip on which the wording has become all but illegible. But considering that it was chucked up to such a high spot, it can't have boded particularly well...

name: Damaged Note
description: A paper note that has been crumpled into a ball. A wish has been scribbled on it, but the only legible word now is "peace."

name: Luxurious Silk Cloth
description: A bolt of lovely silk. This is normally used to make high-end clothing.

name: Special Recipe: Mushroom Pizza
description: A handwritten Mushroom Pizza recipe. Perhaps food prepared using various different methods might result in a unique flavor.

name: Chef Mao's Special Jueyun Chili Chicken
description: Jueyun Chili Chicken specially made by Chef Mao. Seagrass and Sea Cucumber were added in the process, and one wonders how the result might taste...

name: Xiangling's Handwritten Notes
description: Xiangling's handwritten notes. It records some of her... novel ideas regarding cooking.

name: Yellowed Letter
description: A letter unearthed from beneath a tree in Konda Village. It seems to convey a certain person's hopes.

name: Vahid's Kneaded Onigiri
description: Onigiri made from rice cultivated personally by Vahid. It tastes as good as it looks.

name: Naganohara Fireworks Note
description: A note that Yoimiya gave you to record firework formulae with. If you give this note to Yoimiya, she will be able to make fireworks just as you remember them.\nNo matter how time passes, or people and things change, so long as you take care of this note, you will stand guard over a door to the past. Perhaps you too will find happiness that belongs only to you under a firework-filled sky.

name: Spirit Pearl
description: An ancient, vibrant pearl, within which lies the secret of the ocean depths.

name: Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep
description: A strange treasure with an awkward name. It is said to have been forged from the blood of Watatsumi Omikami.

name: Strange Bottle
description: A vessel with an odd appearance. It seems fragile, but is actually quite sturdy.

name: Water Welling With "Wishes"
description: This water is filled with hopes and dreams. Please send them to the place where they belong.

name: Spiritherb Water
description: Crystal-clear water, the ideal source of hydration for the Spiritherb.

name: Rinzou's Letter
description: A letter written by the legendary pirate Rinzou. The paper is all crumpled up. It must have been wet at some point.

name: Rinzou's Signet
description: A signet left behind by the great pirate Rinzou as proof of a glorious life of adventure.

name: Hidden Ledger
description: A ledger that seems to contain the recent taxation situations of Ritou's merchants. Its owner is Keijirou.

name: Komore Teahouse Invitation Letter
description: Whomsoever has this invitation letter may enter Komore Teahouse. It has the seal of the Yashiro Commission on it.

name: A Love Letter(?)
description: A letter that Hiiragi Chisato has written for Kujou Kamaji. She would be mad if you opened it up without her permission...

name: Cooked Meat
description: Meat that has just been cooked. Maybe it can be used in a dish...

name: "The Seventh Samurai" Script
description: A "film script" you obtained from Xavier.

name: A Note Left by Someone
description: A special fortune slip that a certain person left behind. A certain location is recorded within. This may have something to do with Gendou Ringo's disappearance.

name: Bamboo Slip
description: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

description: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

name: Bamboo Slip
description: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

name: Lightly-Perfumed Letter
description: You obtained this from an infantryman at the Kanjou Commission. They say that this was written personally by the young lady of the Hiiragi Clan.

name: Travel Permit
description: A special Travel Permit that allows travel throughout Inazuma. With this in hand, you can now freely enter and leave Ritou...

name: Kujou Kamaji's Letter
description: Kujou Kamaji asked you to carry this letter that he personally penned to Hiiragi Chisato. According to him, this one was the best-worded of the lot.

name: Snack Box
description: A box of snacks that Kujou Kamaji request you bring to Hiiragi Chisato. It seems very full indeed...

name: Dull Golden Bridle
description: The hereditary national treasure of Byakuyakoku, but it has lost all of its own power. This was done to prevent thieves who have entered through alternative means from seeing its value.

name: Golden Bridle
description: The hereditary national treasure of Byakuyakoku. It represents the highest authority in the land and confers the power to control Evernight and Whitenight upon its wielder.

name: Reins of Revival Fragment (The Narrows)
description: A fragment of the Reins of Revival. It is made from a special material.

name: Reins of Revival Fragment (Temple)
description: A fragment of the Reins of Revival. It has some special power.

name: Reins of Revival Fragment (Serpent's Heart)
description: A fragment of the Reins of Revival. The three fragments, too, follow "The Rule of Three."

name: Reins of Revival
description: The hereditary national treasure of Byakuyakoku. Apart from representing the highest authority in the land, it also confers the ability to control souls and this realm.

name: Offerings of The Narrows
description: Offerings from The Narrows that contain a fraction of Aberaku's remnant thoughts.

name: Offerings of the Temple
description: Offerings from the Evernight Temple that contain a fraction of Aberaku's remnant thoughts.

name: Offerings of the Serpent's Heart
description: Offerings from the Serpent's Heart that contain a fraction of Aberaku's remnant thoughts.

name: The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku
description: A novel based on Watatsumi Island's folktales. The original edition of this text was transcribed on Watatsumi Island and brought back to Narukami Island by a merchant while the former's serpent god yet lived. No one reads this ancient tome nowadays, its role supplanted by all the light novels on the market. This book describes the unique cosmological outlook of the Watatsumi people before they came to adopt aspects of Narukami culture, and a recent resurgence in traditional novel publishing has allowed it to see the light of day once more.

name: Bathysmal Vishap Experimental Records
description: Experimental Records of the Bathysmal Vishaps. No vishaps were killed in the writing of these records.

name: Before Sun and Moon
description: A chronicle that ordinary folk have been forbidden to read. The writing is a mix of fables and histories from the beginning of the world to the creation of the Dainichi Mikoshi.

name: Hydrological Studies in Byakuyakoku
description: This text records the geography and hydrology of Byakuyakoku. With the sealing of the depths and the emigration of the people of Watatsumi, as well as the passing of long years, this book is now useless.

name: In the Light, Beneath the Shadow
description: A puzzle book for children of ages nine to twelve. As a book from a transitory period, it uses Narukami-style names with Byakuyakoku subscripts.

name: Key Sigil
description: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. Such pictures are used in unlocking, and are thus named "Key Sigils."

name: Key Sigil
description: A Key Sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. It was made by disassembling the emblems of the once-upon-a-time people of Byakuyakoku.

name: Key Sigil
description: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. Each of the five Key Sigils is unique in its structure.

name: Key Sigil
description: A Key Sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. When people left the ocean depths, they combined various Key Sigils to create the Sangonomiya house emblem.

name: Key Sigil
description: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. It conceals some secret.

name: Bloodbranch Coral
description: A coral in which the life force of Watatsumi Omikami dwells. It is a vital part of the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri.

name: Divine Bridle
description: A symbol of the Sunchild's authority, made in the shape of a bridle. It does not possess any special power by itself.

name: Date's Medal of Recognition
description: A medal that represents Date's recognition. It is very well-made.

name: Date's Medal of Recognition
description: A medal representing Date's recognition. It is very well-made. If you look at it long enough, the labyrinth-wanderlust might actually overtake you!

name: Secret Room Key
description: A key that opens the door to a certain secret room in The Narrows. This might be one of the abandoned safehouses that Adonis and his compatriots once used.

name: Waters of Lethe
description: Water from a river that flows near the Evernight Temple. It shines with a faint light in the darkness. Directly ingesting this liquid will not cause you to forget anything, but the Dragonbone Orb created through its auspices has this effect.

name: Dragonbone Orb
description: The fruit of the Dragonbone Flower, created via the use of the Waters of Lethe. It is said to sweep one's worries away and bring peace. Giving up your objectives, forsaking desire, and becoming content and satisfied... Is that not happiness?

name: Key to Some Place
description: A key found in Tatarasuna.\nWhere there's a key, there's got to be a lock to match.

name: Key to Some Place
description: A key found in Tatarasuna.\nWhere there's a key, there's got to be a lock to match.

name: Key to Some Place
description: A key found in Tatarasuna.\nWhere there's a key, there's got to be a lock to match.

name: Sun-Dried Sweet Flower
description: A dried flower from Hanayama Kaoru. It was the first flower to grow in that brand-new floral sea.

name: Peculiar Pinion
description: A strange feather you discovered after defeating the monster on the summit of Amakumo Peak.

name: Maushiro
description: An item that Sumida tasked you to find.\nYou found this Maushiro on Tsurumi Island, and it seems to be a traditional instrument around these parts.\nThat said, it should have been at least a few thousand years since Tsurumi Island last played host to any civilization at all.

name: Maushiro
description: The item that Sumida sent you to find.\nThis Maushiro appears to have been left behind by someone before they left Tsurumi Island.\nAccording to what Ruu tells you, the Maushiro are not musical instruments. Instead, they were used by the locals as a means of locating one another amidst the fog that shrouded their home.

name: An Onikabuto Affected by Tatarigami
description: An onikabuto that has fallen under the influence of Tatarigami. Who knows what sort of tests Xavier wants to put it through...

name: Missing Component(s)
description: A component that fell from the Purification Device.

name: Funerary Mask
description:
A trophy obtained from defeating Signora, Eighth of the Fatui Harbingers.
The Fatui often face the world from behind their masks, and it is said that this is because all they once were will mean nothing once they become Fatui, and thus must they forsake their true names and faces alike.

—Yet the act of giving up all that makes up an "I" — one's past and the bonds that come with it — is no mean feat.
Perhaps it is fair to say that only those who possess an obsession close to or even exceeding the level of delusion might be willing to join this group that so rebels against the Heavenly Principles, binding their remaining days to their Delusions and burning as brightly as stars.
...Of course, many within the Fatui are simply consumed by power and are simple sadists — nor are these states necessarily in conflict.

The woman whose real name was Rosalyne-Kruzchka Lohefalter may have once led a more innocent, naive existence.
But that was before her eyes were filled with a raging fire, and her innocent days were burned away. Before the icy Delusion extinguished the flaming tongues that ever gnawed her. Before the frozen might that protected her was shattered by the eternal outlander, unbound yet no less determined than she was, causing the flames to burst forth once more...

name: Musoujin Gorge: Rock Pillar Pearl
description: A precious pearl that emits Electro energy and a strangely-colored light. It seems to have some connection with the rock pillars on the island.

name: Musoujin Gorge: Rock Pillar Warding Stone
description: A gem that has an electric scent and that is quite shocking to the touch. It has some unknown connection to the rock pillars on the island.

name: Serpent's Head: Rock Pillar Pearl
description: A precious pearl that emits Electro energy and a strangely-colored light. It seems to have some connection with the rock pillars on the island.

name: Serpent's Head: Rock Pillar Warding Stone
description: A gem that has an electric scent and that is quite shocking to the touch. It has some unknown connection to the rock pillars on the island.

name: Jakotsu Mine: Rock Pillar Pearl
description: A precious pearl that emits Electro energy and a strangely-colored light. It seems to have some connection with the rock pillars on the island.

name: Jakotsu Mine: Rock Pillar Warding Stone
description: A gem that has an electric scent and that is quite shocking to the touch. It has some unknown connection to the rock pillars on the island.

name: Fort Mumei: Rock Pillar Pearl
description: A precious pearl that emits Electro energy and a strangely-colored light. It seems to have some connection with the rock pillars on the island.

name: Fort Mumei: Rock Pillar Warding Stone
description: A gem that has an electric scent and that is quite shocking to the touch. It has some unknown connection to the rock pillars on the island.

name: Naku Weed Seed
description: A bag of Naku Weed seeds.

name: High-Quality Chilled Meat
description: Chilled Meat that appears to be of high quality. It should make for some good cooking indeed.

name: Piping-Hot Braised Meat
description: Braised Meat made using the Supreme Cuisine Machine. Fresh and steaming hot.

name: Family Letter
description: The page has already yellowed and become incredibly brittle. A single touch might break it.

name: Tattered Letter
description: Someone's private thoughts are written in this tattered letter. Unfortunately, the years have eaten away at the words that were penned until they became blurred, and if not for someone having dug it up, these past events may have forever slept under the soil.

name: Pharmacist's Notebook (I)
description: Notes left by Yasumoto. They still smell strongly of Naku Weed.

name: Pharmacist's Notebook (II)
description: Notes left by Yasumoto. It has been conscientiously protected from rain damage.

name: Pharmacist's Notebook (III)
description: Notes left by Yasumoto. It shows some signs of blotching and water damage.

name: Unsealed Letter
description: A letter that seems brand new but that has already been opened. It gives off a light sakura scent.

name: Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou's Final Words
description: A letter filled with words from margin to margin. Its author has gone missing.

name: Star-Shaped Gem
description: A mysterious gem of unknown make. It shines like a star even when placed inside your backpack.\nPerhaps this is the key to completing a certain "image."

name: Stone Slate
description: A stone slate with Ishine Script carved into it.\nPerhaps it may be of some use on Tsurumi Island...?

name: Kamuijima Cannon Map
description: A map that records the positions of the Kamuijima Cannons.

name: High-Quality Rice
description: High-quality rice that you obtained from Brunn. It looks like it'll cook well.

name: Fragrant Rice Pudding
description: Rice Pudding made using the Supreme Cuisine Machine. One wonders how it might taste...

name: Anemo Slime-Swallowed Bamboo Shoots
description: Bamboo Shoots that have been swallowed by Anemo Slimes. Who knows what special flavor they might add...

name: Piping-Hot Oncidium Tofu
description: Oncidium Tofu made using the Supreme Cuisine Machine. One wonders what flavors this is going to have...

name: Fossil Bag
description: A bag containing the suspected fossil of the Lunar Leviathan. Give it to Kujirai Momiji... though one wonders if she can accept this reality.

name: "Treasury" Key
description: A key treasured by the bandits. This must be one of the keys to finding the secret treasure... right?

name: Incomplete Notes
description: A tattered page. For some reason, it gives off the stench of stale grain.

name: Tattered Paper
description: A crumpled note with very messy, illegible handwriting.

name: Picture Commemorating Seirai Island
description: A picture of some place on Seirai Island. Who knows why it would be buried here...

name: Picture Commemorating Seirai Island (II)
description: A picture you got from Mr. Oda Tarou, it seems to show some place on Seirai Island...

name: Picture Commemorating Seirai Island (III)
description: A picture you got from Mr. Oda Tarou, it seems to show some place on Seirai Island...

name: Picture Commemorating Seirai Island (IV)
description: A picture you got from Mr. Oda Tarou, it seems to show some place on Seirai Island...

name: Fujiwara Toshiko's Treasure Map
description: A treasure map you obtained from Fujiwara Toshiko. According to her, this map hides the means by which certain mechanisms may be activated.

name: A Bag of Beans
description: Beans you got from Sango. Arataki Itto seems to be allergic to beans, so these may prove to be useful tools in stopping him from resisting too much.\nSango says they're not free, though. Hopefully they don't cost too much...

name: Right-Side Photo
description: A picture of Neko, taken from the right.

name: Left-Side Photo
description: A picture of Neko, taken from the left.

name: Inferior Starsilver
description: Starsilver with low luster and dull coloration. It will most likely not sell for a high price.

name: Quality Starsilver
description: Starsilver with great luster and a lovely coloration.

name: Key
description: A unique-looking key. You can open the cage holding Bennett with it.

name: Box of Clothes
description: This box contains the clothes that Ningguang asked you to go get. As she said, "I need a change of mood, and a change of clothes will facilitate that."

name: Iron Chunk
description: This iron chunk can be turned into a multitude of handy items in the hands of a skilled craftsman.

name: White Iron Chunk
description: Skilled hands can make this into something brilliant.

name: Crystal Chunk
description: An uncut crystal. Only professional craftsmanship can bring out its true value.

name: Magical Crystal Chunk
description: These crystal chunks can be refined into Weapon EXP materials by using Original Resin.\nCrystals from mines that were eroded by the energy of the Ley Lines cannot be processed by ordinary means.

name: Scarlet Quartz
description: Scarlet Quartz
effect: Increases the Dragon Blood Buff

name: Starsilver
description: A rare and precious ore formed by the unique geographical conditions and Ley Lines of Dragonspine.

name: Scarlet Quartz
description: Scarlet Quartz (Dragonspine Event)
effect: Increases the Dragon Blood Buff

name: Amethyst Lump
description: An uncut crystal that can only be found in Inazuma. Some professional craftsmanship will bring out its true value.

name: Condessence Crystal
description: A bright and clear crystal with a core that is both tough and malleable.

name: Rainbowdrop Crystal
description: A crystal that gives off an iridescent glow. Exceptionally tough and malleable, it has been regarded by Snezhnayan craftspeople as the best forging material since ancient times.\nIt is believed that when the moon's chariot was shattered, its blood-stained axle-tip fell into the earthly realm beneath the moon, transforming into an iridescent crystal. From that day on, the people of this land no longer worshipped the dead gods. The survivors who knew what the monarchs of the night died for, however, still futilely sing those long-forgotten names.

name: Northlander Sword Billet
description: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star swords. \nPhilosophers believe marble has the potential to be sculpted into a beautiful statue. Likewise, these billets have the potential to become something greater.

name: Northlander Bow Billet
description: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star bows. \nPhilosophers believe marble has the potential to be sculpted into a beautiful statue. Likewise, these billets have the potential to become something greater.

name: Northlander Claymore Billet
description: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star claymores. \nPhilosophers believe marble has the potential to be sculpted into a beautiful statue. Likewise, these billets have the potential to become something greater.

name: Northlander Catalyst Billet
description: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star catalysts. \nPhilosophers believe marble has the potential to be sculpted into a beautiful statue. Likewise, these billets have the potential to become something greater.

name: Northlander Polearm Billet
description: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star polearms. \nPhilosophers believe marble has the potential to be sculpted into a beautiful statue. Likewise, these billets have the potential to become something greater.

name: Northlander Sword
description: An unknown sword from the Northlands

name: Northlander Bow
description: An unknown bow from the Northlands

name: Northlander Claymore
description: An unknown claymore from the Northlands

name: Northlander Catalyst
description: An unknown catalyst from the Northlands

name: Northlander Polearm
description: Unknown Northlander Polearm

name: Midlander Sword Billet
description: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star swords.\nPhilosophers believe that there are four purposes behind earthly things. The purpose of these billets is to become a weapon worthy of accompanying a hero.

description: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star bows.\nPhilosophers believe that there are four purposes behind earthly things. The purpose of these billets is to become a weapon worthy of accompanying a hero.

Can be used to forge 4-star swords.\nIn terms of the "state" of the many weapons that can be crafted from billets, while their potential has long been contained within the original materials, the exact forms these weapons will ultimately take remain unknown to this day...

name: Onikabuto
description: A strange beetle that inhabits areas rich with Electro energy. Its docile and sedentary temperament could not be more different from the fierce, demonic visage displayed on its armored shell.

name: Sakura Bloom
description: Blossoms from the Sacred Sakura at the Grand Narukami Shrine, filled with a fondness for Inazuma.

name: Crystal Marrow
description: A crystal that contains a sliver of Tatarigami power. Adding this material during smelting will greatly increase the strength and toughness of metals.

name: Dendrobium
description: A vibrant plant that has also been named the "lycoris" by the poets. It was once thought extinct in the Inazuman archipelago, only to re-emerge now upon the battlefields. It is said that it blooms most enchantingly where much blood was spilled.

name: Naku Weed
description: Even on windless days, this plant will tremble lightly amid the cries of thunder. The parts of it that resemble petals are in fact extensions of the leaves meant to protect the fragile flower.

name: Sea Ganoderma
description: A plant species that only grows in certain regions and islands of the ocean. Though it looks like a fungus of some sort, it actually comes from a substance secreted by certain soft-bodied organisms.

name: Sango Pearl
description: A precious pearl that grows in the coral of Watatsumi. Gives off a cool sheen like that of the moonlight.

name: Amakumo Fruit
description: The fruit of the Amakumo Grass, which grows on Seirai Island. You can hear it crackling with a tiny current if you hold it up to your ear.

name: Fluorescent Fungus
description: A mushroom that glows like a night-light. Some curious power lies hidden within it.

name: Seagrass
description: A plant that grows in shallow seas. It adds a unique flavor to dishes.

name: Lavender Melon
description: A brightly-colored fruit. The flesh within transforms into food with a unique mouthfeel when cooked.

name: Starshroom
description: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It is quite hardy indeed. Once it matures, the center of the cap will split open.
effect: Restores 300 HP for the selected character.

name: Rukkhashava Mushrooms
description: A fungus that grows in layers upon layers, like a sea of clouds, and which mostly grows on trees deep in the rainforest.

name: Padisarah
description: A holy and noble plant. The conditions for growth in its environment are very demanding. The flower buds can be processed to make valuable spices.

name: Nilotpala Lotus
description: Growing in the forest wetlands, these plants only bloom at night with flowers as bright as the moon.

name: Harra Fruit
description: Commonly grown in the hot and humid rainforest, this fruit has a special spicy aroma. When ground to powder, spices can be made from it. It is the most valued spice plant in Sumeru.

name: Kalpalata Lotus
description: Flowers from vines that grow on cliff sides. It is called a lotus only because it has a similar appearance to one. Aside from that, it bears no other similar properties to the lotus.

name: Zaytun Peach
description: The fruit of a forest shrub. Its flesh is firm and sweet. It is said to have a calming effect on the mind.

name: Sumeru Rose
description: Bright and beautiful, these pure purple flowers give off a pleasant fragrance that will give any passerby pause. While some like to call this a type of "rambler rose," its relative lack of multiple flowers means that it falls under a different floral classification.

name: Henna Berry
description: A fruit that grows even in the most hostile of desert environments. Its vibrant crimson fruits are made even more lovely against a backdrop of yellow sand.

name: Ajilenakh Nut
description: A fruit that grows on evergreen trees within desert oases. The flesh under the tough skin is thick, sweet, and delicious, making it an important food source amongst the desert peoples.

name: Sand Grease Pupa
description: You can only find such husks deep in the desert where the Quicksand Eels breed. The hardened shell is meant to protect the Quicksand Eels' larval bodies until they finally acclimate to the conditions of the dry desert.

name: Mourning Flower
description: Crimson flowers that bloom on ancient battlefields. They can even flourish in the depths of the desert. Their drooping flowers seem to be in mourning for heroes long past.

name: Trishiraite
description: A splendorous stone that can be found in the depths of desolate mountains, seemingly formed from congealed elemental energy.

name: Scarab
description: A tenacious beetle that finds repose within the vast ocean of desert sand. The golden pattern on such beetles' shells hints at some deep relationship between them and the ancient ruins that dot the desert.

name: Activated Starshroom
description: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It seems to be bursting with vitality.
effect: Restores 800 HP for the selected character.

name: Scorched Starshroom
description: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It seems to be a little singed.
effect: Restores 1 HP for the selected character.

name: Viparyas
description: A flower without seeds. \nOnce the earth remembers, the Viparyas will bloom.

name: Pluie Lotus
description: A plant that grows in environments rich with Hydro. This plant can be found everywhere in Fontaine after its long rainy seasons. The plant is named "Pluie" — which means "rain" in the local tongue — for that reason.

name: Bulle Fruit
description: A fruit that grows in warm and damp environments with ample sunlight. Inside this round and rotund fruit hides a sweet and refreshing surprise.
effect: Restores 300 HP for the selected character.

name: Marcotte
description: A pink flower with a pearl-like luster and rich scent profile. It is one of the most important ingredients in a perfumer's arsenal.

name: Beryl Conch
description: A conch-like structure that gives off a faint glow. Despite the name, it is not a shell but something condensed from pure elemental energy.

name: Romaritime Flower
description: An ethereal and elegant blue flower. Its tender petals are elastic and water-absorbent, making it the ideal raw material for various daily necessities.

name: Tidalga
description: An algae floating with the tides that sustains itself by feeding on substances produced by other plants. Though often mistaken for zooplankton, based on its nature, Tidalga is actually a type of phytoplankton.

name: Lumidouce Bell
description: A serene and tranquil violet flower. It has a light, soft, and lasting scent and is often used for making luxurious perfumes.

name: Rainbow Rose
description: A delicate and tender pink flower. Despite their name, Rainbow Roses are essentially more akin to Lilies.

name: Lumitoile
description: A soft-bodied animal that emits a gentle light. Often found climbing the walls of buildings near the water or underwater.

name: Lakelight Lily
description: A clear and clean azure flower, it is born where Water Veins come together. It has a simple, cool, and elegant fragrance, pungent and refreshing yet gentle.

name: Subdetection Unit
description: Detection units produced by Fontaine Research Institute using new models of artificed components. Its original purpose was monitoring all kinds of environmental data.

name: Spring of the First Dewdrop
description: A limpid drop of dew floating amidst the waters of Morte Region. It is different from other pure water bodies, as though it is a conglomeration of even more pure and primordial Elemental Energy.

name: Clearwater Jade
description: Jade from Chenyu Vale. Named for its cool, refreshing touch, that is much like clear water.

name: Chenyu Adeptea
description: Tea grown in warm, moist areas in Chenyu Vale. After millennia of careful cultivation, the tea today emits a rich fragrance that can be savored from several streets away.

name: Grainfruit
description: This plant is named after the giant grains that grow along the cob.

name: Candlecap Mushroom
description: A fungus that grows on cliff faces or at the foot of mountains, and which shines like a little lamp. You can feel a hint of warmth when your hand draws close.
effect: Restores 300 HP for the selected character.

name: Spinel Fruit
description: The crystalline trees that grow widely in areas with Liquid Phlogiston produce these gem-shaped fruits after absorbing phlogiston.

name: Cacahuatl
description: A crop rich in flavor. The fleshy part itself features a unique bitterness and its seeds, after being fermented and baked, can be made into other delicacies.

name: Sprayfeather Gill
description: A special feather-shaped species that grows by the seaside. It looks kind of like a seagrass but is in truth a soft-bodied aquatic coral with a unique shape.

name: Brilliant Chrysanthemum
description: A flower with a shape like floating wings. Its petals sway in an unbelievably relaxed, serene manner as they are caressed by the wind.

name: Quenepa Berry
description: Bluish, juicy berries that grow in large amounts near the Scions of the Canopy. Their shape is similar to that of Flamegranates.

name: Saurian Claw Succulent
description: A succulent shaped like the paw of a great animal.

name: Embercore Flower
description: A strange flower that can be found all over the plains and highlands. Mature buds will bloom after being hit.

name: Glowing Hornshroom
description: A fungus that emits a faint light in the darkness. It is so named because its shape resembles the horny crest of an Iktomisaurus.

name: Withering Purpurbloom
description: A flower, the leaves and petals of which look scorched and withered, that can often be seen in places where ash abounds.

name: Skysplit Gembloom
description: A strange plant whose flower's exterior resembles stone. Only in bloom does it reveal a resplendent, crystal-like core.

name: Dracolite
description: Formed gradually in areas rich in Phlogiston, these red, scale-like crystals are blazing-hot to the touch.

name: Red Berryshroom
description: An ordinary-looking mushroom with an extraordinary flavor. Only grows near the orchard at Varesa's house. Since Paimon gave it a cute name, its taste must have been truly memorable for her.

name: Portable Bearing
description: A portable bearing of a type that was mass-produced after the Fatui moved into Nod-Krai. Excessively worn units are discarded like obsolete personnel.\nA few of them have a vestige of kuuvahki left inside. As they are difficult to imitate, they are occasionally used as currency by merchants in Nasha Town.\nIt's said that people tried to forge these bearings for that reason, but went bankrupt in the end because the cost of forging them was higher than their market value.

name: Icy Pebble
description: A pebble commonly found on Nod-Krai's coasts, characterized by a naturally occurring hollow. Touching it sends a faint chill through your finger.\nAccording to ancient legends, the hollows in these pebbles were once shelters revealed to the fae by the Frost Moon — gateways to the ethereal. In another story popular in Nasha Town, the legendary thief, Reed Miller, was surrounded when a runestone given to him by a holy lady of the Frost Moon as a token of her love allowed him to conceal himself and escape his pursuers. Naturally, the Frostmoon Scions vehemently reject this claim, as these pebbles do not display any such magical properties.

name: Frostlamp Flower
description: A flower that resembles a candle lamp, commonly found near water. It emits a cold, simple aroma that has a calming effect.\nThe contrasting colors of its stamen and stem are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, yet despite this symbolism, it is one of the few rare plants that are immune to kuuvahki's influence. As a result, the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as a symbol of faithlessness and apostasy.\nIt is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared at the end of the dark calamity five hundred years ago, but this claim has never been rigorously verified.

name: Nocturnal Blossom
description: A flower in two entwined colors with a strong affinity for kuuvahki. Its light fragrance and conspicuous color have made it an excellent natural dye.\nIts contrasting colors are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, so the followers of the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as the Moon Maiden's blessing.\nIt is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared decades after the dark calamity ended five hundred years ago, a claim widely reflected in the verses of the Frostmoon Scions, though it has never been rigorously verified.

name: Moonfall Silver
description: A silver crystal as pure and pristine as moonlight. It possesses almost perfect elemental affinity.\nIn the legacy of the Frostmoon Scions, these crystals were born five hundred years ago alongside the Moon Maiden, and were believed by the Moonchanter at the time to be a gift from the moon, hence the name "Moonfall Silver". However, in older documents written by Snezhnayan chroniclers, the descendants of the golden realm were already using secret silver woven by the Frostmoon thousands of years in the past. The threads that connect these two tales are unclear — the only certain thing is that these crystals make excellent elemental conductors in the eyes of Nod-Krai's craftspeople.

name: Lakkaberry
description: A fruit as white as pearl that tastes refreshingly sweet.\nIn the legends of the Frostmoon Scions, these fruits, like kuuhenki, are a gift from the Moon Maiden, a sacred symbol blessed by the new moon. Therefore, sharing and eating delicious Lakkaberries is also a form of worshipping Kuutar.\nEven when not associated with the divine, their plumpness and sweetness alone are enough to awaken one's appetite.

name: Midsommar Berry
description: A fruit that grows in the warmer parts of Nod-Krai. It is beloved by animals emerging from winter and hungry children alike.\nIn the legacy of the Frostmoon Scions, Midsommar Berries are regarded as a symbol of life and abundance, for they only flourish during the warmth of spring and summer.\nThere is a tale that tells of the endless struggle between the King of Winter Icelea and the King of Midsommar Oak — twin monarchs that slay each other as the seasons change, returning from the underworld to rule in turn until the end of time. Most Snezhnayan scholars dismiss this as a primitive religious metaphor for the alternating seasons — or at least that's what they tell themselves.

name: Winter Icelea
description: A hardy plant known for withstanding relentless wind and frost, it survives even in the coldest depths of winter.

name: Pine Amber
description: A gem formed from the resin of the towering ancient trees that once blanketed Nod-Krai. Over ages, the resin hardened into crystalline amber, now shining with vivid, radiant hues.

name: Teardrop of the Moon
description: A clear, radiant azure crystal that holds an exceptionally pure form of kuuvahki. It possesses a near-perfect affinity with all types of elemental energy.

name: Windrest Flower
description: An exquisite flower that remains delicate and fresh, found primarily in the northern part of Mondstadt.\nIts fragrance is clear and enduring, making it one of the primary ingredients used in perfumery.

name: Etherwing Moth
description: A singular entity bathed in a divine, golden radiance, drifting through uncanny interstices as if a moth in flight.

name: Birch Wood
description: Timber obtained from birches. It is easy to work with and produces smooth cuts. Furniture made using such wood is both beautiful and durable.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Cuihua Wood
description: Timber obtained from Cuihua Trees. With its lovely color and unique make, it will surely be able to take on myriad uses upon undergoing suitable workmanship.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Pine Wood
description: Timber obtained from pines. Its color and grain are nothing to write home about, but its unpretentious nature is elegant in its own right. The wood is very sturdy as well. In able hands, its products should be able to resist moth and rot alike.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Sandbearer Wood
description: Timber from the Sandbearer Tree. Said to be an exceptionally hardy plant resistant to wind and rain with a long lifespan.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Bamboo Segment
description: Segments of bamboo that are light and far stronger than their humble appearance might suggest. It lets off a light fragrance.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Fragrant Cedar Wood
description: Wood from the Cedar tree. Also known as the "Fragrant Cedar" for the aromatic oils it contains.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Fir Wood
description: Wood from the tree known as "Faber's Fir." Widely used for its fine quality and attractive grain.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Yumemiru Wood
description: Timber obtained from Sakura Trees. Exquisite in quality and full of moisture, people say that it can lull people into dreams as sweet as the warm spring.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Maple Wood
description: Timber from the Amur Maple. Excellent quality wood with a fine color and texture.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Aralia Wood
description: Wood from the Inazuman Cedar. It is soft, has straight veins, and gives off a light fragrance.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Otogi Wood
description: Wood from the Otogi Tree. It has just the right amount of moisture and oil, and as such has a great many uses.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Brightwood
description: Timber from the Brightwood Tree. It seems to have different properties from ordinary wood — soft but extremely resilient, easy to dye, and can be used for special purposes. \nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Karmaphala Wood
description: The wood of the Karmaphala Tree. One can easily get a nice, smooth surface while working on this material and obtain a rather eye-pleasing result without going through any sophisticated processes.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Adhigama Wood
description: The wood of the Adhigama Tree. Can be found everywhere and therefore appears rather ordinary, but the wood is durable and easy to handle.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Mountain Date Wood
description: Wood of the Mountain Date Tree. Although it neither feels special to touch nor possesses a special texture, it retains water exceedingly well and is thus easy to grow.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Athel Wood
description: Wood of the Athel Tree. It has a special texture and is resilient to both drought and humidity, making it very durable.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Mallow Wood
description: Wood from the Mallow Tree. With a tough core, it is suitable for building the foundations and frames of houses. It is easy to craft and process, so it takes relatively less manual labor to produce beautiful furniture.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Linden Wood
description: Wood from the Linden Tree. With a smooth texture and light color, few wood chips are produced even during fine processing. Often carved into delicate handicrafts or used to make compact parts for wooden mechanisms.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Ash Wood
description: Wood from the Ash Tree. With its extremely high strength, it is not only used for making strong load-bearing components, but also for making sheets to be used as wall reinforcements, and for transportation crates subject to frequent shocks.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Cypress Wood
description: Wood from the Cypress Tree. The core has a relatively large radius, with thinner sapwood. Though not solid or reliable as metal, the wood possesses unique advantages for buildings components with a large surface area.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Torch Wood
description: Wood from the Torch Tree. It has a soft texture, can be easily cut, stays dry easily, and the color is compatible with many bright paints. This makes it a common choice for artisans making delicate decorations.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: White Chestnut Oak Wood
description: Timber obtained from White Chestnut Oak Trees. It strikes a balance between hardness and toughness, making it easy to process. Though it appears no different from most other wood, its color grows lighter once processed using methods common to the tribes of Natlan, becoming nearly white, hence the name.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Ashen Aratiku Wood
description: Timber obtained from Ashen Aratiku Trees. Other than being lighter, it isn't all that different from most regional trees in Natlan. Mature Saurian companions can carry it with ease, and some legends even tell of tribal warriors who use bundles of such timber as fitness gear.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Flammabomb Wood
description: Timber obtained from Flammabomb trees. Unlike what their names suggest, such timber is resistant to catching fire or exploding once processed using methods recommended by the Collective of Plenty.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Peach Palm Wood
description: Timber from Peach Palm Trees. As the name suggests, the bark has the feel of coconut palm husks, and is both smooth and aesthetically pleasing once sanded and polished, with exceptional hardness and humidity-resistant qualities...\nCan be used to create furnishings.

name: Silver Fir Wood
description: Wood harvested from the Silver Fir Tree. Humans have favored this type of wood since ancient times for its wide range of uses, from crafting barrels to constructing frameworks.

name: Hazelnut Wood
description: Wood sourced from the Hazelnut Tree. Though the subspecies this wood comes from vary wildly in appearance, they mostly share the same unique compounds that offer excellent resistance to insects and decay, making it a remarkably durable material.

name: Pedunculate Oak Wood
description: Wood sourced from the Pedunculate Oak Tree. While its density is relatively low, it boasts impressive toughness and water resistance, making it a common choice for buildings near bodies of water.

name: Alder Wood
description: Wood from the Alder Tree. It demonstrates considerable resistance to moisture and cold, making it a fine raw material for both furniture and musical instruments.

name: Fabric
description: Some fabric of fine make. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

name: Red Dye
description: Red dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

name: Yellow Dye
description: Yellow dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

name: Blue Dye
description: Blue dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

name: Torn Page: Toki Alley Tales (Prologue)
description:
Collect all 10 pages to form Toki Alley Tales (Prologue).

This page billows about in the breeze, seemingly having dropped from a very old novel.
Perhaps you might be able to reconstruct the complete text, should you find other torn pages elsewhere.

name: Torn Page: Toki Alley Tales (I)
description:
Collect all 10 pages to form Toki Alley Tales (I).

This page billows about in the breeze, seemingly having dropped from a very old novel.
Perhaps you might be able to reconstruct the complete text, should you find other torn pages elsewhere.

name: Toki Alley Tales (Prologue)
description: They say that in the past, when the fragile and short-lived mortals had yet to cross over the sea unto these lands, Inazuma was once a land that belonged to the tanuki. They say, too, that human history began as drunken tanuki nonsense... Welcome to Toki Alley, a place where history and wild tales intertwine.

name: Toki Alley Tales (I)
description: The great tengu are naught but brutal braggarts, and especially when drunk! — Tanuki Historical Commentary

name: Toki Alley Tales (II)
description: Mother once warned that a beautiful face can hide deceptive intentions. If she looks as lovely as the moonlight, she must either be a fox spirit, or some old bake-neko hag of significant power — Tanuki Historical Commentary

name: Toki Alley Tales (III)
description: They say that those who make the ameonna cry will bring inescapable sorrow upon themselves. —Tanuki Historical Commentary

name: Toki Alley Tales (IV)
description: The tragedy of mortals is to lack self-knowledge, and that of the youkai is the lack of any such tragic troubles. —Tanuki Historical Commentary

name: Toki Alley Tales (V)
description: Will this middle section filled with regret lead to a more interesting story thereafter?

name: Pass Permit
description: A pass permit you obtained from Yae Miko. With this, you can enter Tenshukaku without restrictions and meet the Raiden Shogun.\nYou heard that this was made for emergencies, but that Yae Miko seems to have never had a chance to use it.

name: Dango Milk
description: A creative snack made by adding sticky dango to milk. It is sweet and has a dense mouthfeel. All the customers who have tried it love it.\nStill, it is dango that's been added in — drink too much and you might lose your appetite.

name: Realm Dispatch
description: A realm dispatch that you obtained from Tubby. It seems to be able to allow your companions to come and go in your realm as they please...\nAfter acquiring this item, you can invite companions to reside in your Serenitea Pot from the Placement Screen.

name: Special Sakura Bloom
description: A seemingly special Sakura Bloom.

name: Thunder Sakura Crab
description: A crab that lives beside the Thunder Sakura. One wonders if it has any unique properties...

name: Fresh Seagrass
description: Fresh Seagrass. It looks like it would make a good meal.

name: Fresh Sakura Bloom
description: A fresh sakura bloom. One can't be sure how Julie is going to use it in her dish...

name: Fresh Snapdragon
description: Fresh snapdragon. It should be most suitable for cooking.

name: Fresh Bird Egg
description: A fresh egg that should be most amenable to cooking.

name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune: Prologue
description: Stories about memories are always closely intertwined with transience. This book is not all-new, but is an adaptation of "Urakusai's Chronicles of the Six Kitsune."

name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (I)
description: The story of the "Black Fox" Itaru was actually the third volume in the original "Urakusai's Chronicles of the Six Kitsune." It appears at the front of this edition due to the writer's personal preference.

name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (II)
description: This volume recounts the clash between "Black Fox Itaru" and the "Twin Oni of Tokaku." This tale was missing from the original text, but it was fortunately rediscovered at a later date. It is presented here in an edited form.

name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (III)
description: In the 500-year-old "Urakusai's Chronicles of the Six Kitsune," Youzan and Yui went on to have their own tales. But at this time, the mother-daughter pair are still reliant on Itaru to rescue them.

name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (IV)
description: This is the tensest tale of the series, said to have been written by Urakusai upon his return from Liyue. It is featured in full in this writer's adaptation.

name: Sangonomiya Chronicles
description: Historical annals written by the famous Shogunate historian Kujou Michizane, who was known as one of the "The Three Kujou Dignitaries," or "The Great Calligrapher." It chronicles the history of Watatsumi Island in broad strokes.

name: The Saga of Hamavaran (Preface)
description: The prefaces of the new light novel "The Saga of Hamavaran," now combined into their own separate volume due to a business model adjustment!

name: The Saga of Hamavaran (I)
description: "How could this happen..." An ordinary scholar from Sumeru is unexpectedly assigned an unpopular specialization and ordered to go forth to the land of thunder and lightning... The curtains slowly rise on an adventure in the nation of many shores!

name: The Saga of Hamavaran (II)
description: "'Ghost-calling'? Is that the same as 'spirit-warding' back home?" With confusing questions swirling in his mind, Hamavaran begins to speak with his newfound traveling companion. An unexpected journey begins!

name: A Legend of Sword (I)
description: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse, light-centuries of war unfold down on the planet's surface... With this grandiose opening comes an all-new tale of gallantry!

name: A Legend of Sword (II)
description: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse, no battle is legendary enough to be any more than a ripple in the silence for those who dwell upon the shore... But for the warriors in the thick of it, the war is all there is.

name: A Legend of Sword (III)
description: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse lies a small chain of shattered isles, each of which has its own history, featuring tales heroic and trivial alike. This heroic tale is set in the time of the Suruga Shogunate.

name: A Legend of Sword (IV)
description: There is a saying in Inazuma: "What are bandits but the children of war?" In times of tumult, even the harvest is a battlefield... See how this unfolds in the latest volume of "A Legend of Sword"!

name: A Legend of Sword (V)
description: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse, in nondescript village in a remote corner of the shattered isles, a ronin who has fallen upon hard times forms an alliance with a group of farmers. A great battle with the bandits draws near...

name: Sacred Sakura Cleansing Summary
description: A tattered scroll containing information related to the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. Some pages seem to bear the cinnabar seal of some shrine.

name: Fresh Mushroom
description: A mushroom that did not originally grow in this area, but began to grow with wild profusion after absorbing sufficient special nutrition.

name: Crab Bait
description: Crab bait that you got from Xudong. Laying it should attract crabs.

name: Someone's Diary V: Jinren Island
description: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's unfortunate encounters at Jinren Island.

name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Ritou
description: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald. The pages bear both the refreshing scent of sakura flowers and the bitterness of tobacco leaves.

name: Grand Narukami Shrine Omamori
description: An omamori given to you by Yae Miko.\n"You can take this out and have a look whenever you think of me as well, you know?"

name: Official Tenryou Commission Document
description: Obtained from Kujou Takayuki. None are privy to these contents save him and the Shogun — or so they tell you. It has the seal of the Kujou Clan Head on it.

name: Tenryou Commission Secret Letter
description: Obtained from Kujou Takayuki. The contents are a bit ambiguous, but it isn't difficult to see that some of it involves an exchange of intelligence with the Fatui.

name: Supersized Firework
description: Yoimiya's pride and joy as the current owner of Naganohara Fireworks. It still seems to be in an experimental state. Nothing's going to go wrong... right?

name: Special Magical Crystal Ore
description: The Special Magical Crystal Ore mentioned in the sailing log. It looks exactly the same as normal magical crystal ore, so there must be some other key factor that allows it to attract the Lunar Leviathan.

name: Ore Slag
description: Slag left behind amidst some ore on Dragonspine. The valuable portions have been taken away, and the rest is just worthless, useless dross — or at least, that's how people might be inclined to see it. They would have carried it off as well otherwise, right?

name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (I)
description: The princess who was prophesied to bring destruction witnesses the imminent fall of her nation, and it is at this moment when a wandering warrior descends from the skies, ignorant of the truth.\nThe pair's journey amidst the fires of an ancient warring period are about to begin!

name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (II)
description: "A princess who brings destruction. Hah. Isn't that just an excuse for making war?"\nThey travel to the center of the world in search of the truth behind the prophecy.\nThe super-popular romantic adventure continues!

name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (III)
description: The two, who have entered the field of battle, finally witness the true Avici. The truth behind the fires of war that have swept across the world will be revealed here!\nThis volume comes with some super value-added extras!

name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (IV)
description: "Go back to hell, you jumped-up vengeful spirit!"\nThe riveting flashback chapter! What lies within the warrior's buried past?\nHere comes a new chapter in the adventures of the princess who lost her nation and the warrior!

name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (V)
description: "If this world requires your sacrifice to be saved, then it might as well burn."\nHaving reached the Sky Tower at the heart of the world at last, is this... finally the end of the pair's tale?

name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (VI)
description: The truth of the world is revealed — and what a terrible joke it is! Even when separated, the two cannot escape the chains of fate.\nThis may be the final volume of "Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation," but our story isn't over yet!

name: Flowers for Princess Fischl (0)
description: The preliminary volume of the "Flowers for Princess Fischl" series.\nThis work originally came in a violet and black wooden box as a limited edition gift, but many hardcore fans of the series who wanted to collect the whole saga were enraged by the great amount of content versus the small number of copies printed.\nDue to this, Yae Publishing House would name this book "Volume 0" and sell it separately. Eventually, the original work, the boxed collector's edition, and Volume 0 would all come to be regarded as standard by fans.

name: Teyvat Travel Guide - Inazuma
description: A magazine by the Adventurers' Guild. Each issue introduces great sceneries across Teyvat. This issue includes a short traveling diary of Alice the Traveler in Inazuma.

name: Drifting Bottle With Letter
description: A floating bottle that you fished up accidentally. The cork on this bottle has already been damaged, and the letter within has been mildewed. Thankfully, you discovered it in time, or its contents may have become lost to time altogether.

name: Onibudou
description: A standalone volume from the light novel series "Onibudou," written by Junkichi, a writer with Yae Publishing House. This collection contains the first two major arcs in the story. The quality of the serialized version varies quite a bit, but it still enjoys a degree of popularity amongst readers.

name: Grand Narukami Shrine Omamori
description: An omamori that served a critical purpose within the Plane of Euthymia.\nAccording to Yae Miko, "This item was given to you by the lovely, sagacious Lady Yae Miko."

name: Lucky Omamori
description: An omamori that Thoma gave you. It is said to be able to bring good luck.

name: Box of Nails
description: A box of nails obtained from a Treasure Hoarder camp. You can use it for repairs.

name: Planks
description: Wooden planks obtained from a Treasure Hoarder camp. You can use them for repairs.

name: Rope
description: Rope obtained from a Treasure Hoarder camp. You can use it for repairs.

name: Kito's Sachet
description: A sachet carried by Kito and Kina. It seems to have been woven from two smaller sachets before being carefully hidden in a wooden box.

name: Treasure Map Fragment
description: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

name: Treasure Map Fragment
description: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

name: Treasure Map Fragment
description: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

name: Treasure Map Fragment
description: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

name: A Treasure Map Left for Shitoki
description: A complete Treasure Map made from several fragments. It gives off a faint sea-salt scent.

name: Makiri's Charm
description: A sturdy bag that seems seawater-proof. It's full of blessing from the ancestral spirits.

name: General Purpose Directional Conduction Component
description: A basic, common component often found in various creations of an ancient civilization, the function of which seems to be ensuring that these creations continue operating. Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.

name: Rust-Worn Key
description: A rusted key. Who knows how long it has been here...

name: Heavy Key
description: A key that feels heavy in your hand. What door will it open?

name: Intact Key
description: A key that at least looks intact. One wonders who might have left it here...

name: Sumida's Letter
description: A letter given to you by Sumida.\nGive this letter to Kama in Ritou.

name: New Firework Model
description: Yoimiya's new firework model. Who knows what it will do...

name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (V)
description: Commentary regarding ancient matters that was specially added to the "New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune." If you find it an insipid, monotonous slog, dear reader, you may skip this volume. But as far as the author is concerned, this is one waste of words and emotion that cannot be avoided.

name: Northland Bank Check
description: A check with the emblem of the Northland Bank printed on it. It can be exchanged for Mora.

name: Scrawled Treasure Map
description: This is an awful specimen of a treasure map. Its lines are random and its grids scrawled. You could probably sell this for a significant amount of Mora by claiming that it is the work of some stream-of-consciousness artist, though.

name: Kiminami Anna's Invigorating Kitty Meal
description: An Invigorating Kitty Meal made personally by Kiminami Anna. You're not certain if Neko will like it or not...

name: Autake Slate
description: An example of the Ishine Script that was once used on Tsurumi Island.\nIt probably needs to be returned to some place in the Autake Plains.

name: General Purpose Directional Conduction Component
description: A basic, common component often found in various creations of an ancient civilization, the function of which seems to be ensuring that these creations continue operating. Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.

Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.
