Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.

name: A Preliminary Study of Sangonomiya Folk Belief
description: This paper was written by Shihab Purbiruni, a scholar of modern history from Sumeru, two years before the civil war in Inazuma. It details the folk beliefs of Watatsumi Island and the Sangonomiya people, and puts forward some relatively new academic propositions.

name: The Life of Mouun the Shrine Maiden
description: For the people of Watatsumi, the legends of the Archon War are always filled with bitterness. Many of these millennia-old folksongs tell of a shrine maiden by the name of Mouun, who once rode upon the back of a sea monster, following the Great Serpent unto a tragic, moving end.

name: Debates on the "Viceroy of the East"
description: The "Viceroy of the East," or "Touzannou" sung of in Watatsumi folk tradition is also known as the "Akuou" all across Raiden's domains. He was the first vassal ruler of the Great Serpent Orobashi, and he was also the last.

name: Treasured Tales of the Chouken Shinkageuchi (I)
description: The first part of a traditional Inazuman novel. This particular volume is also known as "Shinkageuchi," and was once a restricted text. It contains a fantastical tale about the first Raiden Shogun and her kagemusha, depicting the benevolent sagacity of the first Shogun and the great valor of her kagemusha. However, due to the great popularity of another book known colloquially as "Raiden Reincarnation," many people became interested in stories of this kind. This book thus wound up being published in a haphazard manner.

name: Mysterious Stone
description: This object seems to carry the Ishine Script that was once used on Tsurumi Island.\nBring this stone back to its rightful place.

name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Tsurumi Island
description: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald. The pages bear both the moist smell of the fog and a certain fungal scent.

name: Fresh Meat
description: Food that Thoma has prepared for the stray cats and dogs. This should go like hotcakes.

name: Fresh Fish
description: Food that Thoma has prepared for the stray cats and dogs. A slightly fishy smell wafts off it.

name: Bag of Retrieved Items
description: A batch of abandoned goods that you found at a warehouse at the south wharf. They essentially have no value.

name: Repaired Comb
description: The comb that Ningguang commissioned Mingxing Jewelry to repair. It belongs to a special informant. The damage to the comb was originally quite severe. The fact that it could be repaired to this extent is quite impressive indeed.

name: Mysterious Flyer
description: A pamphlet you obtained from the Ms. Hina Fan Club. You've got to say that the design looks kind of familiar...

name: Rigorous Schedule
description: A schedule that you created for Ningguang. The various items are all laid out in a clear and easy-to-read manner.

name: Simple Schedule
description: A schedule that you created for Ningguang. Simple, cogent, and to the point.

name: Starsplinter Iron
description: One of the ores required to create Wonder Cores. It has the power to resonate with Visions.

name: Subrosium
description: One of the ores required to create Wonder Cores. It can often be found where dawn meets dusk.

name: Wonder Core
description: The core component to the Jade Chamber's mechanisms. When combined with Adepti Sigils, they can be used as the control center of the Jade Chamber.

name: Adepti Sigil
description: Adepti Sigils made by Shenhe. They contain dense adeptal energy.

name: Records of a Changing Village
description: Documents announcing the villagers' migration. It states that the village was forced to relocate due to a god's remains.

name: Ragged Notebook
description: A ragged notebook you found in the village. It records the happenings of long ago, now buried by the passage of time.

name: Mountainous Miscellany
description: This text contains all manner of strange legends about Mt. Tianheng's stones, including tales about many rare ores. It is said that if you stand in the middle of the lake south of Mt. Tianheng at dusk, you will find the legendary Subrosium.

name: Neatly-Written Note
description: The paper of this letter is slightly brittle and its ink is also a little smudged. It seems that both it and its owner have borne the assault of the waves. Unfortunately, while they encountered the same tribulations, they did not share the same fate.

name: Little Meng's Drifting Bottle
description: A bottle containing Little Meng's various troubles. You wonder what's inside...

name: Lumenstone
description: A special stone mined from the depths of The Chasm. It is said that it has catalytic properties.\nIt almost blazes with light in the gloomy mines, but it loses all such effects the moment one leaves The Chasm.\nIt seems to have other unique properties as well that have yet to be discovered.

name: Muning's Note
description: The Ministry representative Muning gave you this note. Despite its short length, the word "prohibited" appears 8 times. If you give this to an adventurer named Zhiqiong, you will receive the aid you need.

name: Treasure Map Fragment
description: A fragment of a larger map that seems to indicate the location of treasure.\nIf you can find the other fragment, that should complete the picture.

name: Treasure Hoarders' Treasure Map
description: This treasure map, once torn in two and kept in different hiding spots by the Treasure Hoarders, is now whole again.\nIf you follow the symbol on it, you might discover some special treasure!

name: Storehouse Security Key No. 1
description: A key to a certain storehouse that was hidden in a very obvious place, yet was never found by the Treasure Hoarders. Guess they're not as good at their job as they think, huh?

name: Storehouse Security Key No. 2
description: A key to a certain storehouse that was hidden in an incredibly obvious place, yet was never found by the Treasure Hoarders. They should probably go back to Hoarder school.

name: A Set of Cannonballs
description: Cannonballs for the Mountainator, also known as the Safe Blasting Mechanism 2156. Although you used the Lumenstone Adjuvant to clear the unknown pollutants away, there is still a stench about them that can be detected even while covering your nose.\nUgh. Do you really have to touch it?

name: Special Unmoving Essential Oil
description: A dangerous substance made using the formula that Clitopho provided by compressing two Unmoving Essential Oils into one very dense bottle filled with Geo elemental energy.\nDue to its fame as a highly unstable concoction, only madmen or experienced miners would dare use it, making it an uncommon sight indeed.\nHandle with utmost care!

name: Key to a Stony Hall
description: According to Khedive's initial speculations, this construct may be a "key" that could open the door to some ruin somewhere.

name: Photo of a Strange Rock
description: You took this picture of a strange rock that can be seen on the walls of The Chasm. You do not know what the patterns on the rock mean, but perhaps it could be of value to some researchers.

name: Akademiya Recommendation Letter
description: This letter, carefully crafted, is sealed in the name of "Ecologist Khedive Pursina."\nYou got this as a gift from Khedive. He claims that this is even more precious than gold, and can gain you the help of the House of Purbiruni.\nKhedive himself believes monetary remuneration to be something of an insult... Hopefully, this doesn't prove to be a trend with people from Sumeru.

name: Orb of the Blue Depths
description: A strange gem left behind by a foe from the Abyss. If you look into it hard, it is almost as if you are looking into a long-borne dream shrouded by a deep fog.

name: Metal Key
description: A key wrought of metal that has been worn down with rust accumulated over many years.

name: Miner's Key
description: Such keys are commonly found in the mines, but one wonders why it would appear here.

name: Blessings of Wisdom
description: A suspicious object you obtained from Xamaran. It is claimed that this can clear the source of the foul energy. Condensed from the fungus' absorbed nutrients, the agglomeration of spores... and a thick sense of humor.

name: Mountainator Cannonball (Fuse Attached)
description: A cannonball with a fuse carefully attached. Ready to be fired at any time!

name: Toy Doll
description: A toy belonging to miner Qi Ding's daughter. It looks pretty tattered and it's hard to imagine that any kid would like it. But the intricate stitch-work shows that this was once quite the pricey item.

name: Flower of Farsight
description: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm... possibly? It seems just like an ordinary Qingxin, and one that has newly sprouted as well, seeing as how its white petals have never been touched by dew.\nWho knows how many people have once climbed up to high heights to pick one such fresh flower? Who knows if these flowers eventually bore witness to partings or reunions?

name: Skyfeather
description: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm, a feather that fell from an eagle that flew over the top of the cavern. The Millelith seem to enjoy collecting these tough feathers to use as ornaments.\nIt is said that eagle feathers fit valiant warriors best, and so tend to be used to decorate the armor and arms of the bravest, such that they might break the enemy formation with all the swiftness of that great bird of prey.

name: Sundial of Ages
description: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. It seems quite old now, but the etchings are still very clear, and so it can still be used.\nThe sun is a rare sight down in The Chasm, and it is easy to lose track of time. But someday, this sundial will once again track the passage of years.

name: Cup of Commons
description: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. Neither stone nor gem, it somehow still became part of the Treasure Hoarders' loot hoard.\nIt has been filled by turns with fine wine, fair treasure, and blood. Now, its previous shame has been washed away, and it is ready to take on new memories.

name: Helm of Warding
description: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. It was found hidden in the living quarters of the miners. A slightly less discerning eye might have mistaken it for a miner's hat.\nIt is heavily scarred and pitted, making one wonder how many miners' lives it must have saved.

name: Warrior's Spear
description: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. It was lost amid the ancient battlefield five hundred years ago. The long years have worn the edge of the spear-point away, but it still looks quite ominous nonetheless.\nOne can imagine that it was once wielded by a warrior most brave, earning the cheers of the young wherever it swept, even unto The Chasm itself.

name: Brass Ring
description: A ring that you got off a Golden Weasel Thief. See how it glitters, see how it shines! The Weasel Thief must have planned on using it to attract a mate, and it does indeed look quite valuable. One imagines that its owner must be quite distressed at the moment.

name: Archaic Stone
description: A strange, rare ore that was mined from The Chasm.\nThese rocks can only be found in the ore veins of the oldest mountains. It is so rare that most merchants have probably never heard of it.\nHowever, the changes in The Chasm have led to the emergence of much low-quality Archaic Stone, a fact that has given the merchants of Huishan Hall quite the headache.

name: Shriveled Seed
description: A seemingly withered object that seems to, by normal judgment, be a seed. However, it still has a surprising amount of life in it yet.\nBest not to eat it for now...

name: Lumenstone Ore
description: The raw ore from which Lumenstone may be found. If processed properly, it can be used to strengthen the Lumenstone Adjuvant you have. Why not hit Jinwu up and ask her?

name: Yue Chuan's Drifting Bottle
description: A drifting bottle that contains Yue Chuan's reply to Little Meng. You wonder if it'll reach him...

name: Hiraizumi's Goods
description: Fresh soy milk. It'll go bad quick if improperly stored.

name: Cell Key
description: A metal key that you obtained from the Fatui. It should be able to open some kind of door.

name: Freshly-Picked Calla Lily
description: A freshly-picked Calla Lily. Suitable for being used as a specimen.

name: Freshly-Picked Small Lamp Grass
description: A freshly-picked Small Lamp Grass. Suitable for being used as a specimen.

name: Freshly-Picked Cecilia
description: A freshly-picked Cecilia with a pleasant fragrance.

name: Ruin Machine Core
description: The core section of a Ruin Guard. Old and new versions of this device are incompatible, and it thus cannot be used to empower other objects. However, the leftover energy should be enough to power one Ruin Guard.

name: Date's Key
description: Date's key. Unfortunately, this will not open the treasury of a distinguished Enkanomiya family. It will only open the way to the Heterodoxa labyrinth.

name: Pile of Lavender Melons
description: This pile of Lavender Melons may have been collected and placed here by some kind of animal. They look a bit like Onikabuto from a distance.

name: Fine Incense
description: Incense you got from Wang Ping'an. Looks to be of good quality.

name: Curious Cube
description: An unknown construct that you discovered in the depths of The Chasm. It resembles an intricately-made cube.

name: A Note Someone Stuffed You
description: As you were walking down the streets of Inazuma, someone stuffed this note onto your person. Two strange symbols are drawn on it.

name: Special Bamboo Slip
description: A Bamboo Slip upon which Momoyo has applied some specially made elemental powder. Store and handle it with care! The powder has some measure of poison in it — and of course, you'll get yelled at for improper handling.

name: "Final Instructions"
description: Fatui operational orders that you obtained from Lyudochka. They detail an operation that will take place in the future on Watatsumi Island. This intelligence is very important — peoples' lives are at stake here!

name: Bag of Clothes
description: A bag that contains Lyudochka's Fatui uniform. Considering the controversial nature of Fatui uniforms, it is best not to let other people see this.

name: Special Fortune Slip
description: A specially made fortune slip that describes how your luck will be like today. There is nothing different about this Fortune Slip, save for the fact that you got it for the fake Bamboo Slip.\nWhose fortune does this Fortune Slip describe?

name: Strange Object
description: A strange item that you fished up from the underground waterways in The Chasm. It's wet, and you cannot tell if this is a living or dead thing.

name: Bedrock Key Location Diagram
description: A simple diagram that Zhiqiong drew in haste. It indicates the general locations of several Bedrock Keys.

name: Light Mora Purse
description: A Mora purse you found in a treasure chest. The feeling you had when weighing it was one of immense disappointment.

name: Full Mora Purse
description: A Mora purse you found in a treasure chest. Compared to the previous purse you found, this one provides a decent amount more comfort.

name: Plump Fish
description: A fish you just obtained from the river. It might be considered a gift from nature. It is so excellent that it only needs to be grilled a little to be delicious as can be.

name: Beautifully-Written Note
description: Beautifully-Written Note

name: Yun Jin's Personal Letter
description: A letter that Yun Jin personally wrote to Shiyun. It seems to hold the key to turning the situation around.

name: Lyudochka's Letter
description: The letter that Lyudochka asked someone from Yae Publishing House to pass on to you. It contains her reasons for leaving without saying why. However, whether you will accept her reasons for departing or not is a different story.\nIt was you who discovered her presence and changed her fate... Might you be able to do still more to change this ending for the better?

name: Lyudochka's Mora Purse
description: The Mora purse that Lyudochka left behind. It contains a decent sum of Mora, but even Paimon doesn't want to use it.

name: Fatui Code Sheet
description: A certain ever-somnolent member of the Shuumatsuban wrote this Fatui Code Sheet.\nReading it does not merely let you know that "these Fatui speak very oddly indeed" — you can also feel the recorder's intense lethargy penetrating the paper in the form of saliva.

name: Light Purse
description: A purse you got from Mona. It contains the amount she needs to pay her rent.

name: Marjorie's Gift
description: A present that you got from Marjorie. You've heard that children will like it...

name: Viktor's Gift
description: A gift you got from Viktor. He seems to have also put a letter under the gift box.

name: Fresh Wolfhooks
description: Fresh Wolfhooks that Schuster picked. Thankfully, they haven't been damaged by monsters yet.

name: Lyudochka's Fortune Slip
description: A specially made fortune slip that describes how your luck will be like today. There is nothing different about this Fortune Slip, save for the fact that you used it to open Lyudochka's heart.\nNow, this Fortune Slip has returned to your hands, along with her heartfelt blessings. If you've got the time, why not go to the Grand Narukami Shrine to see her?

name: The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku
description: A novel based on Watatsumi Island's folktales. The original edition of this text was transcribed on Watatsumi Island and brought back to Narukami Island by a merchant while the former's serpent god yet lived. No one reads this ancient tome nowadays, its role supplanted by all the light novels on the market. This book describes the unique cosmological outlook of the Watatsumi people before they came to adopt aspects of Narukami culture, and a recent resurgence in traditional novel publishing has allowed it to see the light of day once more.

name: Before Sun and Moon
description: A chronicle that ordinary folk have been forbidden to read. The writing is a mix of fables and histories from the beginning of the world to the creation of the Dainichi Mikoshi.

name: Hydrological Studies in Byakuyakoku
description: This text records the geography and hydrology of Byakuyakoku. With the sealing of the depths and the emigration of the people of Watatsumi, as well as the passing of long years, this book is now useless.

name: Bathysmal Vishap Experimental Records
description: Experimental Records of the Bathysmal Vishaps. No vishaps were killed in the writing of these records.

name: In the Light, Beneath the Shadow
description: A puzzle book for children of ages nine to twelve. As a book from a transitory period, it uses Narukami-style names with Byakuyakoku subscripts.

name: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
description: "This is a rather orthodox light novel, with its contents essentially being an edited version of real life in Teyvat. What is surprising, however, is that the author seems to be highly knowledgeable about Watatsumi Island, with many vivid, almost lifelike descriptions." — Ms. Hina

name: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
description: "This light novel is based on school life and depicts the antics of all manner of schoolyard oddballs. A very entertaining read." — Ms. Hina

name: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
description: "This story is quite wild and can be almost disorienting to read initially, but its wonderment grows on you, and it contains many a moment of gut-busting laughter. I liked it very much." — Ms. Hina

name: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
description: "By blending many styles together, this seemingly thin book transports you into a great many tales. I can only imagine that its author must also be a very interesting person. I happen to know someone like that, in fact — something that lends this book a very familiar touch." — Ms. Hina

name: Muning's Note
description: The Ministry representative Muning gave you this note. Despite its short length, the word "prohibited" appears 8 times. If you give this to an adventurer named Zhiqiong, you will receive the aid you need.

name: Frostglaze Crystal
description:
A glaze crystal produced in the depths of The Chasm, this special Glaze Sand Crystal ore was one of many scattered about during the battle against the giant ruin machine. Glaze Sand Crystal ore is a regional specialty of The Chasm, but this one is different from the rest.
Under the radiance of the blue crystal and the power of the Abyss, a strange spiral pattern has emerged within this stone, and it is cold, almost chilling to the touch.
This once smooth crystal has been transformed into this shape by the great might that descended from the heavens and the miasma that arose from the earth's depths — and perhaps the form it has taken is itself a warning unto mortals.
If the interaction of these forces alone could twist stone and metal thus, if that ordinary heroine was truly able to witness the end of the pitch-dark path, how would she have faced the discovery she would make?

name: Light Realm Sigil
description: A mark symbolizing the recognition of Enkanomiya's Tokoyo Ookami.\nThey can be offered up to the Statue of the Vassals of Watatsumi, thus upgrading the Bokuso Box.

name: Light Realm Core
description: You discovered this mysterious stone while exploring the darkened realm of Enkanomiya.\nThe Light Realm gave humans additional means to resist the Abyss.

name: Bloodied Sergeant's Insignia
description: The bloodied and muddied insignia of a Fatui sergeant. You have no idea how it ended up in the depths of The Chasm.

name: Kapral Nikolay's Diary
description: A letter left behind by Kapral Nikolay. Its contents have long ceased to be whole.

name: Kapral Nikolay's Diary
description: A fragment of Fatui Kapral Nikolay's diary. It gives off a rather unpleasant smell, but that's at least better than being covered in mud.

name: Mora Purse
description: You were asked by Xu from Feiyun Commerce Guild to deliver this to Huishan Hall's representative Muning, who is at The Chasm. It contains a rather sizable sum of Mora.

name: A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits
description: A light novel that has been popular in Inazuma lately. It contains all manner of bizarre tales involving ancient youkai.

name: Dream Sakura
description:
You held a single sakura petal in your hand before leaving Raiden Makoto's realm of consciousness.
Its existence is a mystery. It appears no different from ordinary sakura petals, and there it silently sits in your storage just like any of the others. But you can no longer touch it, nor can you feel its weight or warmth. When an object loses any of the attributes that one would normally ascribe to it, how can its "existence" be proven for sure?
As you think back on the many sights the petal must have witnessed in the past, a certain guess comes to mind: that which sustains this sakura petal's existence must be someone's will. But as to who this person is, and whether they are intentionally or unintentionally keeping this petal in existence, neither can be known. Nor can you prove whether that willpower is one derived from yearning, trust, or gratitude.
Perhaps, when "that person's will" changes, so too will this sakura petal disappear.
Just to be safe, it might be best to check back from time to time and see if it still exists.

name: Aphotium Ore
description: A special ore created due to the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri. As Enkanomiya's environment has undergone extreme changes, the memories and thoughts of Watatsumi Omikami scattered throughout Enkanomiya have coalesced into medullae, which then transformed into ore.

name: Tokoyo Legume
description: A special plant that was produced via the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri. With the awakening of the Sangacorexes, the elemental energies within Enkanomiya have been pacified. This is a naturally-growing fertilizing crop that will turn into loam within the soil once it decays.

name: Husk Gem
description: A jewel that fell from the armor of a special Shadowy Husk after you defeated it. You can feel a will surging within it. Perhaps it might be more correct to say that this will manifested itself through the armor rather than manipulated it.

name: Fragmented Accessory
description: A small accessory you got from Kokomi. It seems to be the fragment of another object. According to her, it might come in handy at some point.

name: Fragmented Accessory
description: A fragment that you got from "Enjou." He stole this from the Dainichi Mikoshi, so this should be a relic of Enkanomiya.

name: Tsumi's Map
description: A map drawn by Tsumi. There are some markings on it.

name: Hakuen Michimitsu Amenoma
description: The heirloom blade of the Iwakura Clan.\nAlthough the one who forged this blade possessed great skills, and though it is true that this sword has slain many a foe, it does not possess any special powers. Nor has the Iwakura Succession ever obtained a Vision. Their excellent swordsmanship was purely a result of their honing of mind, body, and technique.\nThis blade has been submerged in water for a long time and seems to have completely rusted.

name: Wooden Cage Key
description: Someone from the Kanjou Commission left this behind. You should be able to use this to rescue Shinnojou.

name: Damaged Stone Slate
description: A seemingly ordinary stone slate. Who knows what secrets it might hold...

name: Mysterious Stone Slate
description: The final stone slate you obtained. Secrets within secrets, eh?

name: Yanbo's Note
description: A somewhat complete note, written in a neat hand. It seems to have been a letter left for an old friend.

name: Nikolay's Letter
description: A letter you found off one of the Black Serpent Knights. The name of the letter's recipient is neatly written: "Katarina Snezhevna, My Dear Elder Sister," while the sender's name is written somewhat haphazardly, though you can make out the words "Your Brother, Nikolay Snezhevich."

name: Fragrant Seasoning
description: Seasoning created using the recipe given to you by Nazafarin. It has a tangy aroma and serves to bring out the flavor in any dish it is added to.

name: Fragrant Vegetarian Abalone
description: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

name: The Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival!
description: This is a most lavish invitation letter, whether in its construction or its content. The letter describes a large-scale, deep-rooted, nationally-acclaimed event in which you shall be a most important guest, the radiant star of the show.

name: Worksite Records
description: This was originally a ledger, but appears to have been re-purposed as a site log instead. The latest daily happenings at The Chasm have been scribbled into its pages, though not much of this information is of any particular use.

name: Fragrant Mint Salad
description: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

name: Fragrant Triple-Layered Consommé
description: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

name: Zhiqiong's Letter
description: A letter left by a young adventurer. There is a slightly bitter scent of Qingxin on this piece of paper.

name: Arrival Schedule
description: A list of guests and their time of arrival on ships bound for the Irodori Festival.\nYour task is to welcome and lend your aid to guests according to the information presented in this schedule.

name: Five Kasen Summary
description: A summary of the information concerning the Five Kasen, which you got from Yae Publishing House's Hirayama.\nAlthough the content is quite sparse, you can still get the gist of the Five Kasen and the great flair they had in their heyday.

name: The Five Kasen's Splendor: Suikou
description: A sheet of paper Venti found in a cargo crate within the wharf warehouse. A poem entitled "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Suikou" is written upon it.

name: The Five Kasen's Splendor: Aoi no Okina
description: A sheet of paper Xingqiu found beneath his luggage. Someone seems to have left it there while he was napping. A poem entitled "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Aoi no Okina" is written upon it.

name: The Five Kasen's Splendor: Akahito
description: A sheet of paper that some mysterious person left behind. This person must have originally intended to leave it on Kazuha's person, only to be unexpectedly detected by the latter and forced to flee in a hurry, leaving the sheet behind. A poem entitled "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Akahito" is written upon it.

name: The Five Kasen's Splendor: Sumizome
description: Ayaka found this on a flower stand at the festival venue. This sheet of paper, however, only contains one line of text.

name: The Five Kasen's Splendor: Sumizome
description: Ayaka found this on a flower stand at the festival venue. Once submerged in water, this sheet of paper reveals the full poetic text of "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Sumizome."

name: Ancient Forging Blueprint
description: An ancient forging blueprint. The Shogun once ordered the Kaedehara Clan to forge a Goshintou according to it.\nAfter being soaked in water, it becomes clear that some of the text has been blurred — someone tampered with the blueprint, dooming the forging to failure and triggering the tragedy that followed...

name: Kaedehara Yoshinori's Letter
description: A blank piece of paper that was hidden in an old flower pot. When dipped in water, it reveals a long-sealed secret.\nAfter telling everyone about the truth that was concealed within, Kazuha said that "this letter may still be of use to you," before handing it over to you.

name: Taliesin's Manuscript
description: A very thick poetic manuscript. If you were to give it a generous review, it would be "mediocre," while an honest review would see it getting a "hard to read." It resembles bone-dry historical records more than it does poetry.

description: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

name: Sayu's Salary
description: This was originally intended to buy bedding and other materials by which sleep quality might be improved, but on the other hand, Sayu has no wish to sleep forever just yet.

name: Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder
description: The Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder that Sara has been hankering after. Go on, go give it to her.

name: Kokomi's Shopping List
description: A shopping list of books compiled by Kokomi. All the genres, unit prices, and amounts of the books she desires have been written down here in her elegant script.

name: Toy Fox
description: The gift that Gorou got when helping Kokomi purchase books during the Irodori Festival. Gorou then gave it to you as thanks for accompanying him.\nEvery time you look at it, you can't help but remember the sight of every hair on Gorou's body standing on end as he heard the word "fox."

name: Salary Bag
description: It is said that opening this will bring you bad luck. It seems lighter than you assumed it might be...?

name: A Complete Chart of Ako's Treasure
description: A complete nautical chart pieced together after all four parts of the clue were collected, leading to the treasure hidden by Ako Domeki and company before they left this place.

name: "Outlander Brigade: When the Wind of Death Blew Towards the Blond Samurai" Script
description: A "film script" you obtained from Xavier.

name: "Mushounin" Script
description: A new film script that Xavier finished overnight, much thicker than his last one. What you have here merely contains Act I.\nThe willpower one can harness to achieve a goal is truly amazing.

name: A Legend of Sword (VI)
description: "In essence, the great battle in space is no different from the armed conflict between commoners which took place ten years ago on that barren planet..." Soon, the name of that man shall be known across the Galaxy, matching that of the Emperor.

name: Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power
description: A popular light novel in Inazuma which tells the story of a mere mortal suddenly turning into the Raiden Shogun. The story is well-received for its novel plot and has inspired many light novelists.

name: Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?
description: A popular light novel in Inazuma which tells the story of the "good-for-nothing" Shogun and the "good-at-everything" Kitsune Guuji. The novel is in the same collection as "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power," but not by the same author. What they share in common, however, is their popularity.

name: Let's Go, Dodoco!
description: Message From the Editor: "Let's Go, Dodoco!" is the combined work of an older girl and a younger girl. Every chapter brims with their gentleness and good wishes, as the story is intended as a gift to our readers. I hope this book — in spite of its small volume — can bring you some simple joy after a long day of work.

name: Ako's Treasure: Location 1
description: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the first part.

name: Ako's Treasure: Location 2
description: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the second part.

name: Ako's Treasure: Location 3
description: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the third part.

name: Ako's Treasure: Location 4
description: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the fourth part.

name: Yajna Grass
description: One of the ingredients for making the elixir Arahaoma. "Yajna" is said to mean "the realization of death."

name: Zohrah Mushroom
description: One of the ingredients for making the elixir Arahaoma. "Zohrah" is said to mean "lost in a tipsy dream."

name: Barsam Flower
description: One of the ingredients for making the elixir Arahaoma. "Barsam" is said to be a sacred tree that has long vanished in history.

name: Arahaoma
description: An elixir of Aranara. A mere drop of it is all it takes to unveil Aranara's pure and pristine dreams to the forest.

name: "Mushounin" Script
description: A new film script that Xavier finished overnight, much thicker than his last one. What you have here merely contains Acts I and II.\nThe willpower one can harness to achieve a goal is truly amazing.

name: "Mushounin" Script
description: A new film script that Xavier finished overnight, much thicker than his last one.\nThe willpower one can harness to achieve a goal is truly amazing.

name: Jinwu's Soup
description: A thick soup that Jinwu made for sick miners. It's nutritious, fragrant, and makes you feel warm inside when you drink it.\nDon't let it go cold, now.

name: Bag of Ornaments
description: A bag of decorations that Old Chou gave you as compensation for Tang Wuchou's misfortunes. They are very roughly made, owing to having been manufactured by the Treasure Hoarders within The Chasm using smuggled ore, and can barely be considered to possess any aesthetic qualities at all. As such, there is no hope at all of them selling well in Liyue. The only thing good you could say about these ornaments is that they are at least made using the right materials...

name: Vasmrti
description: An item you obtained after traversing the nursery. It is translucent and seems to contain the memories of the earth.

name: Let's Go, Dodoco!
description: Message From the Editor: "Let's Go, Dodoco!" is the combined work of an older girl and a younger girl. Every chapter brims with their gentleness and good wishes, as the story is intended as a gift to our readers. I hope this book — in spite of its small volume — can bring you some simple joy after a long day of work.

name: Sea Route Log
description: A log indicating how to find the clues, left by the ones who hid them. If you navigate as it directs, you may indeed find a clue regarding the treasure left by Ako Domeki and company.

name: Route Log: I
description: A log indicating how to find the clues, left by the ones who hid them. If you proceed as it directs, you may indeed find a clue regarding the treasure left by Ako Domeki and company.

name: Route Log: II
description: A log indicating how to find the clues, left by the ones who hid them. If you proceed as it directs, you may indeed find a clue regarding the treasure left by Ako Domeki and company. Still, this is, what, the second log you've found already? Hopefully, it can lead you directly to the clue this time.

name: Asterism Shard
description: A mysterious shard engraved with a pattern of stars. It seems to be the key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

name: Asterism Shard
description: A mysterious shard engraved with a pattern of stars. It seems to be the key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

name: Vasoma Fruit
description: A fruit with mysterious powers.\nBija is indispensable for helping Rana, and the Vasoma Fruit is indispensable for obtaining Bija.

name: Garland
description:
A garland woven by Arama.
Garlands of this kind represent the blessings from all of Vanarana and once channeled endless powers during the fight with Marana's Avatar. But their blazing light has now faded, perhaps because they burned so relentlessly.

Every flower on the garland is connected with the lovely, tiny heart of an Aranara, and all of them together constitute the gate to Mahavanaranapna. Aranara will support those who wear such garlands. As friends, they ease the wearers' pains, ward off their nightmares, aid them through lightless days, and fill the emptiness in their hearts.

name: Garland
description: A garland woven by Arama.\nGarlands of this kind represent the blessings from all of Vanarana.

name: Bija
description: The crystallization of what is most precious to Aranara. It is not only a fruit but also a seed of hope.

name: Arana's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Arana.\nYou promised Arana that the evil shall be punished.

name: Araja's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Araja.\nAraja seems to have lost important memories.

name: Nameless Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by an unknown Aranara.\nA symbol of Aranara friendship. One who receives this flower willingly recognizes this friendship.

name: Arapandu's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Arapandu.\nCan power the Varuna Contraption and adjust the amount of water contained within the earth, thus breathing new life into the forest.

name: Arakunti's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Arakunti.\nHappy moments spent with friends are like Nilotpala Lotuses in the water.

name: Aranakula's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Aranakula.\nFearful though Aranakula was, this little creature still ventured into the Fungus-infested forest to tend to "the Memory of Stone."

name: Arabalika's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Arabalika.\nIt seems to contain the power to destroy a Ruin Guard with one strike.

name: Aranaga's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Aranaga.\n"Season of rain returns, plants rejoice... The pomegranate sings, the apples clap."

name: Aranakin's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Aranakin.\n"Wind that doesn't return, water that doesn't flow backwards... Sweet dreams and bitter aftertastes."

name: Aragaru's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Aragaru.\n"Old leaves, swollen fruit... Drifted dreams, fallen flowers."

name: Ararycan's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Ararycan.\nThere is neither soil nor water inside the Ruin Golem. It must be a nightmarish place for Ararycan.

name: Araesha's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Araesha.\nThe biggest mystery is perhaps why Araesha describes the riddles as being "delicious"... Is it because they are all about food?

name: Arakara's Flower
description: A flower gifted to you by Arakara.\nFor Arakara, who nurtures Viparyas, flowers given to friends must be most precious indeed.

name: The Siblings' Flowers
description: Flowers gifted by Arapacati and her brothers.\nLonging to be connected as "siblings" are, these Aranara have each taken on the role of sister or brother. Their obsession with cooking stems from the wish to share food with family.\nThat being said, an Aranara's tastebuds are not to be trusted.

name: The Song Gatherers' Flowers
description: Flowers gifted to you by the Song Gatherers.\n"No matter how dark the sky and land get, as long as your spirit emits warm, golden light like the sun, there will always be hope."

name: Aralila and Aranishat's Flowers
description: Flowers gifted by Aralila and Aranishat.\nWe ourselves are the strongest. Of that, there is no doubt!

name: Arakanta's Flower
description: A flower gifted by Arakanta.\nArakanta used to love hanging out with Rishboland Tigers. But now, he has created a new game for his Nara friend.

name: Stories of You and the Aranara
description: So many wonderful things transpired during your adventures with the Aranara. In the world of the Aranara where stories are highly valued, maybe someone is willing to "exchange" these with you.

name: "Emergency Adjustment Plan"
description: This map was contained within the plans that a Fatuus named Oleg accidentally dropped. All the encampment positions and Fatui patrol routes have been marked out here.

name: Asterism Shard
description: A mysterious shard engraved with a pattern of stars. It seems to be the key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

name: Key
description: A key that you found near the mysterious plant. This may be used to open a certain door in a high-up location within Xinyan's Mirage.

name: Bottle of Spring Water
description: A bottle of spring water. The Glacial Spring Water that Blazing Heart desires should be stored within.

name: Frozen Soul's Petal
description: An uncanny petal. At first glance, it seems like ice molded into the shape of a petal, but it is quite soft to the touch.\n"Plant my petal at the ending point of the intersection of melodies, and what had once sunk into the earth will re-emerge with the music."\nThat's what Frozen Soul said.

name: Elegantly-Written Note
description: An elegantly-written note.

name: A Letter
description: A letter.

name: Rock Garden Rough Stone (Left)
description: Mountain rocks. They look suited in all ways to be used as base materials from which to carve rocks for the bonsai's left side.

name: Rock Garden Rough Stone (Right)
description: Mountain rocks. They look suited in all ways to be used as base materials from which to carve rocks for the bonsai's right side.

name: Rock Garden Carving Tools
description: Carving tools that you found on the Mondstadt-style mountains. You might be able to use them to carve the base materials you have into a rock garden.

name: Rock Garden Carving Tools
description: Carving tools that you found on the Inazuma-style mountains. You might be able to use them to carve the base materials you have into a rock garden.

name: Small Gear
description: A small gear. No matter how small a gear is, it can be of use sometime, perhaps?

name: Medium Gear
description: A medium gear. "The pivotal one," as we call it.

name: Drive Gear
description: A gear that can transmit a measure of force. After all, momentum is key.

name: Large Gear
description: A large gear. Its weight and the noise it emits will make an impression for sure.

name: Duplex Gear
description: A rather small duplex gear. Double the flanks, double the labor hours.

name: Large Duplex Gear
description: A fairly large duplex gear. The bigger the size is, the more it takes to manufacture.

name: Driven Gear
description: A gear that requires power to rotate. It can be very helpful. Really. Can someone help rotate it, please?

name: Leisurely Rocks: Left
description: Slightly soft bonsai rocks. They seem to be able to summon a leisurely and comfy breeze. These can be placed on the left side of the bonsai.

name: Leisurely Rocks: Right
description: Slightly soft bonsai rocks. They seem to be able to summon a leisurely and comfy breeze. These can be placed on the right side of the bonsai.

name: Hoverlight Rocks: Left
description: Rocks of moderate hardness. It is said that a glimmer will dance across the surface of these rocks during stormy weather. These can be placed on the left side of the bonsai.

name: Hoverlight Rocks: Right
description: Bonsai rocks of moderate hardness. It is said that a glimmer will dance across the surface of these rocks during stormy weather. These can be placed on the right side of the bonsai.

name: Unyielding Rocks: Left
description: Very hard bonsai rocks that have an air of firmness to them. These can be placed on the left side of the bonsai.

name: Unyielding Rocks: Right
description: Very hard bonsai rocks that have an air of firmness to them. These can be placed on the right side of the bonsai.

name: Living Spring
description: Water obtained from the source of the rivers flowing across Apam Woods. According to Arapas, soup made from such spring water is a Supreme Delicacy. But one wonders if it really is any different from ordinary water...

name: A Box of Components
description: A box full of components. They all look quite intact, perhaps because monsters have no interest in them...

name: Note of Unknown Origin: I
description: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

name: Note of Unknown Origin: II

name: A Note
description: A wrinkled note with horrendously slanted handwriting.

name: Forensic Office Research Log Excerpt
description: A research log excerpt with plenty of crinkles. The handwriting is still very much legible.

name: Note of Unknown Origin
description: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

name: Crystalline Core
description: The crystalline core component that was missing from the curious Fatui machine. According to Persikov's manuscript, the machine can be restarted if three such cores are found and inserted into the device.

description: The crystalline core component that was missing from the curious Fatui machine. According to Persikov's manuscript, the machine can be restarted if three such cores are found and inserted into the device.

description: Old Yellowed Notes

name: Mysterious Letter
description: Mysterious Letter

name: A Seemingly Waterproof Note
description: A Seemingly Waterproof Note

name: Reverberating Key
description: A key related to a certain mysterious plant. It seems to be able to open some door somewhere...

name: A New Letter
description: A letter the head housemaid, Adelinde, just received. It needs to be sent to Dawn Winery for archiving.\nThe paper is slightly wrinkled. Maybe the person who wrote the letter was in a hurry and couldn't find a desk.

name: Dawn Winery's Top-Quality Grape Juice
description: A gift from Diluc. A bottle of grape juice with luxury packaging. It is something Paimon has long been looking forward to, but more so a memento of the time when you and your friends handled the crisis together.\nIt is also Diluc's personal favorite, produced using only Dawn Winery's best quality grapes.\nBeing "Master Diluc's favorite grape juice" seems to have inestimable commercial value...

name: Slime Condensate-Soaked Soil
description: Soil soaked with Slime Condensate. What will Akim use this sticky stuff for?

name: Whopperflower Root Soil
description: Soil collected from Whopperflower roots. What will Akim use it for?

name: Moist Soil
description: Moist soil collected from the bottom of rocks. What will Akim use it for?

name: Starlight Coalescence
description: A translucent crystal that seems to hold coalescent starlight within it. This item seems to be key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

name: Dragonspine Supplies: Ham
description: Ham meant to be used for resupply. It will keep longer in low-temperature conditions.

name: Nightwatch Contract
description: A contract penned and signed personally by the Prinzessin der Verurteilung herself. It may be used to authorize the opening of navigational sites. Those who should produce this letter of warrant shall be authorized forthwith to spread their black feathers where dawn meets dusk, and envelop the skies in night's own embrace.

name: Special "Concresoil" for Toys
description: Special "Concresoil" Akim made for Nima. What kind of pot warriors will Nima make with it?

name: Whopperflower Root Soil
description: Soil collected from Whopperflower roots. What will Akim use it for?

name: Fertile Soil (Reportedly)
description: You can't tell whether this soil is fertile or not.\nWhat will Akim use this for?

name: Discarded "Concresoil"
description: "Concresoil" of poor quality. It looks to be in terrible condition...

name: Tenryou Commission's Missing Person Poster
description: An official missing person poster with the Tenryou Commission's symbol on it.

name: Sea Salt-Crusted Key
description: A key found in the Golden Apple Archipelago, seemingly able to open a lock somewhere...

name: Special Bird Egg
description: A bird egg needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. This special egg was collected from a specific tree, but it does not look particularly special.

name: Special Mushroom
description: A mushroom needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, mushrooms of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

name: Special Mint
description: Mint needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, mints of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

name: Special Harra Fruit
description: Harra Fruit needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, Harra Fruits of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

name: Special Sweet Flower
description: Sweet Flower needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, Sweet Flowers of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

name: Box Lunch from Tighnari
description: Emergency food that Tighnari prepared for Haypasia. Paimon took a peek into the lunchbox, finding some traditional Sumeru delicacies that looked very tasty inside.

name: Letter to Haypasia
description: A letter from Tighnari to Haypasia. In the letter, Tighnari explains your identity and situation after coming to Sumeru and requests that Haypasia help clear up your doubts.

name: Box Lunch from the Traveler
description: Food that you have specifically prepared for Haypasia. The box contains Sweet Madame and Radish Veggie Soup. You hope Haypasia will like it.

name: Tighnari's Introduction Letter
description: A letter from Tighnari to Rohawi, a researcher from Amurta. In the letter, Tighnari requests that Rohawi use his prowess in collecting information to help you.\nRohawi's address in Sumeru City is also attached therein.

name: Bag of Transaction Funds
description: A bag of Mora given by Alhaitham for purchasing Canned Knowledge. You can feel the heavy weight of the bag.

name: Package of Canned Knowledge
description: Canned Knowledge purchased at Dori's booth with the Mora given to you by Alhaitham. Packaged as common commodities to keep it low-key.

name: Canned Knowledge "Swordfighting Techniques VIII"
description: Canned Knowledge labeled "Swordfighting Techniques VIII." It was bought from Dori's booth at the price of 100,000 Mora at Paimon's instigation. You have no idea where the first seven in the series are, but things like "Combat Techniques" will always be useful. Well, probably.

name: Bag of Intel Transaction Funds
description: A bag of Mora provided by Alhaitham for buying the intel on the whereabouts of the Divine Knowledge Capsule.

name: Picture of the Transaction
description: A picture of a scene where the "Divine Knowledge Capsule" is being traded.\nIn the picture, there is Mizri, the leader of Ayn Al-Ahmar, and the Divine Knowledge Capsule giving off a red glow in his hand.

name: Informant Code Chart
description: A code chart given to you by Alhaitham. Seems like whoever seeks to purchase "special commodities" from Dori has to provide the right code first.\nCheck this code chart before visiting Dori's contact, just in case.

name: Misplaced Conch 1
description: This Imaging Conch should have been placed somewhere else but was abandoned here by someone, causing it to project images out of their proper order. Return it to its rightful place, and who knows what you might find...

name: Misplaced Conch 2
description: This Imaging Conch should have been placed somewhere else but was abandoned here by someone, causing it to project images out of their proper order. Return it to its rightful place, and who knows what you might find...

name: Misplaced Conch 3
description: This Imaging Conch should have been placed somewhere else but was abandoned here by someone, causing it to project images out of their proper order. Return it to its rightful place, and who knows what you might find...

name: Prescription Medication from Bimarstan for Gurgen
description: Medication prescribed for Gurgen. It should be taken along with abundant rest.

name: Prescription Medication from Bimarstan for Azra
description: Medication prescribed for Azra. It smells incredibly bitter.

name: Prescription Medication from Bimarstan for Aftab
description: Medication prescribed for Aftab. Taker of this medication needs to practice a bland diet.

name: Fresh Harra Fruit
description: Harra Fruit needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, Harra Fruits of this kind have an appeal to monsters. They would often linger around areas where these Harra Fruits are...

name: Fresh Zaytun Peach
description: A special Zaytun Peach needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. It seems nothing different than a regular Zaytun Peach.

name: "The Best Water"
description: Water collected in Vanarana, clear, cold, and refreshing — a leaf falling on top of it would look as if floating in the air. This is transparent water of extraordinary quality.

name: Silver Pocket Watch
description: This is certainly not a new pocket watch. But you can tell that it has been carefully polished, evidence of how much the owner really cares about it. Inside is a photograph centering on a young girl from Snezhnaya.

name: Old Insignia
description: This looks like a Fatui insignia, but it's all scratched up somehow.

name: Fresh Slime Condensate
description: Slime Condensate that looks really fresh. Who knows what Garcia needs it for...

name: Sareh's Note
description: This time, we are looking for a kitten named Lale with black and white fur. If you wish to call for Lale's attention in cat language, you need to say "Meow, meow meow meow, meeeeow!" with the tone going downward then upward, before ending on an even higher note.

name: Sareh's Note
description: This time, we are looking for a kitten named Nargis with dark-gray fur. To call for Nargis's attention in cat language, you need to say "Meow! Meow meow, meow." Stress the first meow, and be quick while saying the following meows.

name: Sareh's Note
description: This time, we are looking for a kitten named Rozan with gray and black stripes. To call for its attention in cat language, you should say "Meow meow meow, meow meow meow." Say it quickly with no elongation.

name: Fresh Nilotpala Lotus
description: Flowers that grow in wetlands in the forest and bloom at night. Their fresh petals are important ingredients for the treatment of Eleazar.

name: Rose Sprout
description: A flower sprouting in the faded Withering Zone, tender yet tough.

name: Eagle Feather of The Brave
description: The brave young ones known as Javans are said to have this tough eagle feather as their symbol.

name: Florescent Talisman
description: A talisman woven with childish skills. Its meaning remains unknown. The Dendro energy in it keeps the flower fresh for a long time. But apart from that, there is nothing special about this talisman.

name: Freshly-Picked Mushroom
description: Mushrooms collected at the location designated by Hanbei. Although these mushrooms grow on tree trunks, they don't look special at all. They aren't going to cause any trouble, are they?

name: Strange Sumeru Rose
description: A Sumeru Rose affected by the Ley Lines. It seems a little different from normal...

name: Riddle Note
description:
"A mirror not made of glass reflects every drama."
Another riddle you got from the chest indicated by the previous riddle.
Who wrote these riddles...
Maybe the answer is hidden somewhere associated with dramas?

name: Riddle Note
description: "The sole path to knowledge."\nA riddle that is surprisingly straightforward to read.\nBut what does "the sole path" mean in this case?

name: Riddle Note
description: "The flowers in the pond are blooming, with watery pearls there lingering."\nThe third riddle found from a chest.\nPerhaps this might be some kind of plant?

name: Riddle Note
description: "Please go to the front door of the Temple of Knowledge at noon."\nThis riddle is like some kind of "invitation"...

name: Rafiq's Shipbuilding Materials
description: Shipbuilding materials Rafiq bought. You've heard that these have cost him a fortune...

name: Little Dried Flower
description: It looks like an ordinary little dried flower, but it was once a precious gift. It deserves to be cherished, just like the forgotten friendship of the past.

name: Activated·Canned Knowledge
description: Canned Knowledge labeled "Swordfighting Techniques VIII." It was bought from Dori's booth at the price of 100,000 Mora at Paimon's instigation. You have no idea where the first seven in the series are, but things like "Combat Techniques" will always be useful. Well, probably.

name: Persikov's Manuscript
description: Notes penned by the Fatui researcher Persikov. These notes contain a map, and if you follow its instructions, you should be able to find the crystalline cores that the Cognitive Mimicry device is missing...

name: Normal Wood
description: Viktor bought this. He claims that he'll use it to do wood carving.

name: Fatui Meal
description: A meal box containing two Panipuri. Viktor and Vsevolod should be a little hungry by now...

name: Treasure Map in a Box
description: A treasure map placed at the bottom of a box. It indicates the location of the "good stuff" with simple markings.

name: Glinting Component
description: A piece of the Primal Construct that barred your path. This component seems to be reacting with nearby devices, constantly gleaming and glinting as it does.

name: Sacred Seal: Valley
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Either way, researchers believe this symbol to have initially stood for "valley."

name: Sacred Seal: Bird Head
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Most believe the etchings here symbolize a bird's head.

name: Sacred Seal: Raised Arm
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Either way, researchers believe this symbol to have been a phonetic symbol, and that its extended meanings may have included respect or submission.

name: Sacred Seal: Sandstorm
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The shape of this symbol should be derived from the storms that ravage the desert.

name: Sacred Seal: Auricle
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol on this plate looks like an auricle, but a consensus has not been reached on this matter.

name: Sacred Seal: Forest
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? A majority of researchers believe this to represent the forest, and that this suggests that the modern-day desert was not always a desolate wasteland.

name: Sacred Seal: Thunderstrike
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The shape of this symbol should be derived from the lightning that is ever so rare a sight in the desert.

name: Sacred Seal: Danger
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol seems to indicate the hazardous circumstance of hanging a chisel hammer on a cliff, and is thought to have emerged at a later date.

name: Sacred Seal: Chisel Hammer
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol for a chisel hammer is one of the earliest words to emerge.

name: Sacred Seal: Sunrise
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The origin of this symbol is the rising sun.

name: Sacred Seal: Right to Rule
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? This symbol is the spitting image of a ruler seated upon a throne.

name: Sacred Seal: Sheep Head
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building, though the origin of this writing seems unclear. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Most believe that the etchings here symbolize a sheep's head.

name: Sacred Seal: Crocodile Head
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The source of this symbol is probably the Spinocrocodile's frighteningly huge maw.

name: Sacred Seal: Giant Serpent
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Though Haravatat researchers believe this to be a symbol for a giant serpent, Amurta researchers have proposed a different view, arguing that the Great Red Sand is not home to any snakes. As such, the meaning of and inspiration for this word is still being contested.

name: Sacred Seal: Ceremony
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The original meaning of this symbol was most likely "sacrifice," with an extended meaning of "rites" or "ceremonies" emerging later.

name: Sacred Seal: Labor
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol here appeared at the same time as the chisel hammer, and is one of the earliest words to emerge.

name: Sacred Seal: Dune
description: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The civilization from the era of King Deshret had different words for dunes of different shapes, something that has brought researchers no lack of headaches.

name: Golden Rose Seeds
description: Compared to Sumeru Roses, Golden Roses are a unique species more suited to the deserts. To survive, it has had to protect itself with a shield of mud and stone, but in the right environment, it may yet recoup its original beauty.

name: Transparent Ruins Record (I)
description: A stone slate that you found in the transparent ruins near the Mausoleum of King Deshret. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

name: Record of Lamb-Devourer Rock
description: A stone slate that you found in the secret Eremite base within Lamb-Devourer Rock. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

name: Record of the Tomb of Carouses
description: A stone slate that you found in the Tomb of Carouses. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

name: Soheil's Old Notes
description: These are the notes left by Soheil, an Akademiya researcher, who entered the desert to study when he was young. They look very old, but they are not crinkled.

name: Record of Aaru's Shut
description: A stone slate that you found at the highest point of the Mausoleum of King Deshret. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

name: Twilight Theater Head's Notes
description: The script for "Drama Phantasmagoria: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess!" The meandering scribbles appended to the script seem to be annotations from the theater troupe head, some of which contain such radical instructions as to render their adoption unlikely in the extreme.

name: Freshly-Picked Harra Fruit
description: A freshly picked Harra Fruit. Perfect for cooking.

name: Unsigned Note
description: An unsigned note. No one knows who left it...

name: Remelting Device
description: This device, developed by alchemist Hajanad, is cleverly designed with an internal chamber capable of withstanding high pressure and high temperature to withstand the explosion from the "remelting effect". The special valve can be opened automatically at the right time to release the fully mixed medicament smoke and provide the user with assistance in combat. However, judging from some of its details, this experiment seems to be suffering from a shortage of funds. Hajanad's research doesn't seem to be all that well-funded...

name: Remelting Tablet
description: A masterpiece of the alchemist Hajanad, a truly special solid potion. Theoretically, this alchemy tablet can be stored for a long time and is quite safe and easy to carry and transport. However, when in use, the tablet needs to be put into the "remelting device," where the two solid agents will be mixed via micro-explosion to obtain complete efficacy.\nAnd it is always a little disturbing to think that the device in hand may explode...

name: Pyro Shard
description: A shard that broke off a larger Pyro Crystal. Gives 50 Pyro Energy when absorbed.
effect: Gives 50 Pyro Energy to all party members

effect: Gives 30 Pyro Energy to all party members
