name: Blanche's Letter
description: A letter, placed betwixt two Bulle Fruit.

name: Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures
description: A children's fantasy book containing only three pages, it tells the story of a prince who overcomes loneliness.\nIt reads "For anyone in a tough spot" in small print on the back cover.

name: Location No. 1 Materials
description: Heinry's lost materials. Who knows what kind of inspiration he'll get from them...

name: Location No. 2 Materials
description: Heinry's lost materials. Who knows what kind of inspiration he'll get from them...

name: Location No. 3 Materials
description: Heinry's lost materials. Who knows what kind of inspiration he'll get from them...

name: "Iridescent Glory"
description: Shells and corals of all different hues and colors. Said to be the greatest treasure of the Water Imps, and the very reason they built the shining Rainbow Bridge in the Kingdom of Water Imps...

name: Aurelie's Notes (I)
description: Aurelie's Notes (I)

name: Marvelous Jelly: Improved Fontaine Edition
description: An exquisite gift box from Haniyyah, the jellies within are loved by Fungi. There are many unique flavors, so Fungi with different preferences can be fed separately.\nWith a better understanding of the Fungi and her accumulated experience, Haniyyah has mastered the flavors of the Marvelous Jelly. The improved version is not only more nutritious, but also contains special Fontainian flavors. The healthy jellies allow the Fungi to eat well and live well!

name: Spina di Rosula Uniform Gift Box
description: Navia prepared this gift, which contains a Spina di Rosula uniform, for Adele. The dimensions are a bit large for Adele at present, but it works just fine for a promise.

name: Strangely-Shaped Key
description: A key you got from a member of Romeuf's gang. This seems to be the tool required to quickly stop the explosives.

name: Recommendation Letter
description: Recommendation Letter

name: Rusty Iron Key
description: Someone must have dropped this here. Just what lock does it open?

name: Old Insignia
description: An insignia that marks the owner's identity. If it's been left here and no one thought to look for it for a long time, perhaps the owner didn't care about it very much.

name: "Persona"
description: One of the fabricated materials necessary to forge the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz. It feels almost weightless.

name: Unlocked "Treasure"
description: An old pocket watch.\nIt seems to have stopped at a certain instant, the beautiful memory of a moment becoming eternal.

name: Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz
description: A sacred blade indwelt with great enough reason and will to create and destroy a universe, or a dream.

name: Ancient Tree Branch
description: A branch taken from an ancient tea tree. It emits a faint adeptal energy...

name: Aurelie's Notes (II)
description: Aurelie's Notes (II)

name: "A New Life's Beginning"
description: An exit card issued by the Fortress of Meropide. It's just a piece of paper, but it has been given a name most heartening.

name: Root Cycle
description: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.\nThe innermost circle is the Cycle of Hyperborea, symbolizing the age when the world was frozen and the lost paradise.

name: Root Cycle
description: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.\nThe middle circle is the Cycle of Natlantea, symbolizing the triumph over the evil dragon, a metaphor for humanity's victory over nature as well as the beasts within themselves.

name: Root Cycle
description: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.\nThe third circle and outermost half circle are the Cycles of Remuria and Khraun-Arya, symbolizing the relationship between humans and gods.

name: Simple Vault Key I
description: One of the keys that opens the iron barrier on the shattered vessel.

name: Simple Vault Key II
description: One of the keys that opens the iron barrier on the shattered vessel.

name: Simple Vault Key III
description: One of the keys that opens the iron barrier on the shattered vessel.

name: Arataki Gang's Instant Ramen
description: A gift from Kuki Shinobu after helping the Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King power up and find new ways in Beetle Battle in Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp. \nDried ramen blocks are placed in a sturdy yet light box, with sealed condiments, exceptionally rigid utensils, and a bowl. Put the ramen and the condiments in the bowl, then pour in hot water to quickly make a bowl of ramen that doesn't taste too bad at all. Convenient, isn't it? \nBut according to the letter that Kuki Shinobu left in the box, neither she nor Arataki Itto got to eat this during their journey on the water to Liyue, because they only brought cookies and pickles. During their stay in Liyue, Kuki Shinobu was inspired by the wheaten foods there, and created this instant ramen so that Oni King's Right Hand and Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon could fight off their hunger during their travels...

name: Foggy Forest Branch
description: A branch that glimmers with a jade-green light. It seems to have some kind of mysterious connection with the Foggy Forest Path.\nUpon closer inspection, it appears as though something is flowing within the branch.

name: Fallen Bouquet
description: Wild flowers in bloom that were once cherished by someone. There is little special about it, unless that be the place where it fell.\nA little gratitude and remembrance may be the key to moving forward.

name: Tripod
description: Urville's lost tripod. It should be usable once it is dried.

name: Nadia's Token
description: A small gear. It seems very ordinary indeed.

name: Tiny Conch
description: A beautiful conch. Nadia loves it a lot.

name: Diving Set
description: Urville's lost diving equipment. It seems to have been damaged a bit.

name: Sunken Coin Pouch
description: A commonly-seen coin pouch filled with Mora.

name: Strange Message
description: Strange Message

name: Wangshan Hall Backup Key
description: A rusted key obtained from Huang the Third.

name: The Paimon Special
description: According to Huang the Third, when Grand Master Guhua passed on his techniques, he would accept rice and salted meat as payment instead of Mora. Based on this anecdote, Paimon put all her heart (and salt) into this super special dish...

name: A Bag of Mora
description: The compensation you received from Woliu. It contains a sum of Mora satisfactory to both parties.

name: Woliu's Drilling Device
description: A box that contains a drilling device. Who knows what it'll dig up, exactly...

name: Autumn's Gift
description: A musical toy sold at Bertin's House of Curiosities. It is very popular among children. This one appears to have been bought a long while back and is no longer the latest model available in the store.\nPresents are for sending to people, and if they cannot be sent to their original destination, then let them at least be left with one who will treasure them.

name: Mysterious Xenochromatic Crystal
description: A large crystal obtained by defeating extremely powerful Fontemer Aberrants.\nThe power it contains is more mysterious than common Xenochromatic Crystals.\nMaybe someone will be willing to pay the right price for it.

name: Recruitment Notice
description: Instructions filled in by Benoit Leroy. A map has been kindly appended to the address.

name: Map Fragment
description: A damaged piece of paper that looks like the bottom-right corner of a map. There are strange points and lines drawn on it.

name: Small Key
description: A small key that can even be used as a bookmark. Why was it not confiscated? And why does such a tiny key open such an important door?

name: Carp Spirit Orb
description: An orb that was inlaid on the Golden Carp Fish statue. It contains an immense amount of adeptal energy.

name: Ruin Machine Core
description: A power supply mechanism discovered in the ruins of Chenyu Vale. The residual energy within seems enough to activate one more Ruin Guard.

name: Jade Fragment (Left)
description: A jade fragment with adeptal energy lingering around it. In the legends told by the ancestral peoples, all jades originally came from the same stone. If that holds true, it might be possible to join the jade fragments together...

name: Jade Fragment (Right)
description: A jade fragment with adeptal energy lingering around it. In the legends told by the ancestral peoples, all jades originally came from the same stone. If that holds true, it might be possible to join the jade fragments together...

name: Fragrant Wood "Huangcong"
description: An exquisitely carved piece of fragrant wood that is used in ceremonial rites and exudes a light fragrance. Judging from its shape, there seems to be another piece of fragrant wood to complement this one.

name: Fragrant Wood "Chizhang"
description: An exquisitely carved piece of fragrant wood that is used in ceremonial rites and gives off the scent of something burnt. Judging from its shape, there seems to be another piece of fragrant wood to complement this one.

name: "Our Chenyu Vale Trek" Album
description: A commemorative photo album containing many marvelous pictures. Shockingly, over half were taken by the same person.

name: Ancient Autoharmonic Music Box
description: An ancient music box found in the Faded Castle. It contains the mysterious power of the Symphony.\nUse it to read musical scores left by the ancient civilization. Find more scores to unlock the civilization's secrets.

name: Strange Key
description: A strange key. Who knows what lock it opens...

name: Blank Score
description: This seems to be a musical score created using unknown materials by an ancient civilization.\nIts staves lie empty. No notes have ever been recorded here.

name: Ancient Score
description: This seems to be a musical score created using unknown materials by an ancient civilization.\nThe melody recorded within can only be deciphered using a special device.

name: Lost Grimoire
description: A strange book of magic that has, by the "symphony"'s power, calmed down at last.\nIf you have the chance, you might want to return it to its shelf.

name: Shooting Practice Optical Lenses
description: An optical array provided by Special Security and Surveillance Patrol member Turenna. It appears to use some hard-to-grasp imaging techniques in conjunction with the sand table device from the "Thousand-Pace Interdiction Arcminute Sharpshooting Zone" to simulate using a musket to shoot at one's foes.\nThough this is considered in many ways insufficient for actual Patrol members' training regimens, it is more than enough to drum up interest in muskets and musketry, in developing one's talents for such, and for using such gifts for good.

name: Perinheri (I)
description: This text is also known as "Hleobranto Innamorato." The author of the first edition claims to have based this tale on a legendary story known throughout Khaenri'ah, but there are none left who can verify this. It is an anthological work produced over several generations at this point.

name: Perinheri (II)
description: This text is also known as "Hleobranto Innamorato." The author of the first edition claims to have based this tale on a legendary story known throughout Khaenri'ah, but there are none left who can verify this. It is an anthological work produced over several generations at this point.

name: Anecdota Septentrionalis (I)
description: An ancient Remurian scroll you accidentally discovered in the ruins. There is no way to verify the truth of the words within.

name: Anecdota Septentrionalis (II)
description: An ancient Remurian scroll you accidentally discovered in the ruins. There is no way to verify the truth of the words within.

description: Recruitment Notice

description: Note, Readable

description: Bracari's General Store Receipt

name: Ancient Stone Tablet
description: Ancient Stone Tablet

name: Autumn's Gift
description: A musical toy sold at Bertin's House of Curiosities. It is very popular among children. This one appears to have been bought a long while back and is no longer the latest model available in the store.\nThe chiming tune played in your palm takes the place of all the words that could not be said. This present, which could not be sent, has been forsaken, and is thus now yours.

name: Package for the Leroy Family
description: The newspaper deliveryperson, Pip, has stuffed the papers that the Leroy family has not collected during this time into this package.

name: Chioriya Boutique - Darkness Disguised Behind a Facade of Fashion
Lovely Lumitoile
description: A Lumitoile collected from the seafloor. The shape is stellar and the color charming. It should be usable as a clothing accessory.

name: Forgotten Key (I)
description: A key that seems to have been lost in the wilderness of Chenyu Vale. What could it be used for...?

name: Forgotten Key (II)
description: A key that seems to have been lost in the wilderness of Chenyu Vale. What could it be used for...?

name: Cultivation Area Expansion (I)
description: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

name: Cultivation Area Expansion (II)
description: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

description: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

description: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

name: Cultivation Area Expansion (V)
description: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

name: Cultivation Area Expansion (VI)
description: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

name: Improved Alchemy Cauldron (I)
description: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

name: Improved Alchemy Cauldron (II)
description: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

name: Improved Alchemy Cauldron (III)
description: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

name: Improved Alchemy Cauldron (IV)
description: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

name: Angled Drop Bottle
description: A potion bottle with very distinctive angles, like a chiseled drop of water. When it comes to precious alchemical potions, not a single drop may be wasted...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

name: Heartstopping Heart Bottle
description: A potion bottle with a tall stem with a heart-shaped design. It is said that customers will find it aesthetically appealing no matter the color of the potion within...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

name: Tranquil Bay Bottle
description: A cleverly crafted bottle with a unique long neck design. They say that the designer of the bottle compared it to a "tranquil bay"...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

name: Gorgeous Gem Bottle
description: A potion bottle with a narrow mouth and wide body. The interweaving of a multitude of straight lines gives it the outward appearance of a large gemstone, bestowing it with an extra-luxurious look in the eyes of customers...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

name: Chonky Cat Bottle
description: A potion bottle with a round, curvy design, like a fat feline's head. The attention of customers who like cuteness is easily drawn to these bottles...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

name: Windwheel Aster's Aroma
description: A bottle decoration made from the combination of a Windwheel Aster and emerald-green leaves. It seems to be able to envelop the potion in a gentle breeze...

name: Resplendent as a Crystalfly
description: An especially eye-catching bottle decoration fashioned in the shape of a Crystalfly that can sometimes grab the attention of customers in an instant...

name: Perfect Gift Ribbon
description: A bottle ornament that is shaped like a ribbon tied into a bow. It seems to give the potions a feeling similar to that of a gift box, bursting with promises of pleasant surprises...

name: Raspberry-Red Flying Flower Feather
description: A feather-shaped bottle ornament sprinkled with berry-red that is said to easily be associated by customers with the image of birds in flight...

name: Gold Gild and Emerald
description: A bottle ornament with a golden frame and the appearance of an emerald gem. The "gemstone" is made of glass, and balances aesthetic appeal with cost...

name: Shop Decoration: Blooming Morale
description: A decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop. A beautiful double-layered flower bed, it is said to have been donated by a certain member of the Investigation Team as a "morale booster."

name: Shop Decoration: Blooming Atmosphere
description: A decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop. An array of blue and beige colored flowers, it was supposedly created by a certain member of the Logistics Company as an "item to build up the atmosphere."

name: Shop Decoration: Potent Potions
description: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, it can be hung from the shop roof, and the pictured potion uses a classic shape that most people associate with...

name: Shop Decoration: Portentous Potions
description: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, it is also used to advertise the alchemy shop throughout Mondstadt. The pictured potion uses a classic shape that most people associate with...

name: Shop Decoration: Prismatic Effects
description: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, many small multicolored flags are hung from it, and the "prismatic" effect is said to be symbolic of the many myriad effects of the wondrous potions sold...

name: Sales Expansion Contract
description: Engage an additional distributor.

name: Xuanlian Sacred Water
description: If not for its name, this so-called "sacred water" sourced from the vicinity of Mt. Xuanlian would never have been regarded as anything special. On the contrary, when looking at it after knowing its name, you feel like you can see some adeptal aura rising from the water.

name: Ancient Jade Cup
description: An ancient teacup that seems to have been lost in the wilderness. It seems to exude a faint adeptal aura.

name: Someone's Ledger
description: This ledger found in the Wangshan Hall contains detailed records of every last income and expenditure item.

name: Votive Rainjade
description: The final gemstone hurled by the Adeptus Fujin in ancient times. Although it looks pretty much the same as other ordinary jade stones, it contains enough adeptal energy to transform the nearby water and land in an instant...

name: Chizhang Map
description: The location of the warehouse seems to be recorded on this map the Millelith left behind.

name: Mini Phonograph
description: A miniaturized phonograph that appears to have recorded certain sounds. It might perhaps come in handy...?

name: Ancient City Key
description: It seems that this long-rusted key can be used to open a long-abandoned warehouse somewhere along the Chizhang Wall.

name: Rust-Worn Key
description: Although this key, which you found in Chenyu Vale, is covered in rust, it looks like it can still be used...

name: Beauteous Beryl Conch
description: A Beryl Conch collected from the seafloor. The shape is stellar and the color charming. It should be usable as a clothing accessory.

name: Ravishing Romaritime Flower
description: A Romaritime Flower collected from the seafloor. The shape is stellar and the color charming. It should be usable as a clothing accessory.

name: Fish Seized From a Pelican's Mouth
description: A fish you managed to retrieve from the mouth of a pelican at the Qiaoying Village docks. It seems to be an item that other creatures treasure greatly, so you might be able to make amends for a certain loss from a certain time by returning this to the daily feeding vessel of certain animals...

name: Yellow Obsidian Fragment
description: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Children of Echoes, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

name: Yellow Obsidian Ring
description: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Children of Echoes. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

name: Invitation From the Arataki Gang
description: An invitation letter that is loud and colorful in both cast and content. It describes a passionate, freeform, wild, huge, border-crossin' rock 'n' roll festival, in which you shall be a special guest, there to awaken the burning rock 'n' roll soul within all present!

name: Witness Pact
description: A document that seems to be of considerable age. Who knows how long it's been here?

name: Great Clockwork Key
description: A clockwork device preserved to a very high standard. One can only wonder what mysterious power deserves such fine treatment.

name: Felix Felicium
description: A peculiar potion Lisa concocted for you that seems to shine with a golden sheen. It is said to bring the user good luck, ensuring all their every endeavor will succeed until the effects wear off. As the ingredients required are exceedingly rare, and the brewing process devilishly complex, only a few have succeeded in concocting it.

name: Concentrated Transoceanic Pearl
description: A special ingredient on the list that Sigewinne gave. Must be obtained from specific Fontemer Aberrants.

name: Tainted Hydro Phantasm Extract
description: A special ingredient on the list that Sigewinne gave. Must be obtained from specific Tainted Hydro Phantasms.

name: Courier's Trial Keystone
description: A stone mechanism used to unlock the gates of ancient altars. Among the Scions of the Canopy, this mechanism serves as a trial machine, where only the most experienced couriers are said to be able to acquire all three keystones in a short span of time.

name: Lynette's Envelope
description: An envelope that belongs only to Lynette. Her name is penned on the back, and it contains a group photo and a photo of her on stage. The "threatening letter" has been stuffed in there, too.

name: Talisman of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan
description: The talisman of the Sage of the Stolen Flame. It is said that the sage who once stole phlogiston from a dragon's claws left this behind as proof of a pact made with the tribes.

name: Restored Score
description: The once-tattered score has been restored. Someone learned in music will surely be able to read the ancient melody contained within.

name: Pages From a Lost Score (I)
description: A fragment of an ancient musical score. Indecipherable in its current form.

name: A Ridiculously Common Branch
description: A very ordinary branch that has been processed by human hands in some way.\nIt might have been a prop used by children at play... But whatever it is, it couldn't have been some "barbarian token"...

name: Cultivation Area Expansion (VII)
description: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

name: Alchemeter
description: A custom Knights of Favonius device used to analyze alchemical ingredients. Place any alchemical shop ingredients within to analyze their special characteristics and increase the corresponding "ingredient level," allowing the efficacy of concocted potions to be increased in various ways...

name: "I Got Reincarnated as an Onikabuto... And Flipped the World Upside Down"
description: Some light rock 'n' roll lyrics... or perhaps just bad poetry?

name: Mysterious Letter
description: Mysterious Letter

name: Cyno's Letter
description: Cyno's Letter

name: Damaged Score
description: Damaged Score

name: Key With Frontal Notches
description: A key to a Saurian Cart with notched patterns that tend toward the key's front. Normally, local residents only transport Saurians in wooden carts when they can no longer move on their own power.

name: Key With Centered Notches
description: A key to a Saurian Cart with notched patterns that are right smack in the key's center. Although they call these "Saurian carts," what usually happens is that the Saurian will pull the cart while someone sits on it.

name: Key With Rear Notches
description: A key to a Saurian Cart with notched patterns that tend toward its rear. Perhaps this might open the door of quite a special cart indeed.

name: Brickstacks Long-Range Lamp
description: A lamp that once hung in the Brickstacks Lighthouse. It shines brightly still, despite having been removed.

name: A "Weapon-Like" Dragon Horn
description: A dragon horn that resembles a sword. It seems to have once belonged to a reckless dragon...

name: Fell Dragon's Scale
description: A scale from which an ominous power radiates. They say that the fell dragon of Simulanka dropped this.

name: Criminal's Testimony
description: Criminal testimonies compiled by Morgane. They record the results of today's interrogation.

name: Rawat's Notes
description: A page of a notebook you found in a cupboard within Rawat's mother's residence. It marks out a location north of the Fontaine Research Institute.

name: Scattered Star
description: A star that once hung high above Constellation Metropole. For some reason, it has fallen from the sky...

name: Group Photo From an Unknown Time
description: A precious group photo that has surpassed the rules somehow, being taken by some unknown person using unknown means in a space that should no longer exist.

name: Artisan's Memo (II)
description: Artisan's Memo

name: Holy Sovereign's Notes (I)
description: Holy Sovereign's Notes (I)

name: Holy Sovereign's Notes (II)
description: Holy Sovereign's Notes (II)

description: Holy Sovereign's Notes (III)

description: Holy Sovereign's Notes (V)

description: Holy Sovereign's Notes (VI)

description: Restored Score

name: Ruggiero's Notes (II)
description: Ruggiero's Map

name: Green Obsidian Fragment
description: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Scions of the Canopy, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

name: Green Obsidian Ring
description: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Scions of the Canopy. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

name: Azure Obsidian Fragment
description: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the People of the Springs, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

name: Azure Obsidian Ring
description: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the People of the Springs. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

name: Night Jade
description: A nearly weightless black jade, enveloped in chilling flames. According to Natlan's legends, offering it at a specific altar might just open the path to the kingdom ruled by the night.

name: Pages From a Lost Score (II)
description: A fragment of an ancient musical score. Indecipherable in its current form.

name: Special Pickaxe
description: A special pickaxe used to excavate toytanium. It has the special power to slice through layers of rock, but will not harm said toytanium or any resident of Simulanka.

name: Goddess's Manuscript (I)
description: A story written by the creator of this world. This is the blueprint that birthed Simulanka, a history that brooks no doubt.

name: Goddess's Manuscript (II)
description: A handwritten manuscript penned by a fairytale writer. For some reason, there is a hole in the paper that resembles...

name: Goddess's Manuscript (III)
description: A mere fairytale, penned by most mundane hands. If you look closely, the holes in the paper were made by a cat's paw...

name: "Secret Elixir"
description: Said to be a secret elixir that belongs to the empathy clan, capable of increasing both the size and strength of residents of Constellation Metropole. Really, though, does this container really contain such a medicine?

name: Guard's Spear
description: A long spear wielded by Constellation Metropole guards. Well-centered and elegant, you could throw it from ground level and strike down a flying dragon.

name: Star Shard
description: A strange fragment that Orqo termed a Star Shard.

name: Group Photo From an Unknown Time
description: A precious group photo that has surpassed the rules somehow, being taken by some unknown person using unknown means in a space that should no longer exist.

name: Crude Obsidian Statue
description: A uniquely sculpted obsidian statue with very distinctive contours. It was once used by the people of Natlan as a medium to communicate with the "Night Kingdom."

name: Red Metal Key
description: A key you found in the Sulfurous Veins. Who knows where the door it unlocks may lead...

name: "Treasure Map" With the Vault's Location
description: A Treasure Map given to you by Florian, the "guard." It is said that within the vault it will lead you to, the Marechaussee Hunters of the past left behind a treasure with the power to defeat the evil sorcerer...

name: "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day" Character Album
description: A book that commemorates the participants in this game of "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day." For both players and Game Master, it is full of memories of your adventures together. "And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

description: A special "pass" with green patterns drawn along its edges. It is not clear exactly what material this is made of, and it makes a rustling noise when you rub it. On one corner, it reads "If you have picked this up accidentally, please return it promptly to..." A small map has also been drawn on it.

description: Ancient Piece of Paper

name: Water-Rusted Key
description: A key that soaked in water for a long, long time. Who knows if it can even unlock the door it was made to open anymore...

name: Ancient Jadestone Fragment
description: A strange fragment picked up in the ancient ruins of Natlan. The exact material it is made from is hard to determine.\nFor some reason it feels warm to the touch.

name: Perfect Heart of the Sacred Dragon
description: A flawless piece of jade. Before the fires of human civilization had ever been kindled, it was the heart of the Dragonlord Ix Uxul Tz'ib Bolon Ch'ule-L, ruler of Chichen Uctokah.\nIt once held the authority to command all devices within Ochkanatlan, the ineffable city, yet can no longer be used due to its energy having been completely exhausted.\nJust as with the half-humans who pursued it so relentlessly, the Dragonlord's quest for perfection was ultimately in vain, leading to naught but an end that was as cold and lifeless as jade.

name: Production Log
description: Production Log

name: Experiment Log
description: Experiment Log

name: Fresh Sour Sauce Ceviche
description: Raw pieces of fish with a fruity fragrance. The sheer fragrance bowls you over in the first wave, with sourness and spiciness bringing up the rear, granting this fish layers akin to the tides, with you the surfer on a sea of flavor. Even when the tumult has subsided, your yearning remains.

name: A Gem Meant as a Gift
description: A crystal-clear yellow gemstone. Paimon intends to give it to your Saurian companion... but you'll need to process the gem well before it's truly ready to be given away as a gift...

name: Jewel Artisan's Toolbox
description: A suitcase that contains all the tools used by the "Gem Master" Kulahaw when working gems. Some of the tools within are not expensive, but they sure are handy.

name: Jewel Artisan's Box of Parts
description: A suitcase containing parts required for jewel processing by "Gem Master" Kulahaw. The components inside are all made of precious materials.

name: Phlogiston Energy Orb for Gathering
description: Phlogiston Energy Orb

name: Iridescent Inscription Fragment
description: A fragment of a shattered Iridescent Inscription. It is broken beyond repair and can no longer serve its purpose. Though dismissed by many as delusional obsession, some still believe they hold the key to unraveling messages from ancient civilizations.

name: Golden Entreaty
description: A white disc retrieved from the ruins of the Sage of the Stolen Flame. It is one of the essential tokens required to journey to the Great Volcano of Tollan and remove the "Flamelord's Blessing" from the little Tepetlisaur's back. Golden inscriptions are etched into the surface of the white disc, and when touched, one can sense the intricate patterns pulsating as if imbued with life.

name: Cazcal's "Hora Special Care Kit"
description: A set of specialized Saurian care tools personally crafted by Cazcal. Each one has been specially modified for Hora's particular needs.

name: "Uthabiti"
description: Kachina's Ancient Name. This plain, unadorned obsidian seems to be a bit heavier than expected. It is said you can use it to find Kachina's approximate location...

name: Purpose-Built Grappling Hook
description: A specialized grappling hook used by the Scions of the Canopy that is exceptionally safe. It's quite popular for both rock climbing and to assist with rapid descents.

name: Ordinary Obsidian
description: A simple, unadorned piece of obsidian that can become a vessel for an Ancient Name.

name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (I)
description: The binding and layout are exquisitely made, but the actual content is all handwritten. Judging from the handwriting, there is more than one author. "Don't fuss about WHAT we're writing, the cover needs to look good! That's the only way it'll give off that 'masterpiece' feeling."

name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (II)
description: "You're more than halfway through and you haven't even pushed the plot forward one iota! Why is it all about the setting!?" "And what would you know? Besides, this stuff isn't fleshing the setting out. It's elucidating natural science and other miscellaneous disciplines!"

name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (III)
description: Some mysterious handwriting appears before the main text: "It's so rare for R to be in her right mind for a spell. Should she really be wasting the precious little lucid time she has writing this?" "Don't worry. For a witch, this is the most important thing."

name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (IV)
description: Some mysterious handwriting appears before the main text: "Tsaritsa be good, how are there this many unresolved plot threads? Please, have mercy on these old bones, would you?"

name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (V)
description: The writing here is practically a messy scrawl. Perhaps the author doesn't really write much, or perhaps something happened.

name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (VI)
description: "Is it still necessary to write this, the present moment being what it is?" "Allow me, then. Opportunities to return to this world are few and far between. Alice would think the same: If we don't continue, then everything would have been meaningless from the start."

name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (VII)
description: The binding and layout are exquisitely made, but the actual content is all handwritten. Judging from the handwriting, there is more than one author. "I have already found the meaning of writing — that is to tell you: I do so wish you were here, too."

name: The Feline Firm (I)
description: One day, the mysterious Feline Firm sends an invitation to the doorman Perroux... Just what kind of adventures await him?

name: The Feline Firm (II)
description: Having deciphered the Felinese spell, Perroux finds the entrance to the firm, and just like that, "jumps into the shadows beneath"... And then?

name: The Feline Firm (III)
description: The cat with the full-sleeve arm tattoo completed the ever-snoring cat boss's commission, but what did the other do? Perroux's curiosity remained unabated...

name: The Feline Firm (IV)
description: Even the Feline Firm, which has seen nearly everything, can find itself at a loss from time to time. Just what devilish difficulty has confounded the conceited tabby boss that he must seek succor from Perroux?

name: The Feline Firm (V)
description: A cat's magical boots and a cat's mysterious mask. Just how will they bring the long-furred cat to the Feline Firm?

name: The Feline Firm (VI)
description: Witnessed by all the cats and the Master, will the tabby cat and the long-furred cat get hitched without a hitch, becoming cat husband-and-wife... or...?

name: The Feline Firm (VII)
description: "Run, Perroux, run!" — For the Perroux that had grown cat ears, these words alone remained ringing in his mind...

name: The Feline Firm (VIII)
description: "That said, it seems the Master has come into another springtime of love?" whispered the servants...\nBut this was something that happened much later.

name: Broken, Graffiti-Marked Stone
description: Part of graffiti art that was once painted onto a wall. Perhaps, if you can put it back in place, you can see what the art was about...

name: Shattered Night Jade
description: A nearly weightless black jade, enveloped in chilling flames. If it could be pieced together, perhaps something extraordinary might happen...

name: Ancient Flint Key
description: A uniquely shaped key. It seems like rotating it to different angles will enable it to fit into various locks...

name: Contending Spark
description: Small sparks born from conflict. They are precisely the forces that eternally sustain the Sacred Flame.

name: "A Setting Sun That Never Sets"
description: A Sunsettia that grows within Simulanka. It can seemingly be used to make the Magic Tonic of the Forest of Blessings.

name: "A Dragon That Cannot Fly"
description: A Snapdragon that grows in Simulanka. It can seemingly be used to make the Magic Tonic of the Forest of Blessings.

name: "A Moon That Only Shines At Night"
description: A Nilotpala Lotus that grows in Simulanka. It can seemingly be used to make the Magic Tonic of the Forest of Blessings.

name: Magic Tonic
description: Mystical ink created by the Forest Fairy using magic. It seems to be very important to those who dwell in the Forest of Blessings.

name: Ogun's Testimony
description: A record of Ogun's testimony. It contains clearly-listed information on the time of Crafting Bench usage and purpose, and the victim's condition.

name: Pampa's Testimony
description: A record of Pampa's testimony. Many exaggerations and redundancies in information make this one much harder to parse.

name: The Locusts' Purchase Invoice
description: Amidst these items, only the reason for and quantity of the Loach Pearl purchase seems out of place.

name: Anela's Testimony
description: A record of Anela's testimony. Seems like the content is not short on criticism of the Hawkwings, either...

name: Key From a Balloon Platform
description: It looks like it's for opening a cage from a camp below a hot air balloon somewhere... But would someone really be kept in a cage like that?

name: Fell Dragon's Picturebook
description: A picture book that concerns the "fell dragon of Simulanka" — that is to say, Durin. None know the tales that are recorded in this text.

name: Dreams of the Ancient Capital
description: A book about a young woman named Lycia who sets out on a journey alone following the ruination of her homeland at the hands of a black dragon.

name: Missing Package
description: An express delivery package misplaced by a careless courier. It appears slightly worn. Better hurry and deliver it to Michica.

name: Damaged Package
description: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the packaging: "From... Palette... cat..."

name: Damaged Letter
description: A letter with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the envelope: "From... anca..."

name: Slightly Squashed Package
description: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the packaging: "Gemporium... Im..."

name: Torn Letter
description: A letter with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the envelope: "From... irda..."

name: Acat's Package
description: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, the letter inside belongs to Acat, the owner of "Frida's Palette" located in the Stadium of the Sacred Flame.

name: Chanca's Letter
description: A letter with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, the letter belongs to Chanca, the owner of "Weary Inn" located in the Stadium of the Sacred Flame.

name: Imix's Package
description: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, this package contains an invoice belonging to Imix, who can often be found at "Muhuru's Gemporium."

name: Tirda's Letter
description: A letter with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, this letter belongs to Tirda, who is often found at "Golden Dusk."

name: Map Left Behind by the First Chief
description: A map left behind by the first chief of the People of the Springs. It is said to indicate the route to the mysterious island, yet only skilled guides can decipher its secrets.

name: Amina's Coin Pouch
description: A coin pouch that Amina gave you. Inside are funds to deal with scams.

name: Kaulu's Recommended Expedition Equipment
description: Expedition equipment that Kaulu recommended you purchase. Though very expensive, the quality doesn't seem to be as good as he made it out to be.

name: Photo With Ata
description: A photo with Ata, the Koholasaurus elder. Paimon seems to love it.

name: Expedition Equipment Purchased by Mualani
description: High-end camping gear that Mualani has bought for this adventure.

name: Path of Turnfire
description: An illustration of the Turnfire Night ritual. It resembles the Scions of the Canopy's totem.

name: Mementos of Teyvat Album
description: #An album that features many of {NICKNAME} and Paimon's mementos of their adventures. Your adventure is not yet over, and you will certainly create many more memories in the future! This album is probably far too thin to contain all the pictures you've taken and will take, so after it's been filled, don't forget to go buy a new one with Paimon!

name: Dopey Dazzler's Notes on Graffiti
description: A notebook written by the Graffiti Alliance member Dopey Dazzler, discussing what she knows of the art of graffiti. It describes some of the ideas behind creating "avant-garde" works and seems to be a gift she prepared for a star of the graffiti scene who has yet to arise...

name: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (I)
description: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (I)

name: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (II)
description: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (II)

name: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (III)
description: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (III)

name: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (IV)
description: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (IV)

name: Fresh Sprayfeather Gill
description: Sprayfeather Gill that has been freshly picked. They said that its extracted juice can help you deceive a Koholasaurus's sense of smell.

name: Amina's Compensation
description: Remuneration from Amina, as a token of appreciation for helping to convict the scammer "guide."

name: Key to Somewhere
description: A metal key that can be found practically everywhere. Just like every lock has a key, sure there's a door out there somewhere it can open...

name: Expedition Equipment Purchased by Mualani
description: High-end camping gear and a special record player model that Mualani has bought for this adventure.

name: Expedition Equipment Purchased by Mualani
description: Various items that Mualani purchased for this adventure. Camping equipment is a necessity, of course, and the record player and records are for... entertainment during rest time, you suppose?

name: Photo With Ata
description: A photo with Ata, the Koholasaurus elder. Paimon seems to love it.

name: Commemorative Photo of You and Mualani
description: This memento that you took together captures the moment after you and Mualani completed the journey to the mysterious island with each other's help.

name: Commemorative Photo of You and Mualani
description: This memento that you took together captures the moment after you and Mualani completed the journey to the mysterious island with each other's help.

name: Shiny Shell
description: A strangely-shaped shell that you chanced upon in Toyac Springs. Whether or not it can be put to any use is unclear, but nevertheless, Paimon still likes it.

name: Atea's Talisman
description:
"Sometimes I wonder — what if the hot springs were never to dry, nor friends to say goodbye..."
"If this land was no longer plagued by darkness, and our children could relish the joys within their reach, free from both care and worry..."
"If a world like that could really exist, just knowing it could would be enough, even if I didn't live to see it... Mavuika, my hot spring buddy and the god I trust and follow..."
"The flames bind us close, and even death cannot part us. Natlan is with you, and no one fights alone."

name: Wooden Model Alpaca
description: An Alpaca model that shows signs of having been hit all over. This heavy object seems to need to be placed at a spot marked with graffiti...

name: Strange Saurian Cart Key
description: A Saurian Cart's key that opens a cart somewhere.

name: Note Left Inside a Treasure Chest
Research Center Emergency Machine Operation Handbook
description: Research Center Emergency Machine Operation Handbook

name: Maawe and Monetoo (I)
description: A woven scroll from the People of the Springs telling of how Maawe the Saurian whelp created the hot spring. Different paragraphs of this seem to have been penned by poets of different eras.

name: Maawe and Monetoo (II)
description: A woven scroll from the People of the Springs telling of how Maawe the Saurian whelp created the hot spring. Different paragraphs of this seem to have been penned by poets of different eras.

name: Maawe and Monetoo (III)
description: A woven scroll from the People of the Springs telling of how Maawe the Saurian whelp created the hot spring. Different paragraphs of this seem to have been penned by poets of different eras.

name: Records of Hanan Pacha (I)
description: A fable, passed down from generation to generation, in which the legendary Sage of the Stolen Flame is the main protagonist. Professional historians, it is said, have analyzed its contents and come to a consensus that this tale has nothing to do with historical fact.

name: Records of Hanan Pacha (II)
description: A fable, passed down from generation to generation, in which the legendary Sage of the Stolen Flame is the main protagonist. Professional historians, it is said, have analyzed its contents and come to a consensus that this tale has nothing to do with historical fact.

name: Records of Hanan Pacha (III)

name: The Tale of Qoyllor and Ukuku
description: A long-standing Natlan folk tale that was originally told orally. As such, there is now no way of knowing who the original author was.

name: The Volcano Lord and the Shadow Pins
description: A woven scroll that depicts the legend of the hero Traore, a favorite among the children of the Nanatzcayan.

name: Rust-Spotted Key
description: A rusty key that you might be able to use to open a door somewhere...

name: Pilgrim's Chronicle
description: Obtained from the Lord of the Night, this material plays a key role in the creation of Ancient Names. Its essence is "memory," for Natlan's Ley Lines do not record the adventures of outsiders, and so, a special "vessel" is needed here.\nMemory flows within this receptacle, and if you focus on its surface, it will display the vital footprints you have left in Natlan.\nFrom what you've heard, Xilonen and Citlali had a rather easy time obtaining this material. This, you presume, is thanks to the Lord of the Night's gentleness and generosity.

name: Pyrophosphorite
description: An ordinary-looking stone that seems to be the key to unlocking the secrets hidden within the legendary Tonatiuh.

name: Dye Samples
description: Dye samples made from a special fruit, found deep within a cave. They seem to be the key to making that type of woven scroll.

description: Saurian medicine personally concocted by Mazkal. Its healing effect is outstanding.

name: Medicine of Superior Taste
description: Saurian medicine personally concocted by Mazkal that tastes absolutely amazing.

name: Scarlet Phlogiston Honey Pearl
description: An unpolluted Phlogiston Honey Pearl, and a gift from Xilonen.\nFrom the nearly-crimson color, you can tell that this is of the absolute highest quality.\nIn contrast to her words, the market value of this is astonishingly high.

name: Magnifico's "Masterpiece"
description: An unforgettable group photo with Magnifico's signature on the back: "Friends, even the smallest of trees can cast the biggest of shadows!"

name: Fires of Autumn Twilight (I)
description: A woven scroll from the Flower-Feather Clan. It seems like it consists of what were originally two separate stories from different eras that were then merged together at some unknown time.

name: Springs of Hidden Jade (II)

name: Mt. Lingmeng Gossip (I)
description: A book about the local folklore and ballads of Chenyu Vale. It contains many far-fetched folk legends.

description: A long-standing Natlan folk tale that was originally recounted orally. As such, there is now no way of knowing who the original author was.

name: Mysterious Weapon Fragment: Arrow Rest
description: A fragment of a weapon once wielded by Sanhaj Kompore, Border Master of the Masters of the Night-Wind. It was broken into its currents state during the great war five hundred years past. According to Granny Itztli's intuition, it may aid the Traveler in some inexplicable way at some future point in their journey.

name: Iktomi Scroll: Map
description: A woven scroll map, obtained through a clairvoyant vision, pointing to a mysterious place said to have vanished long ago — namely, the Mare Jivari.

name: Tepal's Tattered Notes
description: An incomplete notebook in which Tepal has recorded his obsessions and dreams.

name: Key Found by the "Painted Stone Challenge" Podium
description: A key you found by the "Painted Stone Challenge" podium. Going by the rules of common sense, you'd probably guess that the door it unlocks must be somewhere nearby said podium...

name: Secret Art Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
description: Grilled Fish doused in delicious sauce. Under your and Paimon's careful hands, the fish has been meticulously scored, stuffed with specially selected spices, then baked. Once cooked, a thick mint sauce is generously drizzled over the top. The refreshing aroma of the fish is enough to whet anyone's appetite.\nIf you can master the art of grilling fish this way, perhaps one day you and Paimon will earn the title of Grilled Fish Master Chefs...

name: Purple Obsidian Fragment
description: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Masters of the Night-Wind, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

name: Purple Obsidian Ring
description: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Masters of the Night-Wind. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

name: Crimson Obsidian Fragment
description: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Flower-Feather Clan, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

description: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Collective of Plenty, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

Captured Photos
description: A batch of photos you got from the Fatui that clearly shows the structure of the Remnants of the Secret Source in this place. This picture shows a special mechanism with a very noteworthy shape.

name: Nearby Flammabomb Wood
description: This tree has a rather frightening name, but is, in fact, not prone to spontaneous ignition. Its name simply comes from its striking crown, which resembles an exploding fireball...\nYou saw lumps of such processed wood scattered on the ground, yet no trees nearby that could produce it. Someone must have deliberately brought them here...

name: Nearby Ashen Aratiku Wood
description: A tree that can be found in a specific region in Natlan. Their numbers are few...\nYou saw lumps of such processed wood scattered on the ground, yet no trees nearby that could produce it. Someone must have deliberately brought them here...

name: A Nameless Adventurer's Notes
description: Notes left by an adventurer of an unknown era. In them, they recorded their adventures in Ochkanatlan.

name: Smooth-Bitted Key
description: A key with a smoothly curved bit, almost like an arc. Somewhere out there, perhaps there's a door it could easily open...

name: Straight-Bitted Key
description: A key with extremely straight bitting. Somewhere out there, perhaps there's a door it could easily open...

name: Messily-Bitted Key
description: A key with worn teeth that look quite messy after many years of action. Perhaps it requires a bit of "technique" to actually use...

name: Citlali's Handkerchief
description: A handkerchief that Citlali gave you as a gift. May its colors ever stay in your memory — as a present, and as a promise.

name: Legend-Inscribed Woven Scroll
description: A woven scroll that Citlali helped you complete. It chronicles the legendary battle you undertook to become a hero of Natlan.

name: "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power," First Edition
description: The first edition of "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power." A very costly item to collect on account of its limited print run.

name: "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?" Limited Deluxe Edition
description: The limited deluxe edition of "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?" The Yae Publishing House released this limited print run in response to its readers. Stocks were all but emptied out the instant these came to market, making them a much sought-after collector's item amongst light novel lovers.

name: Citlali's Handkerchief and Key
description: The key given to you by Citlali so that "you won't wake me up by beating on my door while I'm drunk." You carefully place it alongside the handkerchief she gave you. After all, you've collected so many keys in the past, so this one needs to have a special mark to stand out.

name: Golden Entreaty
description: A white disc retrieved from the ruler of Cinder City's corroded ruins within Ochkanatlan. It is one of the essential tokens required to journey to the Great Volcano of Tollan and remove the "Flamelord's Blessing" from the little Tepetlisaur's body, and is said to have been one of the fragments left behind when the Flamelord's eye was split in two. According to legend, it is said that the ancient Dragonlord — who once held dominion over all light and wisdom — transformed one of his eyes into a conduit of supreme authority by which all flames might be governed, and that this became his only exploitable weakness...

name: Helka's Notes
description: Notes written on pieces of paper printed with conch patterns.\nThese seem to be drafts made in preparation for composing a monster picture book, and apart from records and descriptions, they also contain some information intended for a companion. Perhaps someone might have switched the copy out for the original by mistake...

name: A "Gift Envelope" From Paimon
description: To my best— no, bestest travel companion ever!!!

name: Emblem of Valor
description: A commemorative portrait of you and your companions, which you obtained after assisting the combat readiness liaison Irade with stage certification.\nAccording to her, after having been crafted by three masters and certified by you, the stages may now have reached such a level of perfection as to require no further iteration. They will surely become the first port of call for warriors looking to challenge themselves and hone their martial prowess...

name: Special Commemorative Letter
description: A souvenir obtained after assisting the combat readiness liaison in testing and certifying various stages...\nComplete the Archon Quest "Incandescent Ode of Resurrection" to use, thereby earning an "Emblem of Steadfast Valor" as a special gift.

description: A credit coupon given to you by Mizuki which allows you to visit the Aisa Bathhouse after hours. With this, you'll not only not disturb others, but more importantly, others are guaranteed not to disturb you.

name: Leafy Dreams
description: An album given to you by Kinkaku and co. that is said to be able to transform and preserve recent wonderful memories. For some reason, when you open its pages, you are greeted by the scent of fresh leaves...

name: Rattan Toy: Hu Tao
description: A rattan figure that Lan Yan made specially for Hu Tao. It contains mysterious spellwork that can be used to distribute Fetor for the latter. However, due to your special relationship with the Ley Lines, your rattan figure cannot be linked up to the array...

name: Hu Tao: Plum Branch
description: The night was suddenly filled with the fragrance of plum blossoms, spreading across the springtime sky and land.

name: Zhongli: Rex Coin
description: A Fortune Coin with a special Guyan Sigil engraved into it. It is said that this is the symbol of Rex Lapis, and can be used as a protective talisman.

name: Rattan Toy
description: A rattan toy left behind by someone, perhaps Lan Yan. It is slightly different from the ones at the fair, having a mysterious sigil stuck to it, indicating some other purpose.

description: Crackers shaped like little Saurians. The enticing aroma of butter draws forth the delightful, irresistible interplay between the Cacahuatl and Grainfruit, while the cute shapes make them truly hard to put down... Be that as it may, you received these treats on the parade of blessings and it might be nicer to keep them as an uneaten memento.

name: That Which Was Once Ehecatl
description: A small-scale Secret Source Automaton. Now that it has lost all power, all that is left are echoes in an empty shell. It shows clear signs of careful maintenance, which afforded it brief function once reactivated, even after being lost in the outside world for so long.

name: Aisa Bathhouse VIP Pass
description: A beautifully crafted invitation letter that emits a faint yet beguiling scent. It's claimed that such letters are sent to only the most valued of customers. The letter contains the establishment's location and introduces its three primary services.

name: Mysterious Gift
description: A gift gained from playing games at the Mikawa Flower Festival. It appears to be an exquisitely-made furnishing...

name: Glimpses of Mysterious Inazuma (I)
description: A collection of Inazuman folk stories transcribed by a traveling writer from Fontaine. Its pages contain a wealth of myths and strange tales passed down orally by people from all over Inazuma.

name: Glimpses of Mysterious Inazuma (II)
description: A collection of Inazuman folk stories transcribed by a traveling writer from Fontaine. Its pages contain a wealth of myths and strange tales passed down orally by people from all over Inazuma.

name: Men of Lithin (I)
description: A fantasy novel doing the rounds among the tribes of Natlan that is said to be translated from a popular work by the reputedly famous Fontainian author K'n-yan. The Natlanese who have visited the Court of Fontaine, however, claim to have been unable to find the original — nor has anyone managed to find a local who's ever heard of an author named "K'n-yan".

name: Men of Lithin (II)
description: A fantasy novel doing the rounds among the tribes of Natlan that is said to be translated from a popular work by the reputedly famous Fontainian author K'n-yan. name: Green Berryshroom
description: An ordinary-looking mushroom with an extraordinary flavor. Only grows near the orchard at Varesa's house. They're fast growers, so if you see one, eat it quickly.

name: Permit to the Sacred Heart
description: An unadorned scale obtained from the Chamber of Deliberation and activated by the Secret Source Servant, Awanyu. It grants access to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain. Most dragon scales discolor and fade to white once removed from their masters as they lose the power that once ran through them. Yet this one, despite its long history, still glows gold in the darkness, displaying its might for all to see.

name: Phlogiston Unit
description: A replaceable resource unit created by the ancient inhabitants of this place by harnessing the properties of Phlogiston. All Secret Source Automatons require Phlogiston Units to work, though the exact specifications of the units required depend on the complexity of each automaton's operations.

name: Fusion Profusion: DJ Remix Selections
description: A series of songs handpicked by Xilonen that have earned her recognition, a selection truly unique to Natlan. Includes a "Master Xilonen Commemorative Photo" commissioned by several DJs. \nHowever, it seems that this record can only sound its best on professional equipment such as the Dance-Off Stage, and using unsuitable equipment may damage the disc surface... In any case, it makes for a one-of-a-kind collector's item and keepsake!

name: Café Lutece House Grounds
description: Coffee procured exclusively for Café Lutece. The smell alone is enough to sharpen your senses. Make sure to bring it to Escoffier.

name: Kompore the Cunning (I)
description: Said to be a tapestry personally woven by Master Sanhaj Kompore, its contents are both short and strange. Generally believed to be a work of pure fiction.

description: Said to be a tapestry personally woven by Master Sanhaj Kompore, its contents are both short and strange. Generally believed to be a work of pure fiction.

description: A woven scroll passed down for generations in the Children of Echoes. It tells the legend of a young Sundjatta from 500 years ago.

name: Rangi Nui's End
description: An ancient folk song from the People of the Springs. It describes the tale of the legendary hero, Rangi Nui.

name: The Headless Coquitao (I)
description: A woven scroll from the Masters of the Night-Wind. It is said that the stories within are older than the tribe itself, a claim that remains difficult to verify.

name: The Headless Coquitao (II)
description: A woven scroll from the Masters of the Night-Wind. It is said that the stories within are older than the tribe itself, a claim that remains difficult to verify.

name: Photo With Travel Companions
description: A photo of you and your travel companions; a memento of a land where humans and saurians coexist. Though our paths may eventually diverge, the memories we create together shall never fade.

description: A memento to remind you of the roaring success that you and your companions achieved with the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland. You drew this map together in a whimsical, storybook style, ensuring every enchanting attraction and adorable landmark stands out. Of course, the most important features are the friends who came to visit. Following Furina's advice, you added a snowy white beard to her portrait, like a coating of sweet cream, making sure the entire map "sounds delicious"...

name: Easybreeze Album
description: An album filled with precious memories from your time at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort. The Asha painted on the vibrant cover looks as though it's dancing.\nThe lilting melody of your holiday still lingers on the breeze, like an old friend from a distant land waiting for the chance to greet you once more.

name: Hand-Drawn Map
description: A map from Albedo's manuscript. There are three locations marked on it.

name: Mysterious Map
description: A map from Albedo's manuscript.

name: Wonderland Cosmosphere
description: One of the keys to the Miliastra Wonderland, this glittering crystal ball, adorned with star-shaped gemstones, was bestowed as a reward for passing the Hexenzirkel's trial.\nAccording to the one who presented it, it is not something that an ordinary person can master. Yet, the witch known as "Octavia" has been observing you and Paimon for some time. She has witnessed you overcome countless trials and dangers while displaying natural curiosity and courage, and showing remarkable creativity beyond the realms of mere adventure. For these reasons, she considers you the ideal candidates to become the new masters of the Miliastra Wonderland. Octavia firmly believes that together, the two of you will unlock the full potential of this wondrous world...

name: Welcome to Nasha Town!
description: This guide map — found after running into the kuuhenki at Nasha Town's docks — appears to highlight points of interest around town.

name: Key to the "Hibernation Chamber"
description: On that ship that traversed the sea of stars, there should be only two keys, belonging to the golden-haired, traveling twins.

name: Ayar Heroes' Cup Invitation
description: A mysterious invitation letter, with a line of crooked little letters inside: "Tour of the Return of the Sacred Flame."

name: "Ultra-Amazing Miracle Tonic Guaranteed to Make You Taller with Zero Effort!"
description: A "miracle tonic" obtained from Dori.\nIt seems a little suspicious. Could growing taller really be this easy?

name: Key (Important Item)
description: The "key" to rescuing the Alpaca Sheriff.

name: Aino's Toolbox
description: A toolbox stored in the Workshop's Trove. Instead of tools, it contains a mysterious accessory.

name: Aino's Toolbox (Empty)
description: A toolbox that once held Aino's accessory — an accessory that has since been taken.

name: Ineffa's Toolbox

name: Teyvat Commemorative Album
description: #An album filled with memories of people and events that {NICKNAME} has encountered on {M#his}{F#her} travels. On this unending journey forward, too much has happened, and too many faces have come and gone. Like a traveler who sleeps beneath the glittering stars each night, even their beauty may one day fade into numbness. To keep that day from coming, you must record every sight and soul you encounter. This is the wisdom that Paimon shared with you during your journey. It's been so many years, and Paimon has grown too. How heartwarming!

name: Keepsake Photo With Yelan
description: After efficiently tracking down and completely dismantling the "Mora-laundering" team of the "Dark Financier," you enjoyed a brief vacation in Fontaine with Yelan. To commemorate this mission, you took a snapshot with the Forensic Imaging Device.

name: "The First Iron Coin"
description:
An aged iron coin engraved with a stylized raven sigil. Legend says it was forged by Reed Miller, founder of the Treasure Hoarders, and was the very first true "Iron Coin."
In a world without borders, in a paradise where no one suffers from hunger or cold, the gold bestowed and governed by the Deus Auri was never meant to serve as the foundation of human cooperation.
Humans should be masters of money, not its servants. Even if one cannot claim the heart of gold for themselves, all should be able to wield the wealth that inherently belongs to everyone.

But that is a story of a much later time. Whether it was the first iron coin or the ideals sung, interpreted, and twisted over the following centuries,
it all began on a winter night beyond the reach of lamplight, when two children slipped out of the academy, hiding from the adults' eyes, and carved a token for playing the Thief Extraordinaire.

description: A sacred lamp capable of forming a protective barrier, brimming with energy and shining brilliantly.\nOnce a ritual vessel of the Frostmoon Scions, it brought dreams and song to the lost people wandering the desolate lands. It has survived to this day only because it was left behind in the time-stilled tower.

name: Forgotten Key
description: This might open a door somewhere.

name: Tier I Bunker Access Card
description: A key card obtained from a peculiar terminal on the west side of Piramida. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.\nFrom what you've been told, it should grant access to the bunker beneath the terminal.

name: Tier II Bunker Access Card
description: A key card obtained from an experiment site. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.\nNeat Snezhnayan text has been printed onto its surface: "Senior Maintenance Technician Aleksey Zakharevich Kotelnikov."

name: Tier III Bunker Access Card
description: A key card obtained from an experiment site. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.\nNeat Snezhnayan text has been printed onto its surface: "Chief Researcher Grazina Myklukho."

name: The Research Notes of Master Ruggiero
The History of the Decline and Fall of Remuria
Automnequi Sermon Dictation: Concerning the Apocalypse
Automnequi Sermon Dictation: Explications on the Chymical Marriage
Great Detective Hurlock: The Alchemist and the Clockwork Saint
Event Invitation
description: An invitation sent by Jean, Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. The message is brief and makes no mention of the event's details.

name: Featherlight Mora
description: Mora found at Starfell Lake. Though it looks identical to ordinary Mora, it weighs only one-tenth as much, making the joy of acquiring wealth feel only one-tenth as great.

name: Highly Elastic Fish Meat
description: Fish meat found at Starfell Lake. Though it looks like ordinary fish, it is exceptionally elastic — no matter how hard you press it, it quickly returns to its original shape. Rather than a cooking ingredient, it seems more like a method of stress-relief... best not to try eating it.

name: Dodoco's Enchanted Candy
description:
A souvenir from Klee during your time helping run the Knights' drinks stand.
"Put everything together on the alchemy table, wish for the shape you want, say Mom's magic words, and... poof! Dodoco-shaped candy!"
As expected of a creation by Ms. Alice. Even using ingredients common across Teyvat, it holds a wonderfully complex sweetness. Take a small bite, and you can almost hear the echo of a sweet magic incantation in your mind...
Unfortunately, the supply is limited. Better keep one as a souvenir!

name: A Message From the Legendary Thief Reed Miller
Letter Buried in the Time Capsule
A Brief History of the Pale Starborn
description: A book on fae history. Based on certain details within, it's believed to have been written by fae elders.

name: Night Murmurs From the Far Border: Varcolac
description: A collection of folktales circulated in Snezhnaya, said to record all kinds of lesser-known fae tales. This volume tells the story of a dangerous fae known as the "Varcolac."

name: Tales Carried by the Northwind
description: A poetry collection chronicling the deeds of successive Starshynas. Most of its contents were lost in past calamities. Only a small fraction of the original fragments have been recovered.

name: Secret Source: Ancient Moon's Fount
description: An artificial core that uses Secret Source techniques to encapsulate highly concentrated Archaeolune Energy.

name: A Letter Carried by the Wind
description: A letter that found its way into your bag at some point. Perhaps it was carried here by the wind.

name: Varka's Invitation Ticket
description: A hand-drawn invitation ticket from Varka. Can be redeemed at the Good Hunter for a hearty, meat-filled feast.

name: Varka's Invitation Ticket
description: A hand-drawn invitation ticket from Varka. Can be redeemed at the Good Hunter for a hearty, meat-filled feast. A small stamp reading "Used" is marked in the corner on the back.

name: Varka's Secret Stash of Cash
description: Money Varka has set aside for drinks, brazenly tucked away in a desk drawer.\n"The most dangerous spot is actually the safest spot!" He might claim that, but the truth is he probably keeps the money here because he believes the acting Grand Master will neither spend it nor reveal its hiding place.\nAlthough this money was originally set aside to buy the Dandelion Wine as an offering to the Archon, now that plans have changed, maybe it can be used to reward the Honorary Knight who saved Varka — or given to the knight to reward each friend who helped rescue Varka instead.
